# OpenADR Demand Response & FlexAlert (`.oadr`, `.xml`, `.json`)

`@modelscript/openadr` (`languages/openadr`) provides native parsing, time-series signal evaluation, Virtual End Node (VEN) curtailment shed calculation, and DAE lowering for **OpenADR (2.0b XML & 3.0 JSON)** automated demand response and dynamic flexibility tariffs.

---

## Supported Extensions & Standards

| Extension | Format                             | Description                                                                  |
| :-------- | :--------------------------------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `.oadr`   | OpenADR Unified Payload            | Demand response program declarations, event intervals, and signal limits     |
| `.xml`    | OpenADR 2.0b `oadrDistributeEvent` | Standard XML schema for utility-to-facility event distribution               |
| `.json`   | OpenADR 3.0 REST/JSON              | Lightweight JSON schema for cloud DR orchestrators and microgrid aggregators |

---

## Key Capabilities

### 1. Dual 2.0b XML & 3.0 JSON Program Ingestion

- Ingests demand response program metadata: event windows, start times, notification lead times, and priority tiers.
- Parses multiple signal types:
  - `level`: Discrete curtailment levels (0: Normal, 1: Moderate, 2: High, 3: Critical)
  - `price`: Real-time locational marginal pricing ($/kWh)
  - `setpoint`: Absolute power limit target (kW)
  - `delta`: Relative power reduction request ($\Delta$ kW)
  - `multiplier`: Percentage multiplier on baseline load

### 2. VEN Curtailment Schedule Evaluation

- Evaluates facility response across non-overlapping and overlapping event windows.
- Resolves conflicting multi-event signals using standard OpenADR priority rules (`priority` field and latest issuance timestamps).
- Projects active power thresholds $P_{\text{limit}}(t)$ for coupling with HVAC thermal zones (`@modelscript/energyplus`), industrial pumps (`@modelscript/epanet`), and EV chargers (`@modelscript/ocpp`).

### 3. DAE Formulation for Microgrid Peak Shaving

- Couples curtailment targets into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder`, bounding facility demand to the active OpenADR limit (with soft-slack $\varepsilon_{\text{shed}}$) and integrating total energy curtailed over the event window:
  $$P_{\text{facility}}(t) \le P_{\text{limit}}(t) + \varepsilon_{\text{shed}}$$
  $$E_{\text{shed}} = \int_{t_{\text{start}}}^{t_{\text{end}}} \max(0, P_{\text{baseline}}(t) - P_{\text{facility}}(t)) \, dt$$

  | Symbol                                | Meaning                                                | Units / Domain                                  |
  | :------------------------------------ | :----------------------------------------------------- | :---------------------------------------------- |
  | $P_{\text{facility}}(t)$              | Actual facility electrical power demand at time $t$    | $\text{kW}$                                     |
  | $P_{\text{limit}}(t)$                 | Active OpenADR curtailment power threshold             | $\text{kW}$                                     |
  | $\varepsilon_{\text{shed}}$           | Non-negative soft-slack violation variable             | $\text{kW}$ ($\varepsilon_{\text{shed}} \ge 0$) |
  | $E_{\text{shed}}$                     | Total energy curtailed below baseline during the event | $\text{kWh}$                                    |
  | $t_{\text{start}}, t_{\text{end}}, t$ | Event start time, end time, and integration time       | $\text{h}$                                      |
  | $P_{\text{baseline}}(t)$              | Counterfactual baseline facility load without DR event | $\text{kW}$                                     |

---

## Verification, Maturity & Benchmarks

Tier: `alpha` | Pass Rate: 100% (2/2) | Parse Latency: 0.05 ms (p95: 0.09 ms)

| Benchmark Case | Scale | Reference Oracle | Metric / Threshold | Measured | Status |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :---: |
| Canonical Fixture Parse | micro | ModelScript WASM GLR | `ast-pass-rate <= 1` | `0` | PASS |
| caiso-dr-curtailment-schedule | standard | OpenADR 2.0b / 3.0 Grid Curtailment | `dae-parity <= 0` | `5` | PASS |

Reproduce: `npm run bench:languages -- --lang=openadr`

# LBNL TOUGH Geothermal Reservoir (`.tgh`, `.dat`, `.tough`)

`@modelscript/tough` (`languages/tough`) provides native fixed-format card parsing, geothermal production well flashing thermodynamics, and multiphase non-isothermal DAE lowering for **Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory (LBNL) TOUGH2/3** geothermal reservoir decks.

---

## Supported Extensions & Standards

| Extension        | Format                   | Description                                                       |
| :--------------- | :----------------------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `.tgh`, `.tough` | TOUGH Input Deck         | Standard LBNL fixed-width ASCII block deck for reservoir modeling |
| `.dat`           | TOUGH / MULKOM Data File | Classic geothermal reservoir simulation deck                      |

---

## Key Capabilities

### 1. Card-Based Block Parsing Engine

- Parses canonical TOUGH2/TOUGH3 simulation blocks:
  - `ROCKS`: Formation density $\rho_r$, porosity $\phi$, anisotropic permeability tensor $(k_x, k_y, k_z)$, thermal conductivity $\lambda_r$, and rock heat capacity $c_r$.
  - `ELEME` & `CONNE`: 3D Voronoi unstructured or cartesian discretization cells, interface areas $A_{ij}$, nodal distances $d_1, d_2$, and gravity cosines.
  - `GENER`: Production and injection mass and heat sources ($q_m$, $h_{\text{inj}}$).
  - `INCON`: Initial cell pore pressures $P$ and temperatures $T$.

### 2. Geothermal Wellbore Flashing Thermodynamics

- Solves steady-state isenthalpic flashing for high-enthalpy production wells, partitioning total fluid enthalpy between saturated liquid and vapor phases to determine steam quality $x$:
  $$h_{\text{mixture}} = (1 - x) h_f(P) + x \, h_g(P)$$
  $$x = \frac{h_{\text{mixture}} - h_f(P)}{h_{fg}(P)}$$
- Evaluates total available thermal power from the wellhead mass flow rate and enthalpy drop to the condenser:
  $$\dot{W}_{\text{th}} = \dot{m} \cdot (h_{\text{mixture}} - h_{\text{condensate}})$$

  | Symbol                  | Meaning                                                                  | Units / Domain          |
  | :---------------------- | :----------------------------------------------------------------------- | :---------------------- |
  | $h_{\text{mixture}}$    | Specific enthalpy of the two-phase wellhead mixture                      | $\text{J/kg}$           |
  | $x$                     | Flash steam mass quality fraction                                        | dimensionless, $[0, 1]$ |
  | $h_f(P), h_g(P)$        | Saturated liquid and saturated vapor specific enthalpies at pressure $P$ | $\text{J/kg}$           |
  | $h_{fg}(P)$             | Latent heat of vaporization ($h_g(P) - h_f(P)$)                          | $\text{J/kg}$, $> 0$    |
  | $P$                     | Separator or wellhead pressure                                           | $\text{Pa}$, $> 0$      |
  | $\dot{W}_{\text{th}}$   | Net thermal power output                                                 | $\text{W}$              |
  | $\dot{m}$               | Total produced wellhead mass flow rate                                   | $\text{kg/s}$, $\ge 0$  |
  | $h_{\text{condensate}}$ | Specific enthalpy of cooled reinjection condensate                       | $\text{J/kg}$           |

### 3. Non-Isothermal Multiphase Darcy DAE Lowering

- Lowers finite-volume mass and internal energy conservation laws for each grid block $i$ into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder`, balancing accumulation against inter-cell fluxes and source/sink terms:
  $$\frac{d M_\kappa}{dt} = \sum_{j} F_{\kappa, ij} + q_\kappa$$
  $$\frac{d E}{dt} = \sum_{j} F_{h, ij} + q_h$$
  where phase mass advection between connected cells is governed by multiphase Darcy's law:
  $$\mathbf{F}_\beta = -k \frac{k_{r\beta}}{\mu_\beta} \rho_\beta (\nabla P_\beta - \rho_\beta \mathbf{g})$$

  | Symbol                           | Meaning                                                                      | Units / Domain                                         |
  | :------------------------------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :----------------------------------------------------- |
  | $M_\kappa, E$                    | Accumulated mass of component $\kappa$ and total internal energy in cell $i$ | $\text{kg}$, $\text{J}$                                |
  | $t$                              | Simulation time                                                              | $\text{s}$, $\ge 0$                                    |
  | $F_{\kappa, ij}, F_{h, ij}$      | Mass flux of component $\kappa$ and heat flux from neighbor cell $j$ to $i$  | $\text{kg/s}$, $\text{W}$                              |
  | $q_\kappa, q_h$                  | External mass and heat source/sink rates (`GENER`)                           | $\text{kg/s}$, $\text{W}$                              |
  | $\mathbf{F}_\beta$               | Advective mass flux vector of fluid phase $\beta$ (liquid, gas, NAPL)        | $\text{kg/(m}^2\cdot\text{s)}$                         |
  | $k, k_{r\beta}$                  | Absolute rock permeability and relative permeability of phase $\beta$        | $\text{m}^2$, dimensionless ($[0, 1]$)                 |
  | $\mu_\beta, \rho_\beta, P_\beta$ | Dynamic viscosity, density, and pore pressure of phase $\beta$               | $\text{Pa}\cdot\text{s}$, $\text{kg/m}^3$, $\text{Pa}$ |
  | $\mathbf{g}$                     | Gravitational acceleration vector                                            | $\text{m/s}^2$, $\mathbb{R}^3$                         |

- Directly connects geothermal district heating outputs into building heating loops (`@modelscript/energyplus`) and regional electrical grids (`@modelscript/opendss`).

---

## Verification, Maturity & Benchmarks

Tier: `alpha` | Pass Rate: 100% (2/2) | Parse Latency: 3.46 ms (p95: 4.01 ms)

# MATPOWER Power System Simulation Cases (`.m`)

The `@modelscript/matpower` package (`languages/matpower`) provides native support for **MATPOWER** power flow and optimal power flow network definitions (`.m`). MATPOWER is the gold-standard open-source electric power system simulation package widely used in academic research, ISO market design, and industrial grid benchmarking.

ModelScript provides Ahead-of-Time WASM parsing, zero-GC linear memory DAE lowering, pre-flight topological and parameter integrity diagnostics (`MP2001`–`MP4001`), bi-directional projections with **Siemens PSS/E (`.raw`)**, and direct integration with the **Two-Tier Optimal Power Flow (OPF)** solver engine.

---

## Supported Case Structures

MATPOWER models are structured around the standard `mpc` struct containing tabular matrix data:

| Matrix / Struct   | Dimension                       | Description & Key Columns                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| :---------------- | :------------------------------ | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **`mpc.bus`**     | $N_{\text{bus}} \times 13+$     | Bus number, type (1: PQ, 2: PV, 3: Slack, 4: Isolated), active load ($P_d$), reactive load ($Q_d$), shunt conductance/susceptance ($G_s, B_s$), voltage magnitude ($V_m$), angle ($V_a$), base kV, and voltage limits ($V_{\min}, V_{\max}$).   |
| **`mpc.gen`**     | $N_{\text{gen}} \times 10+$     | Generator bus index, active generation ($P_g$), reactive generation ($Q_g$), reactive bounds ($Q_{\min}, Q_{\max}$), voltage setpoint ($V_g$), MVA base ($m_{\text{base}}$), in-service status, and active power bounds ($P_{\min}, P_{\max}$). |
| **`mpc.branch`**  | $N_{\text{branch}} \times 11+$  | From-bus, to-bus, series resistance ($r$), series reactance ($x$), total line charging susceptance ($b$), MVA thermal ratings (`rateA`, `rateB`, `rateC`), transformer off-nominal turns ratio, phase shift angle, and in-service status.       |
| **`mpc.gencost`** | $N_{\text{gen}} \times (4+N_c)$ | Generator fuel and operating cost functions: polynomial ($c_2 P_g^2 + c_1 P_g + c_0$) or piecewise linear, including startup and shutdown costs.                                                                                                |

---

## Architecture & Compilation Pipeline

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    M[".m MATPOWER Case File"] --> P["GLR Matrix Parser (parseMatpowerCase)"]
    P --> AST["Typed MatpowerCase AST"]
    AST --> LINT["Static Diagnostic Linter (lintMatpowerCase)"]
    AST --> DAE["Zero-GC DAE Lowering (lowerMatpowerToDae)"]
    AST --> PSSE["PSS/E Projection (matpowerToPsseRaw)"]
    AST --> OPF["Two-Tier OPF Engine (msx opf solve)"]

    DAE --> ARENA["Linear Memory DAE Arena (DAEBuilder)"]
    PSSE --> RAW["Siemens PSS/E RAW (.raw)"]
    OPF --> SOL["LMPs, Thermal Flows & Dispatches"]
```

---

## Pre-Flight Grid Diagnostics (`MP2001`–`MP4001`)

The `@modelscript/matpower` diagnostic linter validates electrical sanity, topology, and numeric consistency prior to solver dispatch:

| Error Code | Rule Name                 |  Severity   | Description                                                             |
| :--------- | :------------------------ | :---------: | :---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `MP2001`   | `duplicate-bus`           |  **Error**  | Duplicate bus number detected in `mpc.bus`.                             |
| `MP2002`   | `branch-unknown-bus`      |  **Error**  | Transmission branch connects to non-existent from/to bus ID.            |
| `MP2003`   | `gen-unknown-bus`         |  **Error**  | Generator attached to a bus number not defined in `mpc.bus`.            |
| `MP3001`   | `no-slack-bus`            |  **Error**  | No swing/slack bus (`type = 3`) present in network definition.          |
| `MP3002`   | `multiple-slack-buses`    | **Warning** | Multiple slack buses detected (distributed slack mode required).        |
| `MP3003`   | `zero-impedance`          |  **Error**  | Transmission branch has zero series impedance ($r = 0, x = 0$).         |
| `MP3004`   | `voltage-limits-inverted` |  **Error**  | Bus voltage minimum exceeds maximum ($V_{\min} > V_{\max}$).            |
| `MP3005`   | `gen-plimits-inverted`    |  **Error**  | Generator active capability inverted ($P_{\min} > P_{\max}$).           |
| `MP3006`   | `gen-qlimits-inverted`    |  **Error**  | Generator reactive capability inverted ($Q_{\min} > Q_{\max}$).         |
| `MP4001`   | `isolated-bus`            | **Warning** | Bus is electrically isolated without any in-service branch connections. |

---

## Bi-Directional Conversion & Projections

### MATPOWER to PSS/E (`matpowerToPsseRaw`)

Projects MATPOWER cases to standard Siemens PTI PSS/E v33 `.raw` files:

- Converts bus voltage angles from degrees to radians and back.
- Splits combined generation/load buses into distinct PSS/E generator and load records.
- Preserves transformer off-nominal turns ratio and complex phase shift angles.
- Maps branch thermal `rateA` ratings to PSS/E MVA ratings.

### Lowering to Linear WebAssembly DAE

Lowers power balance equations into ModelScript's zero-GC WebAssembly `DAEBuilder` linear arena (`lowerMatpowerToDae`):

- Voltage magnitudes $V_i$ and phase angles $\theta_i$ registered as continuous algebraic variables.
- Active and reactive nodal power injection mismatch equations, enforcing that net power injected into the network at each bus $i$ equals generation minus load demand:
  $$P_i(\theta, V) - P_{g,i} + P_{d,i} = 0$$
  $$Q_i(\theta, V) - Q_{g,i} + Q_{d,i} = 0$$

  | Symbol                           | Meaning                                                            | Units / Domain                                          |
  | :------------------------------- | :----------------------------------------------------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------ |
  | $i$                              | Bus index                                                          | $\text{dimensionless}$ ($i = 1, \dots, N_{\text{bus}}$) |
  | $\theta, V$                      | Vectors of bus voltage phase angles and magnitudes                 | $\text{rad}$, $\text{p.u.}$                             |
  | $P_i(\theta, V), Q_i(\theta, V)$ | Net active and reactive power injected into the network at bus $i$ | $\text{p.u.}$ (or $\text{MW}, \text{MVAr}$)             |
  | $P_{g,i}, Q_{g,i}$               | Active and reactive power generated at bus $i$                     | $\text{p.u.}$ (or $\text{MW}, \text{MVAr}$)             |
  | $P_{d,i}, Q_{d,i}$               | Active and reactive load demand at bus $i$                         | $\text{p.u.}$ (or $\text{MW}, \text{MVAr}$)             |

- Ready for Block Lower Triangular (BLT) decomposition, Newton-Raphson power flow, and continuous dynamic simulation.

---

## Command-Line Interface (`msx matpower`)

The `modelscript` / `msx` CLI includes dedicated tools for inspecting, linting, solving, and transforming MATPOWER cases:

```bash
# Print a tabular network summary (buses, lines, generators, generation & load capacity)
msx matpower summary case14.m

# Run pre-flight electrical and topological integrity lint checks
msx matpower lint case14.m

# Solve DC Optimal Power Flow using Tier 2 Direct Zero-GC solver
msx matpower solve case14.m --formulation=dc

# Solve non-linear AC Optimal Power Flow
msx matpower solve case14.m --formulation=ac

# Convert MATPOWER case to Siemens PSS/E RAW format
msx matpower to-psse case14.m --out=case14.raw

# Lower directly into zero-GC WebAssembly DAE arena text format
msx matpower to-dae case14.m --out=case14_dae.txt
```

---

## Programmatic TypeScript API

```typescript
import { parseMatpowerCase, lintMatpowerCase, matpowerToPsseRaw, lowerMatpowerToDae } from "@modelscript/matpower";
import { solveDcOpfAsync } from "@modelscript/simulate/opf";
import fs from "node:fs";

// 1. Parse MATPOWER .m case file
const mCode = fs.readFileSync("case14.m", "utf-8");
const mpc = parseMatpowerCase(mCode);

// 2. Validate topological sanity
const diagnostics = lintMatpowerCase(mpc);
if (diagnostics.length > 0) {
  console.warn("Diagnostics found:", diagnostics);
}

// 3. Lower to linear memory DAE arena
const arena = lowerMatpowerToDae(mpc);
console.log(`DAE Variables: ${arena.getVarCount()}, Equations: ${arena.getEqCount()}`);

// 4. Export to PSS/E RAW
const psseCase = matpowerToPsseRaw(mpc);
```

# IEEE COMTRADE Fault Transients (`.cfg`, `.dat`, `.cff`)

The `@modelscript/comtrade` package (`languages/comtrade`) provides native support for **IEEE C37.111** and **IEC 60255-24 COMTRADE (Common Format for Transient Data Exchange)** files. COMTRADE is the universal industry standard for transient fault recordings captured by digital protective relays, disturbance fault recorders (DFRs), digital fault locators, and power quality meters.

ModelScript reads and writes COMTRADE 1991, 1999, and 2013 standards across ASCII, binary 16-bit, and single-file container (`.cff`) formats, extracts sliding-window dynamic Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT) RMS phasors, and replays recorded fault trajectories in linear-memory WebAssembly DAE arenas.

---

## Supported File Formats & Schemas

| Format / Extension  | Specification                 | Description                                                                                                                                                    |
| :------------------ | :---------------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **`.cfg`**          | IEEE C37.111 Configuration    | Station name, recording device ID, channel roster, scaling multipliers ($a, b$), channel phase identifiers, line frequency, sampling rates, timestamp headers. |
| **`.dat` (ASCII)**  | Comma-delimited text          | Sample number, timestamp in microseconds ($t_{\mu s}$), analog values, digital boolean status words.                                                           |
| **`.dat` (Binary)** | 16-bit / 32-bit signed binary | Little-endian packed binary samples with high-density storage for high-frequency transients.                                                                   |
| **`.cff`**          | Single-file container         | Standard XML/MIME container packaging configuration, data, header (`.hdr`), and information (`.inf`) blocks into a single file.                                |

---

## Architecture & Compilation Pipeline

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    C[".cfg + .dat or .cff"] --> P["COMTRADE Reader (parseComtradeCfg / parseComtradeDatAscii)"]
    P --> REC["Typed ComtradeRecord"]
    REC --> LINT["Signal & Scaling Linter (lintComtradeRecord)"]
    REC --> DFT["Sliding-Window DFT Phasor Extractor (extractPhasorSeries)"]
    REC --> DAE["Zero-GC DAE Arena Lowering (lowerComtradeToDae)"]
    REC --> W["COMTRADE Writer (writeComtradeCff)"]

    DAE --> ARENA["Linear Memory DAE Playback Arena"]
    W --> CFF["Bundled COMTRADE Container (.cff)"]
```

---

## Pre-Flight Diagnostics (`COM1001`–`COM4001`)

The `@modelscript/comtrade` linter audits signal completeness and data format integrity:

| Code      |  Severity   | Description                                                               |
| :-------- | :---------: | :------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `COM1001` |  **Error**  | Configuration header syntax error or missing mandatory fields.            |
| `COM1002` |  **Error**  | Channel count mismatch between `.cfg` header and `.dat` columns.          |
| `COM2001` |  **Error**  | Non-monotonic timestamps or backwards time jumps in data stream.          |
| `COM3001` | **Warning** | Analog sample clipping beyond analog channel $A_{\min} / A_{\max}$ scale. |
| `COM4001` | **Warning** | Missing or irregular sampling rate declaration in multi-rate records.     |

---

## Command-Line Interface (`msx comtrade`)

```bash
# Print recording header summary, channel roster, and sampling rates
msx comtrade summary fault_record.cfg

# Lint recording for channel mismatches and timestamp monotonicity
msx comtrade lint fault_record.cfg

# Extract dynamic DFT RMS phasor series for analog channel 0
msx comtrade extract-phasor fault_record.cfg --channel=0

# Bundle split .cfg and .dat files into single-file .cff container
msx comtrade to-cff fault_record.cfg -o bundled_fault.cff

# Lower recording into WebAssembly DAE linear arena for solver playback
msx comtrade to-dae fault_record.cfg
```

---

## MCP Agent Tool Integration

- **`comtrade_extract_phasor`**: Performs sliding-window 1-cycle Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT) phasor estimation (RMS magnitude, phase angle in degrees, nominal frequency) from COMTRADE records for protective relaying evaluation.

# IEC 61850 Substation Configuration Language (`.scd`, `.cid`, `.ssd`)

The `@modelscript/scl` package (`languages/scl`) provides native support for **IEC 61850 Substation Configuration Language (SCL)** files. IEC 61850 is the international gold standard for electrical substation automation, digital control architectures, protective relay communications, and smart grid interoperability.

ModelScript parses SCL XML files across Edition 1 and Edition 2 revisions (`.scd`, `.cid`, `.ssd`, `.sed`, `.icd`), audits real-time Ethernet GOOSE and Sampled Values (SV) publisher-subscriber communication latency against IEC 61850-5 Type 1A fast-trip performance classes ($\le 4\text{ ms}$), synthesizes node-breaker Single-Line Diagram (SLD) grid topologies, and lowers automation logic to WebAssembly DAE arenas.

---

## Supported SCL XML Schema Elements

| SCL Section             | Schema Tag            | Description                                                                                                                                       |
| :---------------------- | :-------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| **Header**              | `<Header>`            | Substation configuration ID, version, revision, tooling vendor metadata.                                                                          |
| **Substation**          | `<Substation>`        | Primary physical equipment: `<VoltageLevel>`, `<Bay>`, `<ConductingEquipment>` (circuit breakers `CBR`, disconnectors `DIS`, transformers `PTR`). |
| **Communication**       | `<Communication>`     | Subnetwork addressing: `<SubNetwork>`, `<ConnectedAP>`, GSE (GOOSE), and SMV (Sampled Values) multicast MAC/IP and APPID allocations.             |
| **IED**                 | `<IED>`               | Intelligent Electronic Device definitions: Access points, Logical Devices (`LDevice`), Logical Nodes (`LN0`, `XCBR`, `CSWI`, `PTOC`, `PDIS`).     |
| **Data Type Templates** | `<DataTypeTemplates>` | Standard and custom LNodeType, DOType, DAType, and EnumType structures.                                                                           |

---

## Architecture & Compilation Pipeline

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    S[".scd / .cid / .ssd SCL XML"] --> P["SCL Parser (parseSclXml)"]
    P --> DOC["Typed SclDocument AST"]
    DOC --> LINT["Engineering Rule Linter (lintSclDocument)"]
    DOC --> GOOSE["GOOSE & SV Latency Auditor (validateGooseStreams)"]
    DOC --> SLD["Node-Breaker SLD Synthesizer (sclToGridTopology)"]
    DOC --> DAE["Zero-GC DAE Lowering (lowerSclToDae)"]

    DAE --> ARENA["Linear Memory DAE Arena"]
    SLD --> TOP["Substation Bus-Branch / Node-Breaker Graph"]
```

---

## Pre-Flight Diagnostics (`SCL1001`–`SCL4001`)

The `@modelscript/scl` linter verifies schema compliance and automation engineering rules:

| Code      |  Severity   | Description                                                              |
| :-------- | :---------: | :----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `SCL1001` |  **Error**  | XML syntax error or missing mandatory `<Header>` element.                |
| `SCL2001` |  **Error**  | Duplicate IED name, VoltageLevel, or Bay identifier in substation scope. |
| `SCL3001` |  **Error**  | GSEControl or SampledValueControl references non-existent Dataset.       |
| `SCL3002` | **Warning** | GOOSE trip signal exceeds Type 1A 4ms latency boundary requirement.      |
| `SCL4001` | **Warning** | Conducting equipment terminal references unknown ConnectivityNode.       |

---


# ATP-EMTP Electromagnetic Transients (`.atp`, `.dat`)

The `@modelscript/atp` package (`languages/atp`) provides native support for **Alternative Transients Program (ATP-EMTP)** card decks. ATP-EMTP is the venerable open-source electromagnetic transient program used globally for simulating high-frequency power system phenomena, lightning surge propagation, switching overvoltages, insulation coordination, and power electronics interactions.

ModelScript compiles 80-column ATP fixed-column and free-format card decks into zero-GC WebAssembly DAE linear arenas, verifies branch connectivity and time step stability (`ATP1001`–`ATP4001`), and simulates nodal transient voltages using **Dommel's companion-matrix trapezoidal integration rule**.

---

## Supported ATP-EMTP Deck Cards

| Card Type             | Column Format                                       | Description                                                                                          |
| :-------------------- | :-------------------------------------------------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Control Card**      | `DELTA T, TMAX, XOPT, COPT`                         | Simulation time step ($\Delta t$), maximum stop time ($t_{\max}$), frequency options, plot controls. |
| **RLC Branch**        | Columns 1–2: Node 1, Node 2, $R, L, C$              | Lumped series and parallel branch impedances ($R$ in $\Omega$, $L$ in mH, $C$ in $\mu\text{F}$).     |
| **Transmission Line** | Berger/Clarke/JMarti card                           | Distributed parameter transmission lines with surge impedance ($Z_c$) and propagation speed ($v$).   |
| **Switch Card**       | Node 1, Node 2, $T_{\text{close}}, T_{\text{open}}$ | Time-controlled circuit breakers, closing resistor insertion, current-zero opening.                  |
| **Source Card**       | Type 14 / Type 11 AC/DC sources                     | Sinusoidal AC voltage and current sources with amplitude, frequency, and phase angle.                |

---

## Architecture & Compilation Pipeline

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[".atp / .dat Card Deck"] --> P["ATP Deck Parser (parseAtp)"]
    P --> AST["Typed AtpCase AST"]
    AST --> LINT["Circuit Integrity Linter (lintAtpCase)"]
    AST --> SOLVE["Dommel Trapezoidal Solver (simulateAtpCase)"]
    AST --> DAE["Zero-GC DAE Lowering (lowerAtpToDae)"]

    DAE --> ARENA["Linear Memory DAE Arena"]
    SOLVE --> PLOT["Nodal Voltage Trajectories & Transients"]
```

---

## Pre-Flight Diagnostics (`ATP1001`–`ATP4001`)

The `@modelscript/atp` linter audits card deck formatting and electrical topology:

| Code      |  Severity   | Description                                                                          |
| :-------- | :---------: | :----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `ATP1001` |  **Error**  | Syntax error in card formatting or missing mandatory control card.                   |
| `ATP2001` |  **Error**  | Non-positive simulation time step ($\Delta t \le 0$) or duration ($t_{\max} \le 0$). |
| `ATP3001` | **Warning** | Isolated circuit node detected with no ground reference or source path.              |
| `ATP4001` |  **Error**  | Branch parameters are invalid (negative resistance or non-physical inductance).      |

---

## Command-Line Interface (`msx atp`)

```bash
# Print summary of branches, switches, sources, and time step parameters
msx atp summary lightning_surge.atp

# Run pre-flight lint diagnostics for isolated nodes and card formatting
msx atp lint lightning_surge.atp

# Lower circuit deck into WebAssembly DAE arena
msx atp to-dae lightning_surge.atp
```

# IEEE 1815 / DNP3 SCADA Telemetry (`.xml`, `.json`, `.dnp3`)

The `@modelscript/dnp3` package (`languages/dnp3`) provides native support for the **IEEE 1815 / DNP3 (Distributed Network Protocol)** standard. DNP3 is the prevailing communications protocol for SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition), remote terminal units (RTUs), programmable logic controllers (PLCs), and intelligent substation devices across North American and international electric and water utilities.

ModelScript parses standard DNP3 Device Profile XML and JSON documents, implements DNP3 analog deadband event filtering, engineering unit scaling transformations ($y = mx + b$), signal reconstruction verification, and lowers SCADA point databases to zero-GC WebAssembly DAE linear arenas for utility digital twins.

---

## Supported DNP3 Point Objects

| Group             | Object Type    | Representation & Parameters                                                                                                                                      |
| :---------------- | :------------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Group 1 / 2**   | Binary Inputs  | Digital breaker status, alarm contacts, latch flags, event class assignment (Class 1, 2, 3).                                                                     |
| **Group 10 / 12** | Binary Outputs | Remote control relays, trip/close commands, pulse/latch directives (`Select-Before-Operate`).                                                                    |
| **Group 30 / 32** | Analog Inputs  | Continuous measurements (bus voltage, MW/MVAR flow, water tank level, pipe pressure), deadband threshold, scaling multiplier ($m$), scaling offset ($b$), units. |
| **Group 40 / 41** | Analog Outputs | Generation dispatch setpoints, voltage regulator targets, valve position setpoints.                                                                              |
| **Group 20 / 22** | Counters       | Energy accumulation (MWh), totalized pumped water volume, rollover boundaries.                                                                                   |

---

## Architecture & Compilation Pipeline

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    D[".xml / .json DNP3 Profile"] --> P["DNP3 Profile Parser (parseDnp3ProfileXml)"]
    P --> PROF["Typed Dnp3DeviceProfile AST"]
    PROF --> LINT["SCADA Profile Linter (lintDnp3Profile)"]
    PROF --> TEL["Deadband Telemetry Filter (processTelemetryStream)"]
    PROF --> DAE["Zero-GC DAE Lowering (lowerDnp3ToDae)"]

    DAE --> ARENA["Linear Memory DAE Arena"]
    TEL --> EVT["Filtered Events, Compression Ratio & RMSE"]
```

---

## Pre-Flight Diagnostics (`DNP1001`–`DNP4001`)

The `@modelscript/dnp3` linter audits point mapping and scaling configuration:

| Code      |  Severity   | Description                                                          |
| :-------- | :---------: | :------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `DNP1001` |  **Error**  | XML/JSON profile syntax error or missing device name.                |
| `DNP2001` |  **Error**  | Duplicate point index within the same point object group.            |
| `DNP3001` | **Warning** | Negative or non-physical deadband threshold on analog input.         |
| `DNP4001` | **Warning** | Zero scaling multiplier on analog channel prevents signal inversion. |

---

## Command-Line Interface (`msx dnp3`)

```bash

# Lint profile for duplicate point indices and invalid scaling
```

# ASPEN OneLiner / CAPE Protection (`.olx`, `.dxt`)

The `@modelscript/oneliner` package (`languages/oneliner`) provides native support for **ASPEN OneLiner** and **Siemens CAPE (Computer-Aided Protection Engineering)** short-circuit and relay coordination cases (`.olx`, `.dxt`). OneLiner and CAPE are the premier protection engineering tools used across electric utilities and ISOs for fault calculations, breaker rating evaluations, and NERC PRC-027 protection coordination studies.

ModelScript parses `.dxt` ASCII and JSON cases, compiles symmetrical component sequence networks (positive sequence $Z_1$, zero sequence $Z_0$, and mutual zero-sequence couplings $Z_{0m}$), calculates 3-phase and single line-to-ground (SLG) fault currents, evaluates **IEEE C37.112 Standard Time-Overcurrent (TOC)** trip times, and lowers protection models into zero-GC WebAssembly DAE linear arenas.

---

## Supported Protection Elements & Sequence Networks

| Network Element       | Data Fields                                                    | Description                                                                                                         |
| :-------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| **Bus**               | `id`, `name`, `baseKv`, `area`, `zone`                         | Substation bus node with nominal voltage rating.                                                                    |
| **Branch / Line**     | `bus1`, `bus2`, $Z_1 (R + jX)$, $Z_0 (R_0 + jX_0)$, $B_1, B_0$ | Transmission lines and cables with positive and zero sequence series impedances and line charging.                  |
| **Mutual Coupling**   | `branch1`, `branch2`, $Z_{0m} (R_{0m} + jX_{0m})$              | Zero-sequence electromagnetic mutual coupling between parallel transmission circuits on shared rights-of-way.       |
| **Generator**         | $X''_d + jR$, $Z_0$                                            | Synchronous and inverter-based resource subtransient short-circuit contributions.                                   |
| **Overcurrent Relay** | `pickupA`, `ctRatio`, `timeDial`, `curve`                      | ANSI 50 instantaneous and ANSI 51 time-overcurrent curves (IEEE Moderately, Very, Extremely Inverse, US CO-8, IEC). |
| **Distance Relay**    | ANSI 21 Zone 1, 2, 3 reach ($\Omega$)                          | Mho and quadrilateral distance protection zones with reach impedances and directional time delays.                  |

---

## Architecture & Compilation Pipeline

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    O[".olx / .dxt OneLiner Case"] --> P["OneLiner Parser (parseOneLiner)"]
    P --> CASE["Typed OneLinerCase AST"]
    CASE --> LINT["Coordination Linter (lintOneLinerCase)"]
    CASE --> FLT["Symmetrical Fault Solver (calculateBusFaultCurrents)"]
    CASE --> TOC["IEEE C37.112 Curve Engine (calculateOvercurrentTripTime)"]
    CASE --> DAE["Zero-GC DAE Lowering (lowerOneLinerToDae)"]

    DAE --> ARENA["Linear Memory DAE Arena"]
    FLT --> CURR["3-Phase & SLG Thevenin Currents"]
```

---

## Pre-Flight Diagnostics (`OLX1001`–`OLX4001`)

The `@modelscript/oneliner` linter audits electrical validity and protection settings:

| Code      |  Severity   | Description                                                                                 |
| :-------- | :---------: | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `OLX1001` |  **Error**  | Branch references undefined from/to bus ID.                                                 |
| `OLX2001` |  **Error**  | Mutual coupling references unknown branch identifier.                                       |
| `OLX3001` | **Warning** | Relay pickup current ($I_{\text{pickup}} \le 0$) or time dial ($TD \le 0$) is non-positive. |
| `OLX4001` | **Warning** | Zone 2 distance reach is smaller than Zone 1 reach ($Z_2 \le Z_1$).                         |


# SEL Relay Protection Settings (`.rdb`, `.rcf`, `.sel`, `.txt`)

The `@modelscript/sel` package (`languages/sel`) provides native support for **Schweitzer Engineering Laboratories (SEL)** protective relay settings across the SEL-300, SEL-400, SEL-700, and modern Axion series (`.rdb`, `.rcf`, `.sel`, `.txt`). SEL relays are the dominant numerical protection platform across North American and global utility substations, generation plants, and industrial switchgear.

ModelScript parses SEL ASCII and JSON settings decks, compiles **SELogic boolean control equations** (including nested parentheses, AND/OR/NOT operators, and recursive cross-variable dependencies), solves **IEEE Standard C37.112** inverse-time overcurrent curves (U1–U5, C1–C5), and lowers protection state machines into zero-GC WebAssembly DAE linear arenas.

---

## Supported Protection Elements & SELogic

| Protection Element                      | Setting Tags              | Description                                                                                 |
| :-------------------------------------- | :------------------------ | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| **Instantaneous Overcurrent (50P/50G)** | `50P1P, 50P2P, 50G1P`     | High-speed instantaneous trip pickups for phase and ground faults.                          |
| **Time-Overcurrent (51P/51G)**          | `51P1P, 51P1C, 51P1TD`    | Inverse-time curve family selection (U1–U5, C1–C5), pickup current, and time dial settings. |
| **Distance Protection (21P/21G)**       | `Z1P, Z2P, Z3P, Z1D, Z2D` | Phase and ground distance reaches in secondary ohms and timer delay cycles.                 |
| **Undervoltage / Overvoltage (27/59)**  | `27P, 59P`                | Bus undervoltage and line overvoltage threshold triggers.                                   |
| **Frequency Elements (81U/81O)**        | `81U, 81O`                | Underfrequency load shedding and overfrequency generation tripping thresholds.              |
| **SELogic Control Equations**           | `TRIP, CLOSE, SV1, SV2`   | Boolean logic expressions combining relay words (e.g. `TRIP = 50P1 OR 51P1T OR Z1P`).       |

---

## Architecture & Compilation Pipeline

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    S[".sel / .txt / .rdb Settings"] --> P["SEL Settings Parser (parseSELSettings)"]
    P --> SET["Typed SELRelaySettings AST"]
    SET --> LINT["Relay Settings Linter (lintSelSettings)"]
    SET --> LOG["SELogic Evaluator (evaluateRelayProtection)"]
    SET --> TOC["IEEE C37.112 TOC Solver (calculateOvercurrentTime)"]
    SET --> DAE["Zero-GC DAE Lowering (lowerSelToDae)"]

    DAE --> ARENA["Linear Memory DAE Arena"]
    LOG --> TRIP["Relay Trip/Close Decisions & Elements"]
```

---

## Pre-Flight Diagnostics (`SEL1001`–`SEL4001`)

The `@modelscript/sel` linter audits relay configuration consistency:

| Code      |  Severity   | Description                                                                       |
| :-------- | :---------: | :-------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `SEL1001` |  **Error**  | Relay model identifier or active settings group is missing.                       |
| `SEL2001` |  **Error**  | SELogic expression syntax error (mismatched parentheses or invalid operator).     |
| `SEL3001` | **Warning** | Relay word referenced in SELogic equation is undefined.                           |
| `SEL4001` |  **Error**  | Instrument transformer ratio (CT or PT) is non-positive ($CTR \le 0, PTR \le 0$). |

---

## Command-Line Interface (`msx sel`)

```bash
# Print summary of relay model, active group, CT/PT ratios, and protection elements
msx sel summary sel421_line_protection.txt

# Run pre-flight lint diagnostics for SELogic syntax and transformer ratios
msx sel lint sel421_line_protection.txt

# Evaluate relay protection trip decisions given measured phase current
msx sel evaluate-protection sel421_line_protection.txt --current=1250.0

# Export settings to canonical SEL ASCII format
msx sel to-ascii sel421_line_protection.txt -o exported.sel

# Lower relay trip logic and TOC curves to WebAssembly DAE arena
msx sel to-dae sel421_line_protection.txt
```

---

## MCP Agent Tool Integration

- **`sel_evaluate_protection`**: Evaluates SEL relay 50P/51P/Z1P elements, calculates inverse-time overcurrent trip durations under IEEE C37.112 curves, and iteratively resolves SELogic boolean equations for agent-driven protection analysis.

---

# IEEE C37.118 Synchrophasor / PMU Profiles (`.c37118`, `.pmu`)

The `@modelscript/c37118` package (`languages/c37118`) provides native support for **IEEE C37.118** synchrophasor and Phasor Measurement Unit (PMU) configuration profiles (`.c37118`, `.pmu`). It enables wide-area monitoring system (WAMS) telemetry validation, DAE measurement-channel lowering, and polyglot synchronization with power grid models.

---

## Supported File Formats

| Extension | Format                     | Description                                                                                    |
| :-------- | :------------------------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `.c37118` | IEEE C37.118 Configuration | PMU station metadata, `IDCODE`, reporting data rate, phasor/analog/digital channel definitions |
| `.pmu`    | PMU Profile                | Synchrophasor stream configuration and nominal frequency/scaling parameters                    |

---

## Capabilities

- **PMU Configuration Parser (`parseC37118`)**: Parses PMU station identifiers, nominal frequency (50/60 Hz), reporting frame rates, phasor channel descriptors (voltage/current, polar/rectangular), analog channels, and digital status words.
- **Static Diagnostics (`lintC37118Config`)**: Validates station configuration consistency, channel bounds, and reporting rate compliance (`C37_3001`, `C37_3002`, and structural checks).
- **DAE Arena Lowering (`lowerC37118ToDae`)**: Lowers PMU phasor magnitude, angle, frequency, and ROCOF measurement channels into `DAEBuilder` variables for co-simulation and digital twin state estimation.
- **LSP & Workspace Indexing (`indexC37118Document`, `getC37118DocumentSymbols`, `getC37118Diagnostics`)**: Provides document symbols, diagnostics, and workspace-wide indexing.
- **TGG Synchronization (`createC37118TggTransformer`)**: Links PMU channels bidirectionally to power system bus measurements and SysML v2 monitoring requirements.

# CYME Distribution Network Models (`.sxst`, `.cyme`)

The `@modelscript/cyme` package (`languages/cyme`) provides native support for **Eaton CYME** distribution power network files (`.sxst`, `.cyme`). # PLS-CADD Overhead Transmission Line Design (`.pol`, `.loa`, `.plscadd`)

The `@modelscript/plscadd` package (`languages/plscadd`) provides native support for **PLS-CADD** overhead transmission line structural and electrical design files (`.pol`, `.loa`, `.plscadd`). It parses tower/pole structures, conductor spans, and weather load cases, computes parabolic sag-tension and span impedance, and lowers transmission line parameters into `DAEBuilder`.

---

## Supported File Formats

| Extension  | Format              | Description                                                                                        |
| :--------- | :------------------ | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `.pol`     | PLS-POLE Structure  | Transmission pole/tower coordinates, attachment elevations, and structural geometry                |
| `.loa`     | PLS-CADD Load Case  | Weather, ice, wind, and conductor temperature loading criteria                                     |
| `.plscadd` | PLS-CADD Line Model | Overhead line corridor definition combining structures, conductor sets, spans, and clearance rules |

---

## Capabilities

- **Line & Structure Parser (`parsePlsCadd`)**: Parses structure coordinates, conductor specifications, ruling spans, and weather load cases, alongside built-in clean-room conductor/structure schemas (`registerBuiltInPlsCaddLibrarySync`).
- **Mechanical & Electrical Span Physics (`computeSpanLengthM`, `computeParabolicSagM`, `computeSpanImpedanceOhms`)**: Evaluates 3D span lengths, parabolic conductor sag under tension/weight loading, and positive-sequence span series impedance.
- **Static Diagnostics (`lintPlsCadd`)**: Validates syntax (`PLSCADD1001`), duplicate/missing structure references (`PLSCADD2001`, `PLSCADD2002`), sag/tension/rating limits (`PLSCADD3001`), and ground-clearance/structural checks (`PLSCADD4001`, `PLSCADD4002`).
- **DAE Arena Lowering (`lowerPlsCaddToDae`)**: Lowers overhead line span impedances, thermal ampacity, and sag-clearance constraints into `DAEBuilder` with default schema parameter resolution (`resolvePlsCaddSchemaParamDefaults`).
- **LSP, Indexing & TGG (`indexPlsCaddDocument`, `getPlsCaddDocumentSymbols`, `tgg/`)**: Provides workspace indexing, LSP symbols/diagnostics, and bidirectional TGG rules.

# PowerWorld Simulator AUX & IEEE CDF (`.aux`, `.cdf`)

The `@modelscript/powerworld` package (`languages/powerworld`) provides native support for **PowerWorld Simulator** Auxiliary (`.aux`) files and **IEEE Common Data Format (CDF)** (`.cdf`) power-flow cases. It combines a native grammar parser, clean-room standard dynamic model schemas with WASM execution loaders, static electrical diagnostics, **PSS/E `.raw`** projection, and linear-memory `DAEBuilder` lowering.

---

## Supported File Formats

| Extension | Format                    | Description                                                                                                              |
| :-------- | :------------------------ | :----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `.aux`    | PowerWorld Auxiliary File | Declarative `DATA (...)` blocks for buses, generators, branches, loads, shunts, areas, contingencies, and dynamic models |
| `.cdf`    | IEEE Common Data Format   | Classic IEEE bus/branch power-flow interchange card deck (`BUS DATA FOLLOWS`, `BRANCH DATA FOLLOWS`)                     |

---

## Capabilities

- **AUX & IEEE CDF Parsers (`parsePowerWorldAux`, `parseIeeeCdf`, `projectToIeeeCdf`)**: Parses PowerWorld `.aux` data/script sections and IEEE CDF card decks into a unified `PowerWorldAuxModel`, with round-trip IEEE CDF export.
- **Clean-Room Dynamic Model Catalog & WASM Loader (`catalog/`)**: Includes clean-room schemas (`buildPowerWorldCleanroomSchemas`, `lookupPowerWorldModelSchema`), SVG block diagram synthesis (`generatePowerWorldBlockSvg`), and WASM model instantiation (`instantiatePowerWorldWasmModel`).
- **Static Diagnostics (`lintPowerWorldAux`)**: Validates bus/branch/generator topology, slack bus presence, impedance sanity, and voltage/reactive limits.
- **DAE Arena Lowering (`lowerPowerWorldToDae`)**: Lowers AC power-flow nodal balance equations and dynamic generator/exciter/governor models into `DAEBuilder`.
- **PSS/E RAW Projection (`projectPowerWorldToPsseRaw`)**: Exports PowerWorld `.aux` / `.cdf` cases directly to Siemens PTI PSS/E `.raw` format.
- **LSP, Indexing & TGG (`lsp.ts`, `indexing.ts`, `tgg/`)**: Provides completions (`getPowerWorldCompletions`), document symbols (`getPowerWorldDocumentSymbols`), diagnostics, workspace indexing, and bidirectional TGG synchronization.

---

## Programmatic TypeScript API


# PyPSA — Python for Power System Analysis (`.pypsa`, `.pypsa.json`)

# OLGA-Compatible Multiphase Flow Simulation (`.opi`, `.key`, `.genkey`)

ModelScript provides first-class, polyglot support for **OLGA-compatible** (High-Fidelity Dynamic Multiphase Flow Simulation) models. Engineers can author, simulate, lint, formally verify, and co-simulate multiphase production flowlines, deepwater catenary risers, and slug catchers directly within ModelScript's unified digital thread.

---

## Supported File Formats

| Format                   | Extension         | Description                                                                                                                         |
| :----------------------- | :---------------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **OLGA XML GUI Project** | `.opi`, `.xml`    | Complete graphical network model defining wells, pipes, chokes, separator terminals, and operational controllers.                   |
| **Legacy Keyword Deck**  | `.key`, `.genkey` | Standard industrial keyword decks specifying flowpath geometry, branch connections, boundary conditions, and valve schedules.       |
| **PVT Flash Tables**     | `.tab`            | Compositional and black-oil tabular fluid files for bilinear interpolation of fluid densities, gas-liquid ratios, and viscosities.  |
| **Simulation Trends**    | `.tpl`            | High-frequency time-series trend files containing arbitrary multi-axis channel catalogs ($P$, $T$, $\alpha_L$, $Q_L$, $U_G$, etc.). |
| **Spatial Profiles**     | `.ppl`            | Spatial profile snapshots along pipeline coordinate $X$ with multi-variable channels, flow regime decoding, and time scrubbing.     |

---

## 3-Tier Execution Architecture

ModelScript implements a 3-tier operational execution framework, accommodating headless cloud workflows, system-level co-simulation, and ground-truth industrial verification:

```mermaid
graph TD
    A[OLGA Model: .opi / .key] --> B{Execution Mode}
    B -->|Tier 1: In-WASM DAE| C[Native WebAssembly 1D Drift-Flux Solver]
    B -->|Tier 2: Co-Simulation| D[FMI 2.0/3.0 & SSP OlgaCoSimParticipant]
    B -->|Tier 3: Native Engine| E[OLGA Batch Runner & TPL Trajectory Ingestion]
    C --> F[Flow Assurance Limits Verification]
    D --> F
    E --> F
    F --> G[Dual-View SVG Visualizer & SysML v2 Projection]
```

### 1. Tier 1: Native In-WASM Drift-Flux Solver

- **Zero Intermediate Allocations:** Lowers directly into ModelScript's `DAEBuilder` linear memory arena.
- **Transient Hydrodynamics:** Solves staggered-grid mass, momentum, and energy balances coupled with Zuber-Findlay drift-flux gas-liquid slip.
- **Mechanistic Physics:**
  - **Taitel-Dukler (1976) & Barnea (1987) Flow Regime Map**: Exact geometric wetted perimeters ($S_i, S_G, S_L$) and Andritsos-Hanratty wave friction enhancement.
  - **Pal & Rhodes (1989) Emulsion Inversion**: Captures apparent viscosity peaks during water breakthrough ($WC_{\text{inv}} \approx 42\%$).
  - **Lagrangian Slug Tracker**: Propagates discrete moving slug bodies, resolving slug length distributions ($L_{s,\text{mean}}, L_{s,95}$) and riser-base severe cyclic slugging.
  - **Dynamic Pipeline Scraper Pig (`OlgaPig`)**: Solves pig motion ODEs ($M dv/dt = \Delta P \cdot A - F_{\text{friction}} - M g \sin\theta$) and liquid slug sweep volume accumulation.

### 2. Tier 2: FMI 2.0/3.0 & SSP Co-Simulation

Exposes standard FMI input and output ports via `OlgaCoSimParticipant` in `@modelscript/exchange`:

- **Input Ports:** `choke.opening`, `wellhead.mass_rate`, `separator.pressure`, `ambient.temperature`.
- **Output Ports:** `inlet.pressure`, `arrival.temperature`, `arrival.liquid_holdup`, `arrival.liquid_rate`, `slug.surge_volume`, `hydrate.subcooling`, `maop.margin`, `slug.mean_length`, `slug.frequency`, `pig.position`.

### 3. Tier 3: Industrial OLGA Engine Orchestration

Automates invocation of locally installed OLGA executable engines (`olga.exe` / `olga-cli`), dynamically ingesting binary `.tpl` trajectories into ModelScript's data structures for verification.

## Flow Assurance Verification & Lint Rules

### Diagnostics for OLGA (13 rules)
| Code | Severity | Identifier | Summary |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `M7001` | error | `cfl-condition-violation` | Simulation timestep maxDt (<maxDt> s) violates convective/acoustic CFL stability limit (<value> s). |
| `M7002` | error | `invalid-pipe-dimensions` | Pipe section '<sectionId>' has invalid geometry: <reason>. |
| `M7003` | error | `missing-boundary-condition` | Flowpath '<flowpath>' has no defined <missing> boundary condition. |
| `M7004` | warning | `steep-elevation-warning` | Pipe section '<sectionId>' has steep inclination (<value>\\xB0), risking hydrodynamic slugging. |
| `M7005` | error | `fully-closed-choke-hazard` | Choke valve '<chokeName>' is fully closed (opening = 0) with no active bypass route. |
| `M7006` | warning | `severe-slugging-hazard` | Severe slugging geometry detected on flowpath '<flowpath>' (seabed dip to steep riser). |
| `M7007` | error | `pig-stuck-hazard` | Pig '<pigName>' required differential pressure (<value> bar) exceeds maximum available (<value> bar). |
| `M7008` | error | `pvt-table-missing-or-invalid` | PVT fluid table validation error: <detail>. |
| `M7009` | warning | `wax-deposition-risk` | Fluid temperature (<value>\\xB0C) on flowpath '<flowpath>' drops below Wax Appearance Temperature (<value>\\xB0C). |
| `M7010` | warning | `sand-erosion-or-dropout-hazard` | Sand transport issue on section '<sectionId>': <reason>. |
| `M7011` | error | `sour-service-metallurgy-violation` | H2S partial pressure (<value> bar) on flowpath '<flowpath>' violates NACE MR0175 material limit (<value> bar). |
| `M7012` | warning | `asphaltene-precipitation-hazard` | Operating pressure (<value> bar) on flowpath '<flowpath>' enters Asphaltene Onset Pressure envelope (<value> bar). |
| `M7013` | error | `heatexchanger-parameter-violation` | Heat exchanger '<hxName>' parameter violation: <detail>. |

## SysML v2 Operating Procedure Integration

OLGA models can be formally projected into SysML v2 packages (`@modelscript/olga` $\to$ SysML v2):

```sysml
package Subsea_Tieback_System {
    import ScalarValues::*;

    part def FlowlineAssembly {
        attribute totalLength: Length = 4450.0 [m];
        attribute maopRating: Pressure = 250.0 [bar];
    }

    state def SubseaFlowlineOperatingProcedure {
        entry; then SteadyProduction;

        state SteadyProduction {
            doc /* Continuous production at nominal design rates */
        }
        accept ESD_Trip_Signal then EmergencyShutIn;
        accept Turndown_Command then LowTurndown;

        state EmergencyShutIn {
            doc /* Choke closed; cooldown clock active */
        }
        accept Depressurize_Command when wallTemperature > 18.0 [degC] then ControlledBlowdown;
        accept Cooldown_Timeout when shutInDurationHours >= 8.0 [hr] then ChemicalInhibitionFlushing;

        state ControlledBlowdown;
        state ChemicalInhibitionFlushing;
    }
}
```

## State Checkpointing & Zero-Discontinuity Warm Restart

Long-duration or multi-stage pipeline flow assurance operations can be snapshot to disk and resumed with zero trajectory discontinuity:

```bash
# Snapshot simulation state at completion
msx olga simulate subsea_tieback.opi --duration=3600 --checkpoint-out=t3600.rst

# Resume simulation from t=3600s
msx olga simulate subsea_tieback.opi --duration=7200 --restart=t3600.rst --out=second_stage.csv
```

The `.rst` snapshot encapsulates complete distributed states across the spatial grid:

- Cell pressure $P$, temperature $T$, phase holdups ($\alpha_L, \alpha_G$), and velocities ($u_L, u_G$)
- Active Lagrangian slug states (tail/front positions, slug lengths, propagation velocities)
- Scraper pig position, speed, and accumulated swept liquid volume
- Machinery operating states and closed-loop controller integral accumulators

## Autonomous Field History Matching & Parameter Calibration

Calibrate flowline simulation models to match production SCADA telemetry and test separator observations using bounded Nelder-Mead simplex optimization:

```bash
msx olga tune subsea_tieback.opi field_telemetry.csv \
  --tune=roughness,choke-cd,heat-transfer \
  --max-evals=150 \
  --out=calibrated_model.opi \
  --report=tuning_report.md
```

The optimizer automatically estimates:

- Effective pipe hydraulic roughness ($\epsilon$)
- Overall ambient heat transfer coefficient ($U_{\text{ambient}}$)
- Choke discharge coefficients ($C_d$)
- Well productivity index (PI) / reservoir inflow rates

Outputs comprehensive statistical goodness-of-fit metrics ($R^2$, RMSE in bar and Kelvin) and ready-to-run calibrated `.opi` / `.genkey` models.

## Native In-WASM Cubic Equation of State (PR78 & SRK)

ModelScript includes a native WebAssembly cubic equation of state solver executing directly in linear memory with zero intermediate AST wrapper overhead.

### Governing Thermodynamic Formulations

The general two-parameter cubic equation of state (EOS) relates pressure $P$, temperature $T$, and molar volume $v$ via attraction and co-volume parameters:

$$P = \frac{R T}{v - b} - \frac{a(T)}{v^2 + u b v + w b^2}$$

| Symbol    | Meaning                                                            | Units / Domain                                                   |
| :-------- | :----------------------------------------------------------------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------- |
| $P, T, v$ | Pressure, absolute temperature, and molar volume                   | $\text{Pa}$, $\text{K}$, $\text{m}^3/\text{mol}$                 |
| $R$       | Universal gas constant ($8.31446$)                                 | $\text{J}/(\text{mol}\cdot\text{K})$                             |
| $a(T), b$ | Temperature-dependent attraction parameter and co-volume parameter | $\text{Pa}\cdot\text{m}^6/\text{mol}^2$, $\text{m}^3/\text{mol}$ |
| $u, w$    | EOS-specific dimensionless constants                               | $\text{dimensionless}$                                           |

| EOS Model                     | $u$ | $w$  | $\Omega_a$ | $\Omega_b$ | Temperature Correction $\alpha(T_r, \omega)$                                                    |
| :---------------------------- | :-: | :--: | :--------: | :--------: | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Peng-Robinson (1978)**      | $2$ | $-1$ | $0.45724$  | $0.07780$  | $\left[ 1 + m (1 - \sqrt{T_r}) \right]^2$, with $m = 0.37464 + 1.54226\omega - 0.26992\omega^2$ |
| **Soave-Redlich-Kwong (SRK)** | $1$ | $0$  | $0.42748$  | $0.08664$  | $\left[ 1 + m (1 - \sqrt{T_r}) \right]^2$, with $m = 0.480 + 1.574\omega - 0.176\omega^2$       |

### Van der Waals Mixing Rules with Binary Interaction ($k_{ij}$)

For multicomponent reservoir and hydrocarbon fluids, mixture EOS parameters are aggregated from pure-component values using quadratic mixing for attraction and linear mixing for co-volume:

$$a = \sum_{i=1}^N \sum_{j=1}^N z_i z_j \sqrt{a_i a_j} (1 - k_{ij}), \quad b = \sum_{i=1}^N z_i b_i$$

| Symbol     | Meaning                                                     | Units / Domain                                                   |
| :--------- | :---------------------------------------------------------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------- |
| $a, b$     | Mixture attraction and co-volume parameters                 | $\text{Pa}\cdot\text{m}^6/\text{mol}^2$, $\text{m}^3/\text{mol}$ |
| $i, j, N$  | Component indices and total number of fluid components      | $\text{dimensionless}$ ($i, j = 1, \dots, N$)                    |
| $z_i, z_j$ | Overall feed mole fractions of components $i$ and $j$       | $\text{dimensionless}$ ($\sum z_i = 1$)                          |
| $a_i, b_i$ | Pure-component attraction and co-volume parameters          | $\text{Pa}\cdot\text{m}^6/\text{mol}^2$, $\text{m}^3/\text{mol}$ |
| $k_{ij}$   | Binary interaction parameter between components $i$ and $j$ | $\text{dimensionless}$                                           |

### Rachford-Rice Vapor-Liquid Equilibrium (VLE) Flash

Isothermal-isobaric flash equilibrium is determined by solving the objective function for vapor mole fraction $\beta = V/F$, enforcing equal fugacities across liquid and vapor phases:

$$\sum_{i=1}^N \frac{z_i (K_i - 1)}{1 + \beta (K_i - 1)} = 0, \quad \text{where } K_i = \frac{y_i}{x_i} = \frac{\phi_i^L}{\phi_i^V}$$

| Symbol               | Meaning                                                               | Units / Domain                               |
| :------------------- | :-------------------------------------------------------------------- | :------------------------------------------- |
| $z_i$                | Overall feed mole fraction of component $i$                           | $\text{dimensionless}$                       |
| $K_i$                | Equilibrium $K$-value (vapor-liquid partition ratio) of component $i$ | $\text{dimensionless}$ ($K_i > 0$)           |
| $\beta$              | Vapor mole fraction ($V/F$)                                           | $\text{dimensionless}$ ($0 \le \beta \le 1$) |
| $y_i, x_i$           | Vapor and liquid phase mole fractions of component $i$                | $\text{dimensionless}$                       |
| $\phi_i^L, \phi_i^V$ | Liquid and vapor phase fugacity coefficients of component $i$         | $\text{dimensionless}$                       |

Accelerated by successive substitution initialized via Wilson's heuristic $K$-value correlations and accelerated by Cardano analytical cubic root solving.

### Dense Fluid Transport Properties

- **Lohrenz-Bray-Clark (LBC) Viscosity:** Computes high-pressure gas and liquid dynamic viscosities from a 4th-order polynomial in reduced mixture density $\rho_r = \rho / \rho_c$:
  $$[(\mu - \mu_0)\xi + 10^{-4}]^{1/4} = a_0 + a_1 \rho_r + a_2 \rho_r^2 + a_3 \rho_r^3 + a_4 \rho_r^4$$
- **Macleod-Sugden Parachor Surface Tension:** Evaluates gas-liquid interfacial tension $\sigma$ from component parachors $P_i$ and phase molar densities:
  $$\sigma = \left[ \sum_{i=1}^N P_i \left( x_i \frac{\rho_L}{M_L} - y_i \frac{\rho_G}{M_G} \right) \right]^4$$

  | Symbol           | Meaning                                          | Units / Domain                                   |
  | :--------------- | :----------------------------------------------- | :----------------------------------------------- |
  | $\mu, \mu_0$     | Dense-fluid and dilute-gas dynamic viscosities   | $\text{cP}$ ($\text{mPa}\cdot\text{s}$)          |
  | $\xi$            | Viscosity-reducing parameter                     | $\text{cP}^{-1}$                                 |
  | $\rho_r$         | Reduced mixture density ($\rho / \rho_c$)        | $\text{dimensionless}$                           |
  | $a_0 \dots a_4$  | Empirical LBC polynomial coefficients            | $\text{dimensionless}$                           |
  | $\sigma$         | Gas-liquid interfacial surface tension           | $\text{mN/m}$ ($\text{dyn/cm}$)                  |
  | $P_i$            | Parachor constant of component $i$               | $(\text{mN/m})^{1/4}\cdot\text{cm}^3/\text{mol}$ |
  | $x_i, y_i$       | Liquid and vapor mole fractions of component $i$ | $\text{dimensionless}$                           |
  | $\rho_L, \rho_G$ | Liquid and gas mass densities                    | $\text{g/cm}^3$                                  |
  | $M_L, M_G$       | Liquid and gas average molar masses              | $\text{g/mol}$                                   |

### Command Line EOS Flash & Grid Synthesis

```bash
# Evaluate multi-component P-T flash and trace saturation envelope
msx olga flash --comp="C1:0.75,C2:0.10,C3:0.08,nC4:0.04,C7:0.03" \
  --p=55.0 --t=295.15 --model=pr --envelope --out=flash_summary.csv

# Synthesize a 2D tabular PVT file (.tab) for 1D drift-flux simulation
msx olga flash --comp="C1:0.80,C2:0.10,C3:0.06,C7:0.04" \
  --model=srk --out=reservoir_fluid.tab
```

## Active Topside Anti-Slug Closed-Loop Feedback Control

Topside choke throttling stabilizes severe cyclic slugging in deepwater catenary risers by dynamically manipulating backpressure using high-frequency subsea pressure transmitter measurements.

```mermaid
graph LR
    SubseaPT[Subsea PT_inlet] --> Washout[High-Pass Washout Filter: H_w]
    Washout --> Err[Error: e_f = P_sp - P_meas]
    Err --> PI[Gain-Scheduled PI Controller]
    TopsideSurge[Slug Catcher Volume] --> Override[High-Liquid Surge Override]
    PI --> Slew[Slew-Rate Limiter: |dZ/dt| <= R_max]
    Override --> Slew
    Slew --> TopsideChoke[Topside Choke Valve Z]
```

### Mathematical Architecture

1. **Subsea PT Feedback Error:** $e(t) = P_{\text{sp}} - P_{\text{inlet}}(t)$
2. **Washout High-Pass Filter:** Passes high-frequency slugging oscillations while attenuating slow reservoir pressure drift:
   $$\tau_w \frac{d e_f}{dt} + e_f = \tau_w \frac{d e}{dt}$$
3. **Gain-Scheduled PI Control:** Scales proportional gain with valve position $Z$ to compensate for non-linear choke valve flow characteristics, then drives the valve via proportional-integral feedback:
   $$K_p(Z) = K_{p0} \cdot [1 + \gamma (1 - Z)]$$
   $$Z(t) = Z_{\text{baseline}} + K_p(Z) \left[ e_f(t) + \frac{1}{\tau_i} \int_0^t e_f(\tau) d\tau \right]$$
4. **Physical Actuator Slew-Rate Constraints:** Clamps valve motion rate to realistic hydraulic actuator speeds:
   $$\left| \frac{dZ}{dt} \right| \le R_{\max} \quad (\text{e.g. } 5\% / \text{s})$$
5. **Slug Catcher Surge Override:** Emergency high-liquid override closes choke if topside separator approaches liquid carryover capacity ($V_{\text{surge}} > 0.8 V_{\text{cap}}$).

| Symbol                               | Meaning                                                     | Units / Domain                           |
| :----------------------------------- | :---------------------------------------------------------- | :--------------------------------------- |
| $e(t), e_f(t)$                       | Raw subsea pressure error and high-pass filtered error      | $\text{Pa}$ (or $\text{bar}$)            |
| $P_{\text{sp}}, P_{\text{inlet}}(t)$ | Subsea pressure setpoint and measured inlet pressure        | $\text{Pa}$ (or $\text{bar}$)            |
| $\tau_w, \tau_i$                     | Washout filter time constant and PI integral time constant  | $\text{s}$ ($\tau_w, \tau_i > 0$)        |
| $t, \tau$                            | Simulation time and integration variable                    | $\text{s}$                               |
| $K_p(Z), K_{p0}$                     | Valve-position-scheduled proportional gain and nominal gain | $\text{Pa}^{-1}$                         |
| $\gamma$                             | Gain-scheduling slope factor                                | $\text{dimensionless}$                   |
| $Z(t), Z_{\text{baseline}}$          | Topside choke valve opening fraction and baseline opening   | $\text{dimensionless}$ ($0 \le Z \le 1$) |
| $R_{\max}$                           | Maximum physical valve slew rate                            | $\text{s}^{-1}$                          |

### CLI Anti-Slug Simulation

```bash
msx olga simulate subsea_catenary_riser.opi \
  --duration=3600 \
  --anti-slug \
  --slug-setpoint=52.0 \
  --slug-kp=1.5e-6 \
  --slug-ti=30.0 \
  --slug-washout=20.0 \
  --slug-choke=0.50 \
  --out=stabilized_trajectory.csv
```

## Coupled Multi-Branch Gathering Network Transient Solver

Simultaneously models converging multi-well subsea gathering manifolds, shared export lines, and platform separators with dynamic acoustic relaxation:

```mermaid
graph LR
    Well1[Wellbore 1 / IPR] --> Flowline1[Flowpath 1: Seabed Tieback]
    Well2[Wellbore 2 / IPR] --> Flowline2[Flowpath 2: Seabed Tieback]
    Flowline1 --> Manifold((Subsea Manifold Accumulator: V_J))
    Flowline2 --> Manifold
    Manifold --> ExportRiser[Export Riser Line]
    ExportRiser --> TopsideSep[Topside Facility Separator]
```

### Governing Manifold Dynamic Balances

1. **Dynamic Junction Mass Continuity:** Balances liquid and gas holdup mass inside manifold accumulator volume $V_J$ against incoming and outgoing branch mass flow rates:
   $$V_J \frac{d(\rho_L \alpha_L)_J}{dt} = \sum_{\text{in}} \dot{m}_{L,\text{in}} - \sum_{\text{out}} \dot{m}_{L,\text{out}}$$
   $$V_J \frac{d(\rho_G \alpha_G)_J}{dt} = \sum_{\text{in}} \dot{m}_{G,\text{in}} - \sum_{\text{out}} \dot{m}_{G,\text{out}}$$
2. **Mixture Thermal Energy Accumulation:** Tracks total internal energy change inside the junction from advected stream enthalpies:
   $$\frac{d(m u)_J}{dt} = \sum_{\text{in}} (\dot{m}_{\text{in}} h_{\text{in}}) - \sum_{\text{out}} (\dot{m}_{\text{out}} h_J)$$
3. **Acoustic Pressure Relaxation:** Relates junction pressure rate of change to net mass imbalance via the multiphase mixture speed of sound $c_m$:
   $$\frac{dP_J}{dt} = \frac{c_m^2}{V_J} \left( \sum \dot{m}_{\text{in}} - \sum \dot{m}_{\text{out}} \right)$$

| Symbol                                          | Meaning                                                       | Units / Domain                                     |
| :---------------------------------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------ | :------------------------------------------------- |
| $V_J$                                           | Manifold junction accumulator volume                          | $\text{m}^3$ ($V_J > 0$)                           |
| $\rho_L, \rho_G$                                | Liquid and gas phase densities at junction $J$                | $\text{kg/m}^3$                                    |
| $\alpha_L, \alpha_G$                            | Liquid and gas volume fractions (holdups) at junction $J$     | $\text{dimensionless}$ ($\alpha_L + \alpha_G = 1$) |
| $\dot{m}_{L,\text{in}}, \dot{m}_{L,\text{out}}$ | Incoming and outgoing liquid mass flow rates                  | $\text{kg/s}$                                      |
| $\dot{m}_{G,\text{in}}, \dot{m}_{G,\text{out}}$ | Incoming and outgoing gas mass flow rates                     | $\text{kg/s}$                                      |
| $m, u$                                          | Total fluid mass and specific internal energy in junction $J$ | $\text{kg}$, $\text{J/kg}$                         |
| $\dot{m}_{\text{in}}, \dot{m}_{\text{out}}$     | Total incoming and outgoing mixture mass flow rates           | $\text{kg/s}$                                      |
| $h_{\text{in}}, h_J$                            | Specific enthalpy of incoming stream and junction mixture     | $\text{J/kg}$                                      |
| $P_J, c_m$                                      | Junction pressure and effective mixture speed of sound        | $\text{Pa}$, $\text{m/s}$                          |
| $t$                                             | Simulation time                                               | $\text{s}$                                         |

### Well Trip & Flowline Shut-In Redistribution

Tier: `beta` | Pass Rate: 100% (3/3) | Parse Latency: 0.10 ms (p95: 0.27 ms)

| Benchmark Case | Scale | Reference Oracle | Metric / Threshold | Measured | Status |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :---: |
| Canonical Fixture Parse | micro | ModelScript Native Parser | `ast-pass-rate <= 1` | `0` | PASS |
| Deepwater Tieback & Riser DAEBuilder Lowering (18 cells) | standard | SLB OLGA / 1D Two-Fluid Drift-Flux Flow Assurance | `dae-parity <= 0` | `0` | PASS |
| 1D Two-Fluid Drift-Flux 60s Transient Simulation | standard | SLB OLGA / 1D Two-Fluid Drift-Flux Flow Assurance | `exact <= 0` | `0` | PASS |

Reproduce: `npm run bench:languages -- --lang=olga`
