# MLXTRAN / Monolix-Compatible Pharmacometrics & PK/PD (`.mlxtran`)

`@modelscript/mlxtran` (`languages/mlxtran`) provides native WebAssembly GLR parsing, multi-compartment pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic (PK/PD) ODE and PK-macro solving ($\text{AUC}$, $C_{\max}$, $T_{\max}$, $t_{1/2}$), `DAEBuilder` linear-memory lowering, and **Modelica 3.x** projections for **Monolix MLXTRAN** longitudinal pharmacometric models.

---

## Supported Extensions & Standards

| Extension  | Format                   | Description                                                                                                             |
| :--------- | :----------------------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `.mlxtran` | MLXTRAN Structural Model | Monolix-compatible longitudinal model (`[LONGITUDINAL]`, `input = {...}`, `PK:`, `EQUATION:`, `ddt_<state>`, `OUTPUT:`) |

---

## Key Capabilities

### 1. Structural Sections, PK Macros & Differential Equations (`EQUATION:`)

`@modelscript/mlxtran` parses `[LONGITUDINAL]` blocks with `input = {...}` parameter declarations, `PK:` compartmental macro statements (`compartment`, `absorption`, `depot`, `elimination`, `transfer`), `EQUATION:` differential equations (`ddt_<state>`), and `OUTPUT:` declarations, modeling first-order oral absorption from a depot into central and peripheral compartments:

$$\frac{dA_d}{dt} = -k_a A_d, \qquad \frac{dA_c}{dt} = k_a A_d - \frac{CL}{V} A_c - \frac{Q}{V} A_c + \frac{Q}{V_2} A_p, \qquad \frac{dA_p}{dt} = \frac{Q}{V} A_c - \frac{Q}{V_2} A_p$$

| Symbol          | Meaning                                                     | Units / Domain                 |
| :-------------- | :---------------------------------------------------------- | :----------------------------- |
| $A_d, A_c, A_p$ | Drug amounts in depot, central, and peripheral compartments | $\text{mg}$ (or $\text{mass}$) |
| $t$             | Time                                                        | $\text{h}$ (or $\text{time}$)  |
| $k_a$           | First-order absorption rate constant                        | $\text{h}^{-1}$                |
| $CL$            | Systemic clearance from central compartment                 | $\text{L/h}$                   |
| $V, V_2$        | Central and peripheral compartment distribution volumes     | $\text{L}$                     |
| $Q$             | Inter-compartmental clearance                               | $\text{L/h}$                   |

### 2. Deterministic PK Simulation & Non-Compartmental Analysis (NCA)

- Integrates 1- and 2-compartment oral/IV dosing models (`solveMlxtranPk`) and computes trapezoidal exposure and elimination metrics from the central plasma concentration curve:
  $$\text{AUC}_{0\to t} = \int_0^t C_c(\tau)\,d\tau, \qquad C_{\max} = \max_t C_c(t), \qquad T_{\max} = \arg\max_t C_c(t), \qquad t_{1/2} = \frac{\ln 2}{k_{10}}$$

  | Symbol                | Meaning                                                                | Units / Domain             |
  | :-------------------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------------- | :------------------------- |
  | $\text{AUC}_{0\to t}$ | Area under the concentration-time curve from $0$ to $t$                | $\text{mg}\cdot\text{h/L}$ |
  | $C_c(t), \tau$        | Central compartment concentration at time $t$ and integration variable | $\text{mg/L}$, $\text{h}$  |
  | $C_{\max}$            | Peak observed plasma concentration                                     | $\text{mg/L}$              |
  | $T_{\max}$            | Time at which $C_{\max}$ occurs                                        | $\text{h}$                 |
  | $t_{1/2}$             | Terminal elimination half-life                                         | $\text{h}$                 |
  | $k_{10}$              | First-order elimination rate constant ($CL/V$)                         | $\text{h}^{-1}$            |

### 3. DAE Arena Lowering & Modelica Projection

- Lowers MLXTRAN parameters, compartmental transfers, and `ddt_*` ODEs directly into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder` arena (`lowerMlxtranToDae`) and projects models into **Modelica 3.x** (`mlxtranToModelica`).

---

| `M9423` | warning | `orphan-derivative` | Differential variable '<stateName>' has time derivative 'ddt_<stateName>' but is never referenced in outputs or transfers. |

| `M9426` | error | `duplicate-equation-definition` | Variable or derivative '<ident>' is defined multiple times in EQUATION block. |
| `M9427` | warning | `missing-output-definition` | Model defines differential equations but is missing an 'OUTPUT:' block. |
| `M9428` | error | `invalid-macro-target` | PK macro '<macroKind>' targets undefined compartment or state variable '<targetName>'. |
| `M9429` | error | `syntax-error` | MLXTRAN syntax error: <detail>. |
| `M9430` | error | `unbalanced-compartment-transfer` | Compartment transfer references invalid or identical compartment index ('from=<from>', 'to=<to>'). |

# PDB & mmCIF 3D Macromolecular Structure (`.pdb`, `.cif`, `.mmcif`)

`@modelscript/pdb` (`languages/pdb`) provides native WebAssembly GLR parsing, backbone Ramachandran $(\phi, \psi)$ dihedral angle and steric clash verification, radius of gyration ($R_g$) calculation, **Gaussian Network Model (GNM)** elastic normal-mode fluctuation analysis, `DAEBuilder` lowering, and OpenSCAD / Modelica projections for **Protein Data Bank (`.pdb`)** and **PDBx/mmCIF (`.cif`)** 3D macromolecular structures.

---

## Supported Extensions & Standards

| Extension        | Format            | Description                                                                                                       |
| :--------------- | :---------------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `.pdb`, `.ent`   | Legacy PDB Format | Fixed-column records (`HEADER`, `TITLE`, `SEQRES`, `HELIX`, `SHEET`, `SSBOND`, `ATOM`, `HETATM`, `CONECT`, `END`) |
| `.cif`, `.mmcif` | PDBx / mmCIF      | Macromolecular Crystallographic Information File (`data_`, `loop_`, `_atom_site.*`)                               |

---

## Governing Mathematical Formulation

### 1. Backbone Dihedral Angles $(\phi, \psi, \omega)$ & Radius of Gyration ($R_g$)

Given consecutive backbone atomic coordinates $\mathbf{r}_{\text{C}_{i-1}}, \mathbf{r}_{\text{N}_i}, \mathbf{r}_{\text{C}\alpha_i}, \mathbf{r}_{\text{C}_i}, \mathbf{r}_{\text{N}_{i+1}} \in \mathbb{R}^3$, bond vectors $\mathbf{b}_1, \mathbf{b}_2, \mathbf{b}_3$ define the peptide torsion angle via the four-quadrant normal projection:

$$
\theta(\mathbf{b}_1, \mathbf{b}_2, \mathbf{b}_3) = \operatorname{atan2}\!\left(
  \bigl((\mathbf{b}_1 \times \mathbf{b}_2) \times (\mathbf{b}_2 \times \mathbf{b}_3)\bigr) \cdot \frac{\mathbf{b}_2}{\|\mathbf{b}_2\|},\;
  (\mathbf{b}_1 \times \mathbf{b}_2) \cdot (\mathbf{b}_2 \times \mathbf{b}_3)
\right)
$$

This four-quadrant $\operatorname{atan2}$ projection computes the signed dihedral angle between the planes spanned by $(\mathbf{b}_1, \mathbf{b}_2)$ and $(\mathbf{b}_2, \mathbf{b}_3)$, yielding $\phi_i = \theta(\text{C}_{i-1}, \text{N}_i, \text{C}_{\alpha,i}, \text{C}_i)$ and $\psi_i = \theta(\text{N}_i, \text{C}_{\alpha,i}, \text{C}_i, \text{N}_{i+1})$. The mass-weighted center of mass $\mathbf{R}_{\text{cm}}$ and radius of gyration $R_g$ over $N$ atoms measure overall macromolecular compactness:

$$
\mathbf{R}_{\text{cm}} = \frac{\sum_{k=1}^N m_k \mathbf{r}_k}{\sum_{k=1}^N m_k}, \qquad R_g = \sqrt{\frac{\sum_{k=1}^N m_k \|\mathbf{r}_k - \mathbf{R}_{\text{cm}}\|^2}{\sum_{k=1}^N m_k}}
$$

| Symbol                                     | Meaning                                                                      | Units / Domain                             |
| :----------------------------------------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :----------------------------------------- |
| $\theta$                                   | Signed backbone dihedral (torsion) angle                                     | $\text{rad}$ (or $^\circ$), $[-\pi, \pi]$  |
| $\mathbf{b}_1, \mathbf{b}_2, \mathbf{b}_3$ | Consecutive backbone bond vectors                                            | $\text{\AA}$, $\mathbb{R}^3$               |
| $\mathbf{R}_{\text{cm}}$                   | Mass-weighted center-of-mass position                                        | $\text{\AA}$, $\mathbb{R}^3$               |
| $R_g$                                      | Radius of gyration (root-mean-square distance from $\mathbf{R}_{\text{cm}}$) | $\text{\AA}$, $\ge 0$                      |
| $N$                                        | Total number of atoms in the structure                                       | dimensionless, $\mathbb{Z}_{>0}$           |
| $m_k, \mathbf{r}_k$                        | Atomic mass and 3D coordinate vector of atom $k$                             | $\text{Da}$, $\text{\AA}$ ($\mathbb{R}^3$) |

### 2. Gaussian Network Model (GNM) & Crystallographic $B$-Factors

In the coarse-grained Tirion / Bahar **Gaussian Network Model (GNM)**, each residue is represented by its $\text{C}_\alpha$ node ($i = 1, \dots, n$) connected by uniform harmonic springs $\gamma$ within a cutoff radius $r_c = 7.0\text{ \AA}$. The $n \times n$ Kirchhoff contact matrix $\boldsymbol{\Gamma}$ encodes the residue contact topology (with diagonal entries equal to each node's coordination degree):

$$
\Gamma_{ij} = \begin{cases}
  -1 & \text{if } i \ne j \text{ and } \|\mathbf{r}_{\text{C}\alpha,i} - \mathbf{r}_{\text{C}\alpha,j}\| \le r_c, \\
  0  & \text{if } i \ne j \text{ and } \|\mathbf{r}_{\text{C}\alpha,i} - \mathbf{r}_{\text{C}\alpha,j}\| > r_c, \\
  -\sum_{k \ne i} \Gamma_{ik} & \text{if } i = j.
\end{cases}
$$

Using the Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse $\boldsymbol{\Gamma}^+$ (excluding the trivial zero translational eigenmode $\lambda_1 = 0$), theoretical equilibrium mean-square residue fluctuations and isotropic X-ray Debye-Waller $B$-factors relate structural flexibility directly to the inverse contact connectivity:

$$
\langle (\Delta \mathbf{R}_i)^2 \rangle = \frac{3 k_B T}{\gamma} \left[\boldsymbol{\Gamma}^+\right]_{ii}, \qquad B_i^{\text{calc}} = \frac{8 \pi^2}{3} \langle (\Delta \mathbf{R}_i)^2 \rangle
$$

| Symbol                                                         | Meaning                                                                           | Units / Domain                               |
| :------------------------------------------------------------- | :-------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :------------------------------------------- |
| $\Gamma_{ij}$                                                  | $(i, j)$ entry of the $n \times n$ Kirchhoff contact matrix $\boldsymbol{\Gamma}$ | dimensionless, $\mathbb{Z}$                  |
| $i, j, k$                                                      | Residue ($\text{C}_\alpha$ node) indices                                          | $1, \dots, n$                                |
| $\mathbf{r}_{\text{C}\alpha,i}, \mathbf{r}_{\text{C}\alpha,j}$ | 3D Cartesian coordinates of $\text{C}_\alpha$ atoms $i$ and $j$                   | $\text{\AA}$, $\mathbb{R}^3$                 |
| $r_c$                                                          | Spatial contact cutoff radius ($7.0\text{ \AA}$)                                  | $\text{\AA}$, $> 0$                          |
| $\langle (\Delta \mathbf{R}_i)^2 \rangle$                      | Equilibrium mean-square fluctuation of residue $i$                                | $\text{\AA}^2$, $\ge 0$                      |
| $k_B, T$                                                       | Boltzmann constant and absolute temperature                                       | $\text{kcal/(mol}\cdot\text{K)}$, $\text{K}$ |
| $\gamma$                                                       | Uniform harmonic spring force constant                                            | $\text{kcal/(mol}\cdot\text{\AA}^2)$, $> 0$  |
| $[\boldsymbol{\Gamma}^+]_{ii}$                                 | $i$-th diagonal entry of the Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse of $\boldsymbol{\Gamma}$ | dimensionless, $\ge 0$                       |
| $B_i^{\text{calc}}$                                            | Calculated isotropic Debye-Waller $B$-factor of residue $i$                       | $\text{\AA}^2$, $\ge 0$                      |

---

## `DAEBuilder` Arena Lowering & Cross-Language Projections

- **Direct `DAEBuilder` Lowering (`lowerPdbToDae`)**: Lowers the coarse-grained $\text{C}_\alpha$ elastic network $M_i \ddot{\mathbf{u}}_i + \eta \dot{\mathbf{u}}_i + \gamma \sum_j \Gamma_{ij} \mathbf{u}_j = \mathbf{0}$ into continuous state and derivative equations in `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder` arena.
- **OpenSCAD 3D CSG Projection (`pdbToScad`)**: Exports secondary-structure ribbons, $\text{C}_\alpha$ elastic contact networks, and ball-and-stick atomic spheres/cylinders to [OpenSCAD](./scad.md) (`.scad`).
- **Modelica Multibody Projection (`pdbToModelica`)**: Generates acausal harmonic spring-damper macromolecular models in [Modelica](./modelica.md).

---

# GenBank & FASTA Nucleotide Sequences (`.gb`, `.gbk`, `.fasta`, `.fa`)

`@modelscript/genbank` (`languages/genbank`) provides native WebAssembly GLR parsing, NCBI genetic code translation verification, 6-frame Open Reading Frame (ORF) discovery, restriction endonuclease digestion mapping, Codon Adaptation Index ($\text{CAI}$) calculation, `DAEBuilder` transcriptional/translational lowering, and SBOL3 / Modelica projections for **NCBI GenBank** and **FASTA** plasmid, viral, and genomic sequence files.

---

## Supported Extensions & Standards

| Extension                 | Format                 | Description                                                                                           |
| :------------------------ | :--------------------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `.gb`, `.gbk`, `.genbank` | NCBI GenBank Flat File | Annotated nucleotide sequence record (`LOCUS`, `DEFINITION`, `ACCESSION`, `FEATURES`, `ORIGIN`, `//`) |
| `.fasta`, `.fa`, `.fna`   | FASTA Sequence         | Multi-sequence nucleotide or peptide FASTA records (`>header`)                                        |

---

## Governing Mathematical Formulation

### 1. GC Content, Primer Melting Temperature ($T_m$) & Codon Adaptation Index ($\text{CAI}$)

Given a nucleotide sequence $S = s_1 s_2 \dots s_L \in \{\text{A}, \text{C}, \text{G}, \text{T/U}\}^L$, the GC fraction $f_{\text{GC}}$ measures the proportion of guanine and cytosine bases, and the salt-adjusted Marmur-Doty / SantaLucia melting temperature $T_m$ ($[\text{Na}^+] = 50\text{ mM}$) estimates the temperature at which half of the DNA duplex denatures:

$$
f_{\text{GC}} = \frac{N_{\text{G}} + N_{\text{C}}}{L}, \qquad
T_m = \begin{cases}
  2(N_{\text{A}} + N_{\text{T}}) + 4(N_{\text{G}} + N_{\text{C}}) & \text{if } L < 14, \\
  64.9 + 41.0 \left(\dfrac{N_{\text{G}} + N_{\text{C}} - 16.4}{L}\right) & \text{if } L \ge 14.
\end{cases}
$$

| Symbol                                                   | Meaning                                                             | Units / Domain                     |
| :------------------------------------------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------ | :--------------------------------- |
| $f_{\text{GC}}$                                          | Guanine-cytosine base fraction                                      | Dimensionless, $\in [0, 1]$        |
| $T_m$                                                    | DNA primer/oligonucleotide melting temperature                      | $^\circ\text{C}$                   |
| $L$                                                      | Total nucleotide sequence length                                    | $\text{nt}$ (positive integer)     |
| $N_{\text{A}}, N_{\text{T}}, N_{\text{G}}, N_{\text{C}}$ | Counts of adenine, thymine (or uracil), guanine, and cytosine bases | Non-negative integers ($\sum = L$) |

For a coding sequence (`CDS`) of $K$ sense codons $c_1, \dots, c_K$, Sharp & Li's **Codon Adaptation Index ($\text{CAI}$)** measures codon usage bias toward highly expressed host genes as the geometric mean of relative adaptiveness weights $w_k$:

$$
w_k = \frac{f(c_k)}{\max_{c \in \text{Syn}(a_k)} f(c)}, \qquad \text{CAI} = \left(\prod_{k=1}^K w_k\right)^{1/K} = \exp\!\left(\frac{1}{K} \sum_{k=1}^K \ln w_k\right) \in (0, 1]
$$

| Symbol            | Meaning                                                                 | Units / Domain              |
| :---------------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------------- | :-------------------------- |
| $w_k$             | Relative adaptiveness weight of codon $c_k$ at position $k$             | Dimensionless, $\in (0, 1]$ |
| $f(c_k)$          | Reference usage frequency of codon $c_k$ in highly expressed host genes | Dimensionless ($> 0$)       |
| $\text{Syn}(a_k)$ | Set of synonymous codons encoding amino acid $a_k$                      | Finite codon set            |
| $K$               | Number of sense codons in the `CDS`                                     | Positive integer            |
| $\text{CAI}$      | Codon Adaptation Index                                                  | Dimensionless, $\in (0, 1]$ |

### 2. Transcriptional & Translational Gene Expression ODEs

Each annotated `CDS` $i$ driven by an upstream `promoter` and ribosome binding site (`RBS`) is lowered into coupled mRNA ($m_i$) and protein ($p_i$) dynamical equations. In plain English, mRNA accumulates from leaky plus Hill-regulated transcription and decays by degradation, while protein is translated at a $\text{CAI}$-weighted rate from mRNA and decays by degradation and cell-growth dilution:

$$
\frac{dm_i}{dt} = \alpha_{0,i} + \alpha_i \frac{u_i^{n_i}}{K_i^{n_i} + u_i^{n_i}} - \gamma_{m,i}\, m_i, \qquad
\frac{dp_i}{dt} = k_{\text{tl},i}(\text{CAI}_i)\, m_i - (\gamma_{p,i} + \mu)\, p_i
$$

| Symbol                          | Meaning                                                          | Units / Domain                                                       |
| :------------------------------ | :--------------------------------------------------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| $m_i, p_i$                      | mRNA and protein concentrations for coding sequence $i$          | $\text{mol}\cdot\text{L}^{-1}$ or $\text{nM}$ ($\mathbb{R}_{\ge 0}$) |
| $t$                             | Simulation time                                                  | $\text{s}$ (or $\text{min}$), $t \ge 0$                              |
| $\alpha_{0,i}, \alpha_i$        | Basal (leaky) and maximal regulated transcription rates          | $\text{conc}\cdot\text{s}^{-1}$ ($\ge 0$)                            |
| $u_i$                           | Upstream transcription factor / regulator concentration          | $\text{conc}$ ($\ge 0$)                                              |
| $K_i, n_i$                      | Hill half-activation constant and Hill cooperativity coefficient | $\text{conc}$ ($> 0$), dimensionless ($> 0$)                         |
| $\gamma_{m,i}, \gamma_{p,i}$    | First-order mRNA and protein degradation rate constants          | $\text{s}^{-1}$ ($\ge 0$)                                            |
| $k_{\text{tl},i}(\text{CAI}_i)$ | $\text{CAI}_i$-scaled translation rate constant                  | $\text{s}^{-1}$ ($\ge 0$)                                            |
| $\mu$                           | Specific cell growth (dilution) rate                             | $\text{s}^{-1}$ ($\ge 0$)                                            |

---

## `DAEBuilder` Arena Lowering & Cross-Language Projections

- **Direct `DAEBuilder` Lowering (`lowerGenbankToDae`)**: Emits mRNA and protein concentrations, promoter Hill kinetics, and $\text{CAI}$-weighted translation rates directly into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder` arena.
- **SBOL3 Genetic Circuit Projection (`genbankToSbol`)**: Maps GenBank `FEATURES` (`promoter`, `RBS`, `CDS`, `terminator`, `rep_origin`) to Sequence Ontology (`SO:0000167`, `SO:0000139`, `SO:0000316`, `SO:0000141`) `SubComponent` hierarchies in [SBOL3](./sbol.md).
- **Modelica 3.x Projection (`genbankToModelica`)**: Generates synthetic biology ODE blocks in [Modelica](./modelica.md).

# CellML Cellular Electrophysiology & Physiome Modeling (`.cellml`)

`@modelscript/cellml` (`languages/cellml`) provides native WebAssembly parsing, 7-base SI dimensional unit consistency and component port directionality verification, Hodgkin-Huxley / cardiac action-potential and 0D microvascular Windkessel ODE integration, `DAEBuilder` lowering, and Modelica 3.x / SBML projections for **IUPS Physiome Project CellML (1.0 / 1.1 / 2.0)** physiological models.

---

## Supported Extensions & Standards

| Extension         | Format                 | Description                                                                                                          |
| :---------------- | :--------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `.cellml`, `.xml` | CellML 1.0 / 1.1 / 2.0 | Modular XML specification of `units`, `component`, `variable`, MathML `math` ODEs, `connection`, and `encapsulation` |

---

## Key Capabilities

### 1. Modular Components, Encapsulation & 7-Base SI Dimensional Vector Algebra

- Parses `<units>` definitions (`prefix`, `multiplier`, `exponent`, `offset`) and reduces every custom physiological unit (e.g., $\text{mV}$, $\mu\text{A}/\text{cm}^2$, $\text{mS}/\text{cm}^2$, $\text{mmHg}$, $\text{mM}$) to its canonical 7-base SI dimensional exponent vector $\mathbf{d} \in \mathbb{Q}^7$ and scalar scale factor $s$:
  $$\mathbf{d}(u) = \begin{bmatrix} d_{\text{m}} & d_{\text{kg}} & d_{\text{s}} & d_{\text{A}} & d_{\text{K}} & d_{\text{mol}} & d_{\text{cd}} \end{bmatrix}^\top$$
- Verifies dimensional homogeneity ($\mathbf{d}(v_1) = \mathbf{d}(v_2)$) across all `<map_variables>` connections and enforces `public_interface` / `private_interface` (`in` / `out` / `none`) encapsulation hierarchy rules so no variable is driven by multiple `in` ports simultaneously.

### 2. Cardiac Action Potential & Microvascular Hemodynamics Solver

- Integrates membrane transmembrane potential $V_m(t)$ and voltage-dependent Hodgkin-Huxley / Noble / ten Tusscher ionic channel gating states $y_i(t) \in \{m, h, j, n, d, f, x_{r1}, x_{r2}, x_s\}$:
  $$C_m \frac{dV_m}{dt} = -\left(I_{\text{Na}} + I_{\text{K1}} + I_{\text{Kr}} + I_{\text{Ks}} + I_{\text{CaL}} + I_{\text{leak}} - I_{\text{stim}}(t)\right)$$
  $$I_{\text{Na}} = \bar{g}_{\text{Na}} m^3 h j (V_m - E_{\text{Na}}), \qquad \frac{dy_i}{dt} = \alpha_{y_i}(V_m)(1 - y_i) - \beta_{y_i}(V_m)y_i = \frac{y_{i,\infty}(V_m) - y_i}{\tau_{y_i}(V_m)}$$
- Supports coupled 0D 3-element Windkessel arterial/venous hemodynamic compliance loops ($C_{\text{art}} \frac{dP_{\text{art}}}{dt} = Q_{\text{in}}(t) - \frac{P_{\text{art}} - P_{\text{ven}}}{R_{\text{periph}}}$).

### 3. DAE Arena Lowering & Modelica / SBML Projection

- Lowers modular CellML component networks and MathML differential/algebraic equations into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder` arena (`lowerCellmlToDae`) and projects models into **Modelica 3.x** (`cellmlToModelica`) and **SBML Level 3** (`cellmlToSbml`).

---

| `M9304` | warning | `cellml-unit-dimensional-mismatch` | Connected variables '<comp1>.<var1>' ('<units1>') and '<comp2>.<var2>' ('<units2>') have incompatible physical SI base dimensions. |
| `M9305` | warning | `cellml-uninitialized-state-variable` | Differential state variable '<varName>' in component '<compName>' has no 'initial_value' attribute. |

| `M9307` | error | `cellml-unresolved-connection-member` | Connection references unknown <memberKind> '<memberName>' in '<contextName>'. |

# NMODL / NEURON Ion-Channel & Membrane Kinetics (`.mod`)

`@modelscript/nmodl` (`languages/nmodl`) provides native WebAssembly GLR parsing, biophysical pre-flight static checks (`M9441`–`M9450`), deterministic Hodgkin-Huxley current-clamp action potential integration, `DAEBuilder` linear-memory lowering, and **Modelica 3.x** projections for **NEURON NMODL** ion-channel and synaptic mechanism descriptions.

---

## Supported Extensions & Standards

| Extension | Format          | Description                                                                                                                   |
| :-------- | :-------------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `.mod`    | NMODL Mechanism | NEURON Model Description Language (`NEURON`, `SUFFIX`, `USEION`, `PARAMETER`, `STATE`, `BREAKPOINT`, `DERIVATIVE`, `INITIAL`) |

---

## Key Capabilities

### 1. Biophysical Interface & Kinetic Block Analysis

`@modelscript/nmodl` parses `NEURON { SUFFIX ... USEION ... READ ... WRITE ... }` blocks, `PARAMETER` declarations with unit annotations, `STATE` gating variables, `INITIAL` conditions, `BREAKPOINT` ohmic/GHK current assignments, and `DERIVATIVE` gating ODEs, coupling ionic conductances into the membrane potential differential equation:

$$C_m \frac{dV_m}{dt} = I_{\text{stim}}(t) - \left[\bar{g}_{\text{Na}} m^3 h (V_m - E_{\text{Na}}) + \bar{g}_{\text{K}} n^4 (V_m - E_{\text{K}}) + g_L (V_m - E_L)\right]$$

| Symbol                                         | Meaning                                                                              | Units / Domain                                 |
| :--------------------------------------------- | :----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :--------------------------------------------- |
| $C_m$                                          | Specific membrane capacitance                                                        | $\mu\text{F/cm}^2$                             |
| $V_m, t$                                       | Membrane potential and time                                                          | $\text{mV}$, $\text{ms}$                       |
| $I_{\text{stim}}(t)$                           | External stimulus current density                                                    | $\mu\text{A/cm}^2$                             |
| $\bar{g}_{\text{Na}}, \bar{g}_{\text{K}}, g_L$ | Maximal sodium, potassium, and leak conductances                                     | $\text{S/cm}^2$                                |
| $m, h, n$                                      | Dimensionless voltage-gated activation ($m, n$) and inactivation ($h$) probabilities | $\text{dimensionless}$ ($0 \le m, h, n \le 1$) |
| $E_{\text{Na}}, E_{\text{K}}, E_L$             | Reversal (Nernst) potentials for sodium, potassium, and leak channels                | $\text{mV}$                                    |

### 2. Current-Clamp Action Potential Solver

- Integrates single-compartment soma membrane voltage $V_m(t)$ and voltage-gated channel states ($m, h, n$) under step current-clamp injection (`solveNmodlActionPotential`), reporting spike count, firing frequency, peak depolarization, and resting potential.

### 3. DAE Arena Lowering & Modelica Projection

- Lowers NMODL parameters, gating states, and `DERIVATIVE` / `BREAKPOINT` equations directly into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder` arena (`lowerNmodlToDae`) and projects mechanisms into **Modelica 3.x** (`nmodlToModelica`).

---

## Pre-Flight Diagnostics

### Diagnostics for NMODL (NEURON) (10 rules)
| Code | Severity | Identifier | Summary |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `M9441` | error | `missing-neuron-block` | NMODL file is missing the required 'NEURON { ... }' interface block. |
| `M9442` | error | `missing-suffix-declaration` | 'NEURON' block is missing the required 'SUFFIX' mechanism identifier. |
| `M9443` | error | `missing-derivative-evolution` | State variable '<stateName>' declared in 'STATE' block has no time-derivative equation in 'DERIVATIVE'. |
| `M9444` | error | `unassigned-write-current` | Ion current '<curName>' declared in 'USEION ... WRITE' is never computed in 'BREAKPOINT'. |
| `M9445` | error | `gating-probability-bounds` | Gating variable initial condition '<varName>' = <val> falls outside physical probability bounds [0, 1]. |
| `M9446` | warning | `reversal-potential-sign` | Reversal potential parameter '<paramName>' has unexpected polarity (<val> mV). |
| `M9447` | error | `missing-breakpoint-block` | Channel mechanism is missing the required 'BREAKPOINT' block. |
| `M9448` | error | `duplicate-block-declaration` | Section block '<blockName>' is declared multiple times. |
| `M9449` | error | `syntax-error` | NMODL syntax error: <detail>. |
| `M9450` | warning | `unbalanced-units-bracket` | Parameter declaration '<paramName>' has unbalanced unit parentheses or brackets. |

---

## CLI Usage

```bash
# Lint an NMODL channel mechanism for missing SUFFIX/BREAKPOINT, unassigned currents, and gating bounds
msx lint hh_sodium.mod

# Parse and inspect the NMODL concrete syntax tree
msx parse hh_sodium.mod

# Run domain inspection and action-potential simulation via the unified domain router
msx domain nmodl inspect hh_sodium.mod
msx domain nmodl simulate hh_sodium.mod
```

---

## Programmatic TypeScript SDK

```typescript
import { parseNmodl, lintNmodl, solveNmodlActionPotential, lowerNmodlToDae, nmodlToModelica } from "@modelscript/nmodl";
import { DAEBuilder } from "@modelscript/runtime";

const doc = parseNmodl(nmodlSource);
const diagnostics = lintNmodl(doc);
const sim = solveNmodlActionPotential(doc, { tEnd: 50, dt: 0.025, stimAmp: 10 });

const builder = new DAEBuilder();
lowerNmodlToDae(doc, builder);
const modelicaCode = nmodlToModelica(doc);
```

# OpenSim Musculoskeletal Biomechanics (`.osim`)

`@modelscript/opensim` (`languages/opensim`) provides native WebAssembly parsing, musculoskeletal kinematic tree and mass/inertia validation, **Hill-type muscle-tendon activation and contraction dynamics** (`Thelen2003Muscle`, `Millard2012EquilibriumMuscle`), `DAEBuilder` lowering, and Modelica 3.x / ROS URDF projections for **OpenSim** biomechanical and orthopedic surgical planning models.

---

## Supported Extensions & Standards

| Extension | Format           | Description                                                                                                                              |
| :-------- | :--------------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `.osim`   | OpenSim Document | XML specification of `BodySet`, `JointSet`, `ForceSet` (Hill muscles, ligaments, coordinate actuators), `MarkerSet`, and `WrapObjectSet` |

---

## Key Capabilities

### 1. Multibody Skeletal Kinematics, Inertia & Wrapping Surfaces

- Parses `OpenSimDocument` (versions 3.x & 4.x) including rigid body segments (`Body` with mass $m_b > 0$ and 6-component inertia tensor $\mathbf{I}_b \succ 0$ satisfying triangle inequalities $I_{xx} + I_{yy} \ge I_{zz}$), anatomical joints (`PinJoint`, `SliderJoint`, `CustomJoint`, `WeldJoint`, `FreeJoint`, `BallJoint`, `UniversalJoint`), generalized coordinates (`Coordinate` with range-of-motion bounds $[q_{\min}, q_{\max}]$), motion-capture fiducial markers (`MarkerSet`), and muscle wrapping surfaces (`WrapCylinder`, `WrapSphere`, `WrapEllipsoid`).
- Formulates the articulated skeletal equations of motion driven by muscle-tendon forces $\mathbf{F}^T$ mapped through the moment-arm matrix $\mathbf{R}(\mathbf{q})$:
  $$\mathbf{M}(\mathbf{q})\ddot{\mathbf{q}} + \mathbf{C}(\mathbf{q}, \dot{\mathbf{q}})\dot{\mathbf{q}} + \mathbf{G}(\mathbf{q}) = \mathbf{R}(\mathbf{q}) \, \mathbf{F}^T + \boldsymbol{\tau}_{\text{ext}}$$

### 2. Hill-Type Muscle-Tendon Activation & Contraction Solver

For every `Thelen2003Muscle` or `Millard2012EquilibriumMuscle` actuator, `@modelscript/opensim` integrates first-order neural excitation-to-activation dynamics ($u(t) \in [0, 1] \to a(t) \in [a_{\min}, 1]$) with asymmetric activation/deactivation time constants ($\tau_{\text{act}} \approx 10\text{ ms}$, $\tau_{\text{deact}} \approx 40\text{ ms}$):

$$\frac{da}{dt} = \frac{u - a}{\tau(a, u)}, \qquad \tau(a, u) = \begin{cases} \tau_{\text{act}}(0.5 + 1.5a) & u > a \\ \dfrac{\tau_{\text{deact}}}{0.5 + 1.5a} & u \le a \end{cases}$$

coupled with active force-length $f_L(\tilde{l}^M)$, concentric/eccentric force-velocity $f_V(\tilde{v}^M)$, passive parallel elastic $f_{PE}(\tilde{l}^M)$, and pennation angle $\alpha(\tilde{l}^M)$ tendon force equilibrium over total muscle-tendon path length $l^{MT} = l^M \cos\alpha + l^T$:

$$F^T = F_0^M \left(a \, f_L(\tilde{l}^M) f_V(\tilde{v}^M) + f_{PE}(\tilde{l}^M)\right)\cos\alpha = F_0^M \, f_{SE}(\tilde{l}^T)$$

### 3. DAE Lowering & Modelica / URDF Projection

- **`DAEBuilder` Linear Memory Lowering**: Emits generalized coordinates $(q_i, \omega_i)$, muscle activation states $a_m(t)$, normalized fiber lengths $\tilde{l}_m^M(t)$, and Hill-type force balance equations directly into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder` arena (`lowerOpenSimToDae`).
- **Modelica 3.x & ROS 2 URDF Export**: Projects musculoskeletal models into **Modelica** (`openSimToModelica`) and **ROS 2 URDF** (`openSimToUrdf`) for prosthetic/exoskeleton co-simulation.

---

## Pre-Flight Diagnostics

### Diagnostics for OpenSim (10 rules)
| Code | Severity | Identifier | Summary |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `M9101` | error | `opensim-unresolved-body-frame` | <componentKind> '<componentName>' references undefined body frame '<frameName>'. |
| `M9102` | error | `opensim-non-positive-body-mass` | Body '<bodyName>' specifies invalid mass or principal inertia (<detail>). |
| `M9103` | error | `opensim-kinematic-tree-cycle` | Kinematic tree topology error at joint '<jointName>': <detail>. |
| `M9104` | error | `opensim-invalid-coordinate-range` | Coordinate '<coordName>' has invalid range ['<rangeMin>', '<rangeMax>'] or default value '<defaultValue>' outside range. |
| `M9105` | error | `opensim-invalid-muscle-parameters` | Muscle '<muscleName>' has non-positive Hill parameter (<detail>). |
| `M9106` | error | `opensim-excessive-pennation-angle` | Muscle '<muscleName>' has invalid pennation angle '<angleRad>' rad (must be in [0, pi/2)). |
| `M9107` | error | `opensim-insufficient-muscle-path-points` | Muscle '<muscleName>' has invalid geometry path (<detail>). |
| `M9108` | error | `opensim-unresolved-wrap-object` | Muscle '<muscleName>' references undefined WrapObject '<wrapName>'. |
| `M9109` | warning | `opensim-invalid-time-constants` | Muscle '<muscleName>' has invalid activation/deactivation time constants (tau_act='<tauAct>', tau_deact='<tauDeact>'). |
| `M9110` | error | `opensim-duplicate-component-name` | Duplicate <componentKind> name '<name>' declared in OpenSim model. |

---

## CLI Usage

```bash
# Inspect bodies, joints, muscles, and markers in an OpenSim model
msx opensim inspect Arm26.osim

# Validate mass/inertia positivity, kinematic cycles, and Hill muscle parameters
msx opensim validate Arm26.osim

# Simulate Hill-type muscle activation and joint trajectories
msx opensim simulate Arm26.osim

# Project OpenSim model to Modelica 3.x, ROS URDF, or DAE arena
msx opensim to-modelica Arm26.osim > Arm26.mo
msx opensim to-urdf Arm26.osim > Arm26.urdf
msx opensim to-dae Arm26.osim
```

---

## Programmatic TypeScript SDK

```typescript
import {
  parseOpenSimModel,
  simulateHillMuscleDynamics,
  lowerOpenSimToDae,
  openSimToModelica,
  openSimToUrdf,
} from "@modelscript/opensim";
import { DAEBuilder } from "@modelscript/runtime";

const model = parseOpenSimModel(osimXmlSource);
const sim = simulateHillMuscleDynamics(model, 1.0, 0.005);

const builder = new DAEBuilder();
lowerOpenSimToDae(model, builder);
const modelicaCode = openSimToModelica(model);
const urdfXml = openSimToUrdf(model);
```

# FEBio & SOFA Soft-Tissue Biomechanics (`.feb`, `.scn`)

`@modelscript/febio` (`languages/febio`) provides native WebAssembly parsing, hyperelastic and biphasic poroelastic material stability verification, element Jacobian volume positivity checking, non-linear strain-energy and Cauchy stress evaluation, `DAEBuilder` lowering, and CalculiX `.inp` / Modelica projections for **FEBio (`febio_spec` 3.0 / 4.0)** soft-tissue biomechanics and **SOFA Framework (`.scn`)** real-time surgical simulation scenes.

---

## Supported Extensions & Standards

| Extension | Format              | Description                                                                                                          |
| :-------- | :------------------ | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `.feb`    | FEBio Specification | XML specification of `Material`, `Mesh` / `Geometry`, `Boundary`, `Loads`, `Contact`, and `Step` blocks              |
| `.scn`    | SOFA Scene Graph    | Simulation Open Framework Architecture (`Node`, `MechanicalObject`, `TetrahedronFEMForceField`, `CollisionPipeline`) |

---

## Key Capabilities

### 1. Hyperelastic, Viscoelastic & Biphasic Constitutive Models

`@modelscript/febio` parses and evaluates soft-tissue strain energy density functions $W(\mathbf{C})$ over the right Cauchy-Green deformation tensor $\mathbf{C} = \mathbf{F}^\top \mathbf{F}$, principal stretches $(\lambda_1, \lambda_2, \lambda_3)$, and volume ratio $J = \det \mathbf{F} = \lambda_1 \lambda_2 \lambda_3$:

| Constitutive Law        | Strain Energy Density $W(\lambda_1, \lambda_2, \lambda_3, J)$                                                                                                               | Stability & Physical Constraints                                              |
| :---------------------- | :-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Neo-Hookean**         | $W = \frac{\mu}{2}(I_1 - 3) - \mu \ln J + \frac{\lambda}{2}(\ln J)^2$                                                                                                       | $\mu > 0, \quad K = \lambda + \frac{2}{3}\mu > 0$                             |
| **Mooney-Rivlin**       | $W = C_1(\tilde{I}_1 - 3) + C_2(\tilde{I}_2 - 3) + \frac{K}{2}(\ln J)^2$                                                                                                    | $C_1 + C_2 > 0, \quad K > 0$                                                  |
| **Ogden ($N$-term)**    | $W = \sum_{p=1}^N \frac{\mu_p}{\alpha_p}\left(\tilde{\lambda}_1^{\alpha_p} + \tilde{\lambda}_2^{\alpha_p} + \tilde{\lambda}_3^{\alpha_p} - 3\right) + \frac{K}{2}(J - 1)^2$ | **Drucker stability**: $\sum_{p=1}^N \mu_p \alpha_p > 0$                      |
| **Holmes-Mow Biphasic** | $W_s(I_1, I_2, J) + \text{Darcy interstitial fluid flux } \mathbf{w} = -k(J) \nabla p$                                                                                      | Hydraulic permeability $k_0 > 0$, solid volume fraction $\phi_0^s \in (0, 1)$ |

### 2. Cauchy Stress Solver & Mesh Jacobian Verification

- Evaluates principal Cauchy stresses $\sigma_i = \frac{\lambda_i}{J} \frac{\partial W}{\partial \lambda_i}$ and verifies **3D tetrahedral/hexahedral element orientation** ($\det \mathbf{J}_e > 0$) across all mesh elements to prevent inverted or zero-volume elements prior to non-linear Newton-Raphson equilibrium iterations:
  $$\det \mathbf{J}_{\text{tet}} = \det \begin{bmatrix} \mathbf{x}_2 - \mathbf{x}_1 & \mathbf{x}_3 - \mathbf{x}_1 & \mathbf{x}_4 - \mathbf{x}_1 \end{bmatrix} > 0$$

### 3. CalculiX FEA, Modelica & DAE Lowering

- **CalculiX / Abaqus `.inp` & Modelica Export**: Projects FEBio meshes, node/element sets, boundary conditions, and hyperelastic material cards directly into **CalculiX- / Abaqus-compatible `.inp`** decks (`febioToCalculixInp`) and **Modelica 3.x** Kelvin-Voigt viscoelastic compliance models (`febioToModelica`).
- **`DAEBuilder` Arena Lowering**: Lowers lumped viscoelastic deformation and biphasic interstitial pore-pressure relaxation ODEs into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder` arena (`lowerFebioToDae`).

---

## Pre-Flight Diagnostics

| `M9403` | error | `febio-unresolved-node-or-set` | Unresolved <refKind> reference '<refId>' in '<contextName>'. |
| `M9404` | warning | `febio-unconstrained-rigid-body` | Model '<modelTitle>' has no fixed or prescribed displacement boundary conditions to prevent rigid-body motion. |
| `M9405` | error | `febio-invalid-biphasic-permeability` | Invalid biphasic/poroelastic parameter (<reason>) in material '<materialName>'. |
| `M9406` | error | `febio-invalid-time-stepper` | Invalid <Control> time-stepper configuration: time_steps='<timeSteps>', step_size='<stepSize>' (both must be > 0). |
| `M9407` | error | `febio-unresolved-material-id` | Unresolved material ID '<matId>' referenced in '<contextName>'. |
| `M9408` | error | `febio-contact-penalty-invalid` | Contact interface '<contactName>' has invalid configuration: <detail>. |
| `M9409` | error | `febio-sofa-missing-mechanical-object` | SOFA <Node> '<nodeName>' contains '<<forceFieldType>>' without a '<MechanicalObject>' state container. |
| `M9410` | error | `febio-duplicate-entity-id` | Duplicate <entityKind> identifier '<id>'. |

---

## CLI Usage

```bash
# Inspect FEBio materials, mesh nodes/elements, and boundary conditions
msx febio inspect LiverHyperelastic.feb

# Validate Drucker hyperelastic stability and element Jacobian determinants
msx febio validate LiverHyperelastic.feb

# Solve hyperelastic strain energy and Cauchy stress response
msx febio solve LiverHyperelastic.feb

# Project FEBio mesh and materials to CalculiX- / Abaqus-compatible .inp, Modelica, or DAE
msx febio to-inp LiverHyperelastic.feb > LiverHyperelastic.inp
msx febio to-modelica LiverHyperelastic.feb > LiverHyperelastic.mo
msx febio to-dae LiverHyperelastic.feb
```

## Programmatic TypeScript SDK

```typescript
import {
  parseFebioModel,
  solveHyperelasticMechanics,
  lowerFebioToDae,
  febioToCalculixInp,
  febioToModelica,
} from "@modelscript/febio";
import { DAEBuilder } from "@modelscript/runtime";

const model = parseFebioModel(febXmlSource);
const mechanics = solveHyperelasticMechanics(model, 1.25); // 25% uniaxial stretch

const builder = new DAEBuilder();
lowerFebioToDae(model, builder);
const calculixInp = febioToCalculixInp(model);
const modelicaCode = febioToModelica(model);
```

# DICOM-RT Radiation Oncology & Clinical Dosimetry (`.rtplan`, `.rtstruct`, `.rtdose`)

`@modelscript/dicom-rt` (`languages/dicom-rt`) provides native WebAssembly parsing, **QUANTEC Organ-at-Risk (OAR)** dose constraint and Multi-Leaf Collimator (MLC) leaf/gantry kinematics verification, cumulative and differential **Dose-Volume Histogram (DVH)** integration, Linear-Quadratic **BED / EQD2** biological dose calculation, `DAEBuilder` lowering, and OpenSCAD / SysML v2 projections for **DICOM Radiotherapy (`RTPLAN`, `RTSTRUCT`, `RTDOSE`)** treatment plans.

---

## Supported Extensions & Standards

| Extension   | Format                 | Description                                                                                                                 |
| :---------- | :--------------------- | :-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `.rtplan`   | DICOM RT Plan          | External-beam photon/electron/proton beam geometry, gantry/couch/collimator angles, MLC control points, and fraction groups |
| `.rtstruct` | DICOM RT Structure Set | 3D anatomical contours for Planning Target Volumes (`PTV`, `CTV`, `GTV`) and Organs at Risk (`OAR`)                         |
| `.rtdose`   | DICOM RT Dose          | 3D dose grid arrays and cumulative/differential Dose-Volume Histogram (`DVH`) curves                                        |

---

## Key Capabilities

### 1. Cumulative DVH, ICRU 83 Homogeneity & Paddick Conformity

`@modelscript/dicom-rt` integrates differential and cumulative Dose-Volume Histograms $V(D)$ across every Planning Target Volume (`PTV`) and Organ at Risk (`OAR`) to extract near-minimum dose $D_{98\%}$, prescription coverage $D_{95\%}$, median dose $D_{50\%}$, near-maximum hot-spot dose $D_{2\%}$, mean dose $D_{\text{mean}}$, and volume-at-dose $V_{x\text{Gy}}$:

$$\text{HI}_{\text{ICRU 83}} = \frac{D_{2\%} - D_{98\%}}{D_{50\%}}, \qquad \text{CI}_{\text{RTOG}} = \frac{PIV}{TV}, \qquad \text{CI}_{\text{Paddick}} = \frac{(TV_{\text{PIV}})^2}{TV \times PIV}$$

where $TV$ is the target volume, $PIV$ is the prescription isodose volume, and $TV_{\text{PIV}}$ is the target volume covered by the prescription isodose.

### 2. Linear-Quadratic Biological Dose ($\text{BED}$ & $\text{EQD2}$)

For a fractionation schedule of $n$ fractions at dose $d = D_{\text{total}}/n$ per fraction, `@modelscript/dicom-rt` evaluates the Linear-Quadratic (LQ) **Biologically Effective Dose ($\text{BED}$)** and **Equivalent Dose in $2\text{ Gy}$ Fractions ($\text{EQD2}$)**:

$$\text{BED} = n d \left(1 + \frac{d}{\alpha/\beta}\right), \qquad \text{EQD2} = \frac{\text{BED}}{1 + \frac{2}{\alpha/\beta}} = n d \left(\frac{d + \alpha/\beta}{2 + \alpha/\beta}\right)$$

using tissue-specific radiosensitivity ratios ($\alpha/\beta \approx 10\text{ Gy}$ for early-responding tumor targets, $\alpha/\beta \approx 2\text{ Gy}$ for late-responding CNS/spinal cord/optic pathways, and $\alpha/\beta \approx 3\text{ Gy}$ for lung, heart, rectum, and bladder).

### 3. QUANTEC Clinical OAR Constraints & MLC Delivery Kinematics

| Organ at Risk (`OAR`) | QUANTEC Metric                        | Clinical Threshold              | Endpoint Guarded                      |
| :-------------------- | :------------------------------------ | :------------------------------ | :------------------------------------ |
| Spinal Cord           | $D_{\max}$ ($D_{0.03\text{cc}}$)      | $\le 50\text{ Gy}$              | Radiation myelopathy ($< 0.2\%$ risk) |
| Brainstem             | $D_{\max}$                            | $\le 54\text{ Gy}$              | Cranial neuropathy / necrosis         |
| Optic Chiasm / Nerves | $D_{\max}$                            | $\le 55\text{ Gy}$              | Radiation-induced optic neuropathy    |
| Parotid Glands        | $D_{\text{mean}}$                     | $\le 25\text{ Gy}$              | Severe long-term xerostomia           |
| Bilateral Lungs       | $V_{20\text{Gy}}$ / $D_{\text{mean}}$ | $\le 30\%$ / $\le 20\text{ Gy}$ | Symptomatic radiation pneumonitis     |
| Heart / Pericardium   | $D_{\text{mean}}$                     | $\le 26\text{ Gy}$              | Pericarditis & late cardiac toxicity  |

Alongside dosimetric checks, `@modelscript/dicom-rt` audits Multi-Leaf Collimator (`MLCX`/`MLCY`) control points for leaf bank collisions ($x_{\text{B},i} - x_{\text{A},i} \ge \Delta_{\min}$), carriage overtravel, monotonic cumulative meterset weights ($w_0 = 0 \le w_k \le w_N = 1$), and non-coplanar gantry-couch collision clearance.

### 4. OpenSCAD, SysML v2 & DAE Projections

- Projects beam apertures and ROI structures into **OpenSCAD** 3D collimator blocks (`dicomRtToScad`), **OMG SysML v2** clinical safety requirement verification packages (`dicomRtToSysML2`), and `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder` arena (`lowerDicomRtToDae`).

---

## Pre-Flight Diagnostics

### Diagnostics for DICOM-RT (10 rules)
| Code | Severity | Identifier | Summary |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `M9201` | error | `dicom-rt-missing-target-volume` | Treatment plan '<planLabel>' contains no clinical target volume ROI ('PTV', 'CTV', or 'GTV'). |
| `M9202` | error | `dicom-rt-mlc-leaf-overlap` | MLC leaf pair '<pairIndex>' on beam '<beamName>' control point '<cpIndex>' has bankA='<bankA> mm', bankB='<bankB> mm' (gap '<value> mm' < minimum '<MIN_MLC_LEAF_GAP_MM> mm'). |
| `M9203` | error | `dicom-rt-mlc-speed-exceeded` | MLC leaf pair '<pairIndex>' on beam '<beamName>' between control points '<cpFrom>' and '<cpTo>' travels at '<value> mm/s', exceeding physical motor limit '<value> mm/s'. |
| `M9204` | error | `dicom-rt-gantry-couch-collision` | Gantry angle '<gantryDeg> deg' and non-coplanar couch angle '<couchDeg> deg' on beam '<beamName>' control point '<cpIndex>' enter the gantry-couch collision hazard zone. |
| `M9205` | error | `dicom-rt-oar-dose-constraint-violated` | Organ-at-Risk '<roiName>' <metricKind> dose '<value> Gy' exceeds QUANTEC clinical constraint '<value> Gy'. |
| `M9206` | error | `dicom-rt-non-monotonic-cum-meterset` | Control point cumulativeMetersetWeight sequence on beam '<beamName>' is invalid: <detail>. |

| `M9208` | error | `dicom-rt-unresolved-frame-of-reference` | <modalitySource> FrameOfReferenceUID '<sourceUid>' does not match plan FrameOfReferenceUID '<planUid>'. |
| `M9209` | error | `dicom-rt-invalid-beam-meterset` | TREATMENT beam '<beamName>' has invalid delivery parameters (metersetMu='<metersetMu>', energyMeV='<energyMeV>'); both must be > 0. |
| `M9210` | warning | `dicom-rt-ptv-underdosage` | Target volume '<roiName>' D95% '<value> Gy' is below 95% of prescribed dose '<value> Gy' (minimum '<value> Gy'). |

# TOPAS & GATE Proton & Hadrontherapy Monte Carlo (`.topas`, `.mac`)

`@modelscript/topas` (`languages/topas`) provides native WebAssembly GLR parsing, Geant4 geometry hierarchy and parent-child bounding-box containment verification, **Bortfeld (1997) analytical Bragg peak depth-dose** and Spread-Out Bragg Peak (SOBP) evaluation, `DAEBuilder` lowering, and OpenSCAD / Modelica projections for **TOPAS (Tool for Particle Simulation)** and **GATE** proton, carbon-ion, and flash radiotherapy beamline configurations.

---

## Supported Extensions & Standards

| Extension        | Format               | Description                                                                                                                                             |
| :--------------- | :------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `.topas`, `.txt` | TOPAS Parameter File | Typed Geant4 parameter system (`s:` string, `d:` double with units, `i:` integer, `b:` boolean, `dv:`/`sv:` vectors) for `Ge/`, `So/`, `Sc/`, and `Ph/` |
| `.mac`           | GATE / Geant4 Macro  | Command-stream macro (`/gate/world/daughters/...`, `/gate/source/...`, `/gate/actor/...`) for medical physics Monte Carlo                               |

---

## Key Capabilities

### 1. Typed Geometry (`Ge/`), Beam Sources (`So/`) & Dose Scorers (`Sc/`)

- Parses hierarchical Geant4 CSG beamline components (`TsBox`, `TsCylinder`, `TsSphere`, `TsRangeModulator`, `TsPropeller`, `TsMultiLeafCollimator`, `TsAperture`, water phantoms, and patient CT volumes), particle sources (`Proton`, `Carbon12`, `Electron`, `Photon`), physics lists (`Ph/Default/Modules`), and `DoseToMedium` / `LETd` / `Fluence` scorers.
- Verifies parent-child spatial containment so every child component bounding box $[x_c \pm \Delta x_c, y_c \pm \Delta y_c, z_c \pm \Delta z_c]$ lies strictly inside its parent volume `Ge/<Comp>/Parent` without geometric overlap.

### 2. Analytical Bortfeld (1997) Bragg Peak & Range Calculation

`@modelscript/topas` evaluates the **Bragg-Kleeman range-energy relation** and **Bortfeld's (1997)** analytical depth-dose equation for proton and heavy-ion beams in water/tissue:

$$R_0 = \alpha \, E_0^p, \qquad \sigma_{\text{mono}}^2 = \alpha_{\sigma} R_0^{3 - 2/p}, \qquad \sigma^2 = \sigma_{\text{mono}}^2 + \sigma_E^2 \left(\alpha p E_0^{p-1}\right)^2$$

where $\alpha \approx 0.0022\text{ cm}\cdot\text{MeV}^{-p}$ and $p \approx 1.77$ for protons in water ($\rho = 1.0\text{ g/cm}^3$). Along depth $z$, the absorbed dose $D(z)$ is computed from the Gaussian range-straggling variable $\zeta = (R_0 - z)/\sigma$, computing:

- Continuous-slowing-down range $R_0$ ($\text{mm}$),
- Distal $80\%$ dose falloff depth $R_{80}$ and $90\%\text{–}10\%$ distal penumbra,
- Entrance-to-Bragg-peak dose ratio and dose-averaged Linear Energy Transfer ($\text{LET}_d$).

### 3. 3D Nozzle CSG, Modelica & DAE Lowering

- **OpenSCAD 3D Nozzle CSG (`topasToScad`)**: Projects treatment nozzle collimators, range modulators, ionization chambers, and water phantoms into parameterized 3D OpenSCAD CSG assemblies.
- **Modelica & `DAEBuilder` Lowering**: Projects beamline energy-degradation and target heating dynamics into **Modelica 3.x** (`topasToModelica`) and `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder` arena (`lowerTopasToDae`).

---

## Pre-Flight Diagnostics

### Diagnostics for TOPAS / GATE (10 rules)

| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `M9601` | error | `topas-type-prefix-mismatch` | Parameter '<fullPath>' value '<rawVal>' does not match declared TOPAS type prefix '<typePrefix>:'. |
| `M9602` | error | `topas-unresolved-parent-component` | Geometry component '<compName>' references undeclared parent volume '<parentName>'. |
| `M9603` | error | `topas-non-positive-geometry-dimension` | Geometry component '<compName>' has invalid dimension: <detail>. |
| `M9604` | error | `topas-child-exceeds-parent-bounds` | Child geometry '<childName>' protrudes outside parent '<parentName>' along <axis>-axis ('<childExtent> mm' > '<parentHalfExtent> mm'). |
| `M9605` | error | `topas-undefined-material` | Component '<compName>' references unknown material '<materialName>' not found in Geant4/NIST materials or custom 'Ma/' definitions. |
| `M9606` | error | `topas-invalid-beam-energy` | Particle source '<sourceName>' has invalid beam energy specification: <detail>. |
| `M9607` | error | `topas-circular-include-file` | Circular or self-referential includeFile chain detected: '<cycleChain>'. |
| `M9608` | error | `topas-scorer-missing-component` | Scorer '<scorerName>' has invalid configuration: <detail>. |
| `M9609` | error | `topas-vector-length-mismatch` | Vector parameter '<fullPath>' declares length '<declaredCount>' but provides '<actualCount>' elements. |
| `M9610` | warning | `topas-duplicate-parameter-assignment` | Parameter '<fullPath>' is assigned multiple times in the same file without 'change' override prefix. |

# NIfTI & NRRD Volumetric Medical Imaging (`.nii`, `.nrrd`, `.nhdr`)

`@modelscript/nifti` (`languages/nifti`) provides native WebAssembly parsing, $4 \times 4$ `qform` quaternion and `sform` affine **Right-Anterior-Superior (RAS)** coordinate transformation validation, anatomical segmentation labelmap volume calculation, **Marching Tetrahedra** 3D iso-surface mesh extraction, `DAEBuilder` lowering, and ISO 10303-21 STEP / OpenSCAD projections for **NIfTI-1 / NIfTI-2** and **NRRD (Nearly Raw Raster Data)** medical imaging volumes.

---

## Supported Extensions & Standards

| Extension        | Format                | Description                                                                                                              |
| :--------------- | :-------------------- | :----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `.nii`           | NIfTI-1 / NIfTI-2     | Neuroimaging & clinical volumetric format encoding 3D/4D voxel grids, `pixdim` spacings, and `qform`/`sform` RAS affines |
| `.nrrd`, `.nhdr` | Teem / 3D Slicer NRRD | Nearly Raw Raster Data header/volume with `space directions`, `space origin`, and anatomical segmentation labelmaps      |

---

## Key Capabilities

### 1. Voxel-to-RAS Affine Geometry & Orientation Auditing

`@modelscript/nifti` parses voxel dimensions $(N_i, N_j, N_k, N_t)$, millimeter spacings $(\Delta i, \Delta j, \Delta k) = (\text{pixdim}[1], \text{pixdim}[2], \text{pixdim}[3])$, unit quaternion parameters $(b, c, d)$ with $a = \sqrt{\max(0, 1 - (b^2 + c^2 + d^2))}$ and `qfac` $q \in \{-1, +1\}$, and $4 \times 4$ `sform` homogeneous transformation matrices:

$$\begin{bmatrix} x_{\text{RAS}} \\ y_{\text{RAS}} \\ z_{\text{RAS}} \end{bmatrix} = \mathbf{R}(a, b, c, d) \begin{bmatrix} \Delta i \cdot i \\ \Delta j \cdot j \\ q \cdot \Delta k \cdot k \end{bmatrix} + \begin{bmatrix} q_{\text{offset},x} \\ q_{\text{offset},y} \\ q_{\text{offset},z} \end{bmatrix}$$

Pre-flight diagnostics verify:

- Non-singular affine determinant ($\lvert \det(\mathbf{M}_{3\times 3}) \rvert > 10^{-9}$) so voxels map bijectively to physical space,
- Consistency of radiological vs. neurological left-right handedness ($\text{sign}(\det \mathbf{M}_{\text{qform}}) = \text{sign}(\det \mathbf{M}_{\text{sform}})$),
- Isotropic/sub-millimeter slice spacing limits for surgical navigation and stereotactic radiosurgery.

### 2. Segmentation Labelmaps & Marching Tetrahedra Iso-Surfacing

- Computes exact organ and tumor ROI volumes $V_{\text{ROI}} = N_{\text{voxels}} \cdot \lvert \det(\mathbf{M}_{3\times 3}) \rvert$ ($\text{mm}^3$ and $\text{cm}^3$), physical RAS centroids, and axis-aligned bounding boxes.
- Decomposes each cubic voxel into 6 Kuhn tetrahedra and extracts a watertight, manifold-consistent 3D triangular surface mesh at any threshold $I_{\text{iso}}$ via linear edge interpolation (`extractIsoSurfaceMesh`):
  $$\mathbf{p}_{ab} = \mathbf{p}_a + \frac{I_{\text{iso}} - I_a}{I_b - I_a}\left(\mathbf{p}_b - \mathbf{p}_a\right)$$

### 3. CAD Reconstruction (STEP AP242, OpenSCAD & DAE Lowering)

- Projects extracted anatomical iso-surfaces directly into **ISO 10303-21 STEP** B-Rep faceted shells (`niftiToStep`), **OpenSCAD** `polyhedron(...)` CSG modules (`niftiToScad`), and `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder` arena (`lowerNiftiToDae`).

---

## Pre-Flight Diagnostics

### Diagnostics for NIfTI / NRRD (10 rules)
| Code | Severity | Identifier | Summary |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `M9501` | error | `nifti-invalid-dimensions` | Invalid NIfTI/NRRD volume dimensions: dim[0]='<ndim>', spatial size=(<nx>, <ny>, <nz>). |
| `M9502` | error | `nifti-non-positive-voxel-spacing` | Non-positive voxel spacing pixdim=(<dx>, <dy>, <dz>) mm (all spatial spacings must be > 0). |
| `M9503` | error | `nifti-singular-affine-transform` | 4x4 sform affine transformation matrix is singular or degenerate with det(A) = '<detA>'. |
| `M9504` | error | `nifti-invalid-quaternion-norm` | Invalid qform quaternion parameters (<b>, <c>, <d>): b^2 + c^2 + d^2 = '<normSq>' exceeds 1.0. |
| `M9505` | error | `nifti-qform-sform-handedness-mismatch` | Coordinate handedness mismatch between active qform (qfac sign '<qfacSign>') and sform (det sign '<sformDetSign>'). |
| `M9506` | error | `nifti-zero-intensity-scale-slope` | Intensity scaling has scl_slope='<sclSlope>' with active scaling (scl_inter='<sclInter>'), zeroing all voxel intensities. |
| `M9507` | error | `nifti-unsupported-datatype` | Unsupported or invalid NIfTI/NRRD voxel datatype '<datatypeName>' (code='<datatypeCode>'). |
| `M9508` | error | `nifti-voxel-data-size-mismatch` | Voxel payload count '<actualCount>' does not match expected '<expectedCount>' for dimensions <dimsDesc>. |
| `M9509` | warning | `nifti-empty-segmentation-mask` | Segmentation labelmap '<title>' contains zero foreground voxels across all anatomical labels. |
| `M9510` | warning | `nifti-anisotropic-slice-gap-warning` | Slice thickness dz='<dz>' mm exceeds in-plane resolution '<minInPlane>' mm by '<ratio>x' (> 5x threshold), risking severe 3D stair-step artifacts. |

---


# 3MF Medical Surgical Guides & Implants (`.3mf`)

`@modelscript/three-mf` (`languages/three-mf`) provides native WebAssembly parsing, **half-edge 2-manifold watertightness** and Euler-Poincaré characteristic ($\chi = V - E + F$) verification, surgical guide minimum wall-thickness and drill-sleeve K-wire clearance auditing, osteotomy cutting-plane normal validation, `DAEBuilder` lowering, and ISO 10303-21 STEP / OpenSCAD projections for **ISO/ASTM 52915 3MF Medical** patient-specific 3D-printed surgical guides and cranial/orthopedic implants.

---

## Supported Extensions & Standards

| Extension | Format             | Description                                                                                                                               |
| :-------- | :----------------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `.3mf`    | ISO/ASTM 52915 3MF | 3D Manufacturing Format (`<model>`, `<resources>`, `<mesh>`, `<vertices>`, `<triangles>`, `<build>`, and surgical guide/implant metadata) |

---

## Key Capabilities

### 1. Watertight 2-Manifold Topology & Signed Divergence Volume

`@modelscript/three-mf` constructs the directed half-edge incidence graph over `<vertices>` and `<triangles>` (`analyzeMeshTopology`) to verify that every directed edge $(u \to v)$ is paired with exactly one opposite half-edge $(v \to u)$:

$$\chi = V - E + F = 2(S - g), \qquad V_{\text{signed}} = \frac{1}{6}\sum_{f=1}^{F} \mathbf{v}_{f,1} \cdot \left(\mathbf{v}_{f,2} \times \mathbf{v}_{f,3}\right)$$

where $S$ is the number of closed connected shells and $g$ is the topological genus (e.g., number of drill-guide holes through the template). Pre-flight checks flag open boundary edges ($N_{\text{boundary}} > 0$), non-manifold edges shared by $>2$ faces, inverted negative-volume shells, and zero-area degenerate triangles ($\|\left(\mathbf{v}_2 - \mathbf{v}_1\right) \times \left(\mathbf{v}_3 - \mathbf{v}_1\right)\| = 0$).

### 2. Surgical Cutting Guide & Drill-Sleeve Verification

- Validates patient-specific osteotomy cutting guides and pedicle/dental drill sleeves:
  - **Minimum Wall Thickness**: Enforces structural wall thickness $t_{\text{wall}} \ge 1.2\text{ mm}$ for biocompatible additive manufacturing (SLS PA12, SLA BioMed Clear/Amber, Ti6Al4V DMLS).
  - **Drill-Sleeve Annular Wall & K-Wire Clearance**: Checks radial wall thickness $r_{\text{outer}} - r_{\text{inner}} \ge 1.0\text{ mm}$ and positive diametral clearance between guide cylinder bore and surgical drill bit / Kirschner wire.
  - **Osteotomy Plane Normals**: Verifies unit-normalized cutting-plane normal vectors ($\lvert \|\mathbf{n}\|_2 - 1 \rvert < 10^{-4}$).

### 3. ISO 10303-21 STEP, OpenSCAD & DAE Lowering

- Exports verified surgical guides and implants to **ISO 10303-21 STEP** (`threeMfToStep`), **OpenSCAD** (`threeMfToScad`), and `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder` arena (`lowerThreeMfToDae`).

---

## Pre-Flight Diagnostics

### Diagnostics for 3MF Medical (10 rules)
| Code | Severity | Identifier | Summary |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `M9701` | error | `three-mf-non-manifold-edge` | Mesh in object '<objId>' is not a closed 2-manifold ('<openEdges>' open boundary edges, '<nonManifoldEdges>' non-manifold edges). |
| `M9702` | error | `three-mf-degenerate-triangle` | Triangle #<triIndex> (<v1>, <v2>, <v3>) in object '<objId>' is degenerate (duplicate vertex indices or zero area). |
| `M9703` | error | `three-mf-negative-mesh-volume` | Mesh in object '<objId>' has non-positive signed volume '<signedVol> mm^3' (inverted outward face normals). |
| `M9704` | error | `three-mf-unresolved-build-object` | Build '<item>' references undefined resource '<object id="<objectId>">'. |
| `M9705` | error | `three-mf-wall-thickness-violation` | Surgical guide or cannula '<targetName>' has wall thickness '<actualMm> mm' below minimum additive manufacturing threshold '<minMm> mm'. |
| `M9706` | error | `three-mf-invalid-osteotomy-guide-axis` | Osteotomy plane or drill sleeve '<guideFeatureId>' on object '<objId>' has a zero-length normal/axis vector. |
| `M9707` | error | `three-mf-missing-biocompatible-material` | Medical object '<objId>' lacks an approved ISO 10993 / USP Class VI biocompatible material (found '<matName>'). |

| `M9709` | error | `three-mf-out-of-bounds-vertex-index` | Triangle #<triIndex> (<v1>, <v2>, <v3>) in object '<objId>' references vertex index outside [0, <value>]. |
| `M9710` | error | `three-mf-duplicate-object-id` | Duplicate '<object id="<objId>">' declared in '<resources>'. |

# OpenIGTLink & PLUS Surgical Navigation (`.igtl`, `.plus.xml`)

`@modelscript/igtl` (`languages/igtl`) provides native WebAssembly parsing, $SE(3)$ homogeneous transform orthogonality ($\mathbf{R}^\top\mathbf{R} = \mathbf{I}$, $\det\mathbf{R} = +1$) and coordinate-frame graph connectivity verification, **stylus pivot calibration**, **Fitzpatrick (1998) Target Registration Error ($\text{TRE}$)** estimation, `DAEBuilder` lowering, and ROS 2 URDF / Modelica projections for **OpenIGTLink** and **PLUS Toolkit** image-guided surgical navigation systems.

---

## Supported Extensions & Standards

| Extension           | Format              | Description                                                                                                                                                                             |
| :------------------ | :------------------ | :-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `.plus.xml`, `.xml` | PLUS Toolkit Config | `PlusConfiguration` XML defining optical/EM trackers (`DataCollection`), `<CoordinateDefinitions>` $SE(3)$ transforms, pivot/phantom calibration, and `<PlusOpenIGTLinkServer>` streams |
| `.igtl`             | OpenIGTLink Stream  | Surgical navigation `TRANSFORM`, `POSITION`, `TRACKING_DATA`, `IMAGE`, and `STATUS` message definitions                                                                                 |

---

## Key Capabilities

### 1. $SE(3)$ Coordinate Frame Graph & Matrix Orthogonality

`@modelscript/igtl` parses $4 \times 4$ homogeneous transformations $\mathbf{T}_{\text{From}\to\text{To}} \in SE(3)$ across surgical coordinate frames (`Tracker`, `Patient`, `Reference`, `Stylus`, `StylusTip`, `Probe`, `UltrasoundImage`, `RAS`) and verifies $SO(3)$ rotation matrix orthogonality ($\|\mathbf{R}^\top\mathbf{R} - \mathbf{I}\|_F < 10^{-4}$ and $\det\mathbf{R} = +1$):

$$^{A}\mathbf{T}_{C} = {}^{A}\mathbf{T}_{B} \, {}^{B}\mathbf{T}_{C}, \qquad \mathbf{T}^{-1} = \begin{bmatrix} \mathbf{R}^\top & -\mathbf{R}^\top\mathbf{t} \\ \mathbf{0}^\top & 1 \end{bmatrix}$$

Breadth-first traversal over `<CoordinateDefinitions>` resolves arbitrary multi-hop kinematic chains (e.g., $\text{StylusTip} \to \text{Stylus} \to \text{Tracker} \to \text{Reference} \to \text{Patient} \to \text{RAS}$) and detects disconnected subgraphs or contradictory cycle transforms.

### 2. Stylus Pivot Calibration & Fitzpatrick Target Registration Error ($\text{TRE}$)

- **Spherical Stylus Pivot Calibration**: Given $M$ poses $\{(\mathbf{R}_i, \mathbf{t}_i)\}_{i=1}^M$ of a tracked surgical pointer pivoting around a stationary divot, `@modelscript/igtl` solves the overdetermined linear least-squares system (`solveTransformChainAndPivot`) for the local tip offset $\mathbf{p}_{\text{tip}}$ and global pivot position $\mathbf{p}_{\text{pivot}}$:
  $$\begin{bmatrix} \mathbf{R}_1 & -\mathbf{I}_3 \\ \vdots & \vdots \\ \mathbf{R}_M & -\mathbf{I}_3 \end{bmatrix} \begin{bmatrix} \mathbf{p}_{\text{tip}} \\ \mathbf{p}_{\text{pivot}} \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} -\mathbf{t}_1 \\ \vdots \\ -\mathbf{t}_M \end{bmatrix}, \qquad e_{\text{RMS}} = \sqrt{\frac{1}{M}\sum_{i=1}^M \|\mathbf{R}_i \mathbf{p}_{\text{tip}} + \mathbf{t}_i - \mathbf{p}_{\text{pivot}}\|^2}$$
- **Fitzpatrick (1998) Target Registration Error**: Evaluates expected RMS registration error at surgical target $\mathbf{r}$ from $N$ anatomical/bone-screw fiducial markers with isotropic Fiducial Localization Error ($\text{FLE}$) and principal-axis RMS distances $f_k$:
  $$\langle \text{TRE}^2(\mathbf{r}) \rangle = \frac{\langle \text{FLE}^2 \rangle}{N}\left(1 + \frac{1}{3}\sum_{k=1}^{3}\frac{d_k^2}{f_k^2}\right)$$

### 3. ROS 2 URDF, Modelica & DAE Projections

- Projects surgical tracker coordinate trees into **ROS 2 URDF** (`igtlToUrdf`), **Modelica 3.x** (`igtlToModelica`), and `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder` arena (`lowerIgtlToDae`).

---

## Pre-Flight Diagnostics

### Diagnostics for OpenIGTLink / PLUS (10 rules)
| Code | Severity | Identifier | Summary |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `M9801` | error | `igtl-non-orthogonal-rotation` | Transform '<from> -> <to>' has non-orthogonal or reflection 3x3 rotation block (\|\|R^T R - I\|\|_F = <frobErr>, det(R) = <det>). |
| `M9802` | error | `igtl-invalid-homogeneous-bottom-row` | Transform '<from> -> <to>' has invalid 4x4 homogeneous bottom row '[<rowStr>]' (expected '[0, 0, 0, 1]'). |
| `M9803` | error | `igtl-disconnected-coordinate-frame` | Coordinate frame graph is disconnected: <detail>. |
| `M9804` | error | `igtl-cyclic-transform-chain` | Directed cycle detected in coordinate transform definitions: '<cycleStr>'. |
| `M9805` | warning | `igtl-excessive-registration-error` | Registration or calibration RMS error '<errorMm> mm' on '<contextName>' exceeds clinical safety threshold '<thresholdMm> mm'. |
| `M9806` | error | `igtl-invalid-acquisition-rate` | Device '<deviceId>' has invalid AcquisitionRate '<rateHz> Hz' (must be > 0 Hz). |
| `M9807` | error | `igtl-unresolved-device-or-channel` | '<contextName>' references undeclared <refKind> '<refId>'. |
| `M9808` | error | `igtl-self-transform-identity-mismatch` | Self-transform '<frameName> -> <frameName>' must be the 4x4 identity matrix. |
| `M9809` | error | `igtl-invalid-server-port` | OpenIGTLink server '<serverId>' ListeningPort '<port>' is outside valid TCP port range [1024, 65535]. |
| `M9810` | error | `igtl-duplicate-transform-edge` | Duplicate '<Transform>' defined for coordinate frame pair '(<from>, <to>)'. |

---

## CLI Usage

```bash
# Inspect tracking devices, SE(3) transforms, and OpenIGTLink servers
msx igtl inspect LaparoscopicTracker.plus.xml

# Validate SE(3) rotation orthogonality, frame connectivity, and TRE limits
msx igtl validate LaparoscopicTracker.plus.xml

# Solve coordinate frame chains, stylus pivot calibration, and Fitzpatrick TRE
msx igtl calibrate LaparoscopicTracker.plus.xml

# Project surgical navigation frame tree to ROS 2 URDF, Modelica, or DAE arena
msx igtl to-urdf LaparoscopicTracker.plus.xml > SurgicalTracker.urdf
msx igtl to-modelica LaparoscopicTracker.plus.xml > SurgicalTracker.mo
msx igtl to-dae LaparoscopicTracker.plus.xml
```

---

## Programmatic TypeScript SDK

```typescript
import {
  parseIgtlModel,
  solveTransformChainAndPivot,
  lowerIgtlToDae,
  igtlToUrdf,
  igtlToModelica,
} from "@modelscript/igtl";
import { DAEBuilder } from "@modelscript/runtime";

const model = parseIgtlModel(plusXmlSource);
const calibration = solveTransformChainAndPivot(model);

const builder = new DAEBuilder();
lowerIgtlToDae(model, builder);
const urdfXml = igtlToUrdf(model);
const modelicaCode = igtlToModelica(model);
```

# ACSL (`.csl`)

**Package:** `@modelscript/acsl` · **Maturity:** `Beta` · **Extensions:** `.csl`

ModelScript Beta-tier language package for **ACSL** (Advanced Continuous Simulation Language, 1975).

## Features

- Native WebAssembly GLR parser (`@modelscript/dsl` → `dist/parser.wasm`) with linear-memory CST access.
- Comprehensive diagnostics (`ACSL1001`–`ACSL5006`) for section placement, integrator initialization, algebraic loops, and `SCHEDULE` targets.

# VHDL (IEEE 1076) (`.vhd`)

**Package:** `@modelscript/vhdl` · **Maturity:** `Beta` · **Extensions:** `.vhd`

VHDL (IEEE Std 1076-1987 / 1076-1993 — VHSIC Hardware Description Language) language package for ModelScript (**Beta** tier).

## Features

- **Native WASM GLR Grammar (`src/language.ts`)**: Declarative `@modelscript/dsl` grammar compiled to `dist/parser.wasm` + `src-gen/bindings.{js,d.ts}` supporting `library`, `use`, `entity`, `port`, `generic`, `architecture`, `package`, `package body`, `signal`, `variable`, `constant`, `type`, `component`, `process`, `if/elsif/else`, `case/when`, `for/loop`, `<=`, `:=`, `port map`, `generic map`, `with ... select`, `when ... else`, and `--` comments.
- **Static Analysis & Lints (`src/errors.ts`, `src/lints/`)**: Diagnostics `VHDL1001`–`VHDL5006` covering syntax errors, mismatched entity/architecture end identifiers, duplicate declarations, undefined signal/port references, port direction violations (`in` driven / `out` read), incomplete sensitivity lists & inferred latches, vector width mismatches, and multiple drivers on unresolved signals.
- **Event-Driven Delta-Cycle 9-Value RTL Simulator (`src/solver/`)**: Full IEEE 1164 9-value (`U`, `X`, `0`, `1`, `Z`, `W`, `L`, `H`, `-`) resolution function, delta-cycle signal scheduling, immediate variable semantics, `rising_edge`/`falling_edge` clock detection, and hierarchical component instantiation.
- **DAE / Clocked Arena Lowering (`src/dae/`)**: Direct lowering of clocked synchronous processes and combinational logic into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `IDaeBuilder` linear memory arena.
- **Cross-Language Projections (`src/projections/`)**: Projections to Modelica 3.3+ synchronous clocks (`Clock`, `previous`, `when sample(...)`) and synthesizable IEEE 1364 Verilog (`module`, `always @(posedge clk)`, `assign`).
- **Cleanroom IEEE Standard Library (`src/catalog/`, `assets/vhdl-std-lib/`)**: Zero-I/O registered cleanroom library for `STD.STANDARD`, `IEEE.STD_LOGIC_1164`, `IEEE.NUMERIC_STD`, resolution functions, and primitive logic gates with an AssemblyScript WASM runtime (`runtime.wasm`) and parametric SVG block icons.
- **Workspace Indexing & LSP (`src/indexing.ts`, `src/lsp.ts`)**: UnifiedWorkspace symbol indexing, diagnostics, document symbols, hover documentation, and completions for `.vhd` / `.vhdl` files.

## Commands

```bash
npm run build       # Build stdlib WASM, GLR parser.wasm, and TypeScript output
npm run typecheck   # Strict TypeScript type checking
npm run lint        # ESLint checks on src/ and tests/
npm test            # Run full unit, grammar, lint, DAE, benchmark, stdlib, projection & LSP tests
```

# Verilog (IEEE 1364) (`.v`)

**Package:** `@modelscript/verilog` · **Maturity:** `Beta` · **Extensions:** `.v`

IEEE 1364 Verilog Hardware Description Language (1984/1995/2001) support for ModelScript — **Beta** tier.

## Features

- **Native WASM GLR Grammar (`src/language.ts`)**: Declarative `@modelscript/dsl` specification compiled to `dist/parser.wasm` + `src-gen/bindings.{js,d.ts}` supporting `module`/`endmodule`, ANSI & non-ANSI port lists, `input`/`output`/`inout`, `wire`/`reg`/`integer`/`parameter`/`localparam`, bit-vectors `[msb:lsb]`, continuous `assign`, `always @(posedge/negedge/*)`, `initial`, `begin`/`end`, `if`/`else`, `case`/`endcase`, blocking (`=`) and non-blocking (`<=`) assignments, IEEE 1364 gate primitives (`and`, `nand`, `or`, `nor`, `xor`, `xnor`, `buf`, `not`, `bufif0`, `bufif1`, `notif0`, `notif1`), module instantiation, sized literals (`4'b1010`, `8'hFF`), and `//` / `/* */` comments.
- **RTL Parser & Diagnostics (`src/parser/`, `src/errors.ts`, `src/lints/`)**: Full Verilog-2001 structural/behavioral parser with `VLOG1001`–`VLOG5006` linting (syntax errors, duplicate ports/nets, undeclared identifiers, blocking assignments in sequential `always @(posedge/negedge ...)` blocks, non-blocking assignments in combinational blocks, assigning to `wire` inside `always`, multiple drivers on non-`tri` nets, and bit-width truncation warnings).
- **4-State (`0/1/X/Z`) Event-Driven RTL Simulator (`src/solver/`)**: Stratified IEEE 1364 active/NBA delta-cycle simulator supporting combinational `assign`, gate primitives (including tri-state `bufif0`/`bufif1`/`notif0`/`notif1`), `initial` blocks, `posedge`/`negedge` flip-flops, `if`/`else`/`case` control flow, hierarchical module instantiation, and waveform recording.
- **Linear-Memory DAE Lowering (`src/dae/`)**: Direct lowering of Verilog parameters, ports, combinational assignments, gate primitives, and clocked registers into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder`.
- **Cleanroom IEEE 1364 Standard Library (`src/catalog/`, `assets/verilog-std-lib/`)**: Built-in gate primitives (`and`, `nand`, `or`, `nor`, `xor`, `xnor`, `buf`, `not`, `bufif0`, `bufif1`, `notif0`, `notif1`) and standard RTL blocks (`dff`, `dffr`, `dffe`, `dlatch`, `mux2`, `mux4`, `half_adder`, `full_adder`, `alu4`, `shift_reg`, `lfsr7`, `counter`) with parametric SVG icons and AssemblyScript WASM runtime kernels.
- **Cross-Language Projections (`src/projections/`)**: Export Verilog modules to Modelica 3.6 synchronous clocks (`Clock`, `previous`, `when`) and IEEE 1076 VHDL (`entity`/`architecture`, `std_logic`, `std_logic_vector`).
- **Unified Indexing & LSP (`src/indexing.ts`, `src/lsp.ts`)**: Workspace symbol indexing, document symbols, diagnostics, contextual hover, and domain actions.

# Lustre (`.lus`)

**Package:** `@modelscript/lustre` · **Maturity:** `Beta` · **Extensions:** `.lus`

Lustre (Synchronous Dataflow Language, Caspi, Pilaud, Halbwachs & Plaice, 1984) compiler, clock calculus analyzer, clocked DAE lowering, cycle-accurate synchronous stepper, Modelica 3.3+ synchronous clock projection, cleanroom temporal operator standard library, and LSP support for ModelScript.

## Maturity Tier

**Beta** (`modelscript.tier = "beta"`, `fileExtensions: [".lus", ".ec"]`).

## Features

- **Native WASM GLR Parser (`src/language.ts`, `src/parser/`)**: Declarative `@modelscript/dsl` grammar compiled to WebAssembly (`dist/parser.wasm`) plus fast semantic parser supporting `const`, `type`, `node`/`function`, `returns`, `var`, `let ... tel`, `->`, `pre`, `when`, `current`, `merge`, `if ... then ... else`, `assert`, boolean/arithmetic/relational operators (`and`, `or`, `not`, `xor`, `div`, `mod`, `=>`), and `--` / `/* */` comments.
- **Static Analysis & Clock Calculus (`src/errors.ts`, `src/lints/`)**: Diagnostics `LUST1001`–`LUST5006` covering syntax errors, duplicate declarations, undefined identifiers/nodes, instantaneous algebraic causality cycles without `pre`, uninitialized `pre` without `->`, clock mismatches in binary expressions/assignments, `bool`/`int`/`real` type checking, and missing output equations.
- **Clocked DAE Lowering (`src/dae/`)**: Direct lowering of Lustre streams (`pre`, `->`, `when`, `current`, `merge`) into `@modelscript/runtime` `DAEBuilder` linear memory (`VarType.Clock`, `ExprKind.Pre`, `EqKind.When`, `EqKind.InitialSimple`).
- **Synchronous Stepper & Observer Checker (`src/solver/`)**: Cycle-accurate topological execution of Lustre nodes with sub-clocked `when`/`current` streams, nested node instantiation, `assert` verification, and safety-property observer checking.
- **Modelica 3.3+ Synchronous Projection (`src/projections/`)**: Translates Lustre nodes to Modelica 3.3+ synchronous clocked models (`Clock`, `previous`, `sample`, `hold`, `firstTick`).
- **Cleanroom Standard Library (`src/catalog/`, `assets/lustre-std-lib/`)**: 9 standard Lustre/SCADE temporal operators (`Edge`, `RisingEdge`, `FallingEdge`, `Counter`, `Timer`, `IntegratorEuler`, `PIDDiscrete`, `Latch`, `OnceSince`) compiled to AssemblyScript `runtime.wasm` with cleanroom SVG icons.
- **Unified Indexing & LSP (`src/indexing.ts`, `src/lsp.ts`)**: Workspace symbol indexing, diagnostics, document symbols, hover documentation, and completions.
