# Esterel (`.strl`)

**Package:** `@modelscript/esterel` · **Maturity:** `Beta` · **Extensions:** `.strl`

ModelScript **Beta**-tier implementation of **Esterel** (Gérard Berry, 1984) — the synchronous imperative reactive language for deterministic real-time control systems.

## Features

- **Declarative WASM GLR Parser (`src/language.ts`, `src/parser/`)**: Supports Esterel v5 modules, signal interfaces (`input`, `output`, `inputoutput`, `sensor`, `relation` with `#` exclusion and `=>` implication), local `signal ... in ... end`, `emit`, `sustain`, `present ... then ... else ... end`, `await` / `await immediate`, `pause`, `nothing`, `halt`, `loop ... end`, `loop ... each ...`, `every ... do ... end`, strong & `weak abort ... when ... end`, `suspend ... when ... end`, `trap ... in ... end` / `exit`, `run`, `||` parallel composition, `;` sequential composition, and `%` comments.
- **Constructive Semantics & Causality Checker (`src/lints/`, `src/errors.ts`)**: Diagnostics `EST1001`–`EST5006` covering syntax errors, duplicate declarations, undeclared signals/traps, relation conflicts, instantaneous infinite loops (`loop` without `pause`/`await`), and constructive causality cycles (`present S else emit S`).
- **Berry's Constructive Reactive Simulator (`src/solver/`)**: 3-valued constructive fixpoint step-by-step execution engine supporting synchronous broadcast across `||`, strong vs. weak preemption (`abort` / `weak abort`), suspension (`suspend`), hierarchical `trap`/`exit` priority, and `loop ... each`.
- **Mealy FSM / DAE Lowering (`src/dae/`)**: Direct linear-memory lowering of Esterel reactive state registers and signal status equations into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder`.
- **Polyglot Projections (`src/projections/`)**: Translates Esterel modules to Modelica 3.3+ clocked synchronous state machines and Lustre v6 synchronous dataflow nodes.
- **Cleanroom Standard Library (`src/catalog/`, `assets/esterel-std-lib/`)**: Zero-I/O standard library bundle with AssemblyScript WASM runtime and SVG block icons for canonical Esterel reactive patterns (`ABRO`, `Watchdog`, `Debouncer`, `Arbiter`, `Timeout`, `Stopwatch`).
- **Workspace Indexing & LSP (`src/indexing.ts`, `src/lsp.ts`)**: Unified workspace symbol indexing, diagnostics, document symbols, hover documentation, and completions.

## Usage

```ts
import {
  parseEsterel,
  lintEsterel,
  simulateEsterelTrace,
  esterelToDae,
  esterelToModelica,
  esterelToLustre,
} from "@modelscript/esterel";

const abro = `
module ABRO:
input A, B, R;
output O;
loop
  [ await A || await B ];
  emit O
each R
end module
`;

const program = parseEsterel(abro);
const diagnostics = lintEsterel(program);
const trace = simulateEsterelTrace(program, [[], ["A"], ["B"], ["R"], ["A", "B"]]);
```

# SDL-88 (`.sdl`)

**Package:** `@modelscript/sdl` · **Maturity:** `Beta` · **Extensions:** `.sdl`

**Maturity:** Beta · **Extensions:** `.sdl`, `.pr`, `.sdl88` · **Standard:** ITU-T Z.100 (SDL-88, 1976–1988)

Native **SDL-88 (Specification and Description Language — ITU-T Recommendation Z.100)** compiler, Extended Finite State Machine (EFSM) communicating discrete-event simulator, static reachability/deadlock verifier, direct `DAEBuilder` lowering, and Modelica state-machine projection package for ModelScript.

## Core Capabilities

- **WASM GLR Parser & Structured SDL-88 PR Parser**: Native `@modelscript/dsl` WebAssembly GLR parser (`sdlLanguage`) plus structured SDL/PR parser (`parseSdl`) supporting `SYSTEM`/`ENDSYSTEM`, `BLOCK`/`ENDBLOCK`, `PROCESS`/`ENDPROCESS`, `CHANNEL`/`ENDCHANNEL`, `SIGNALROUTE`, `CONNECT`, `SIGNAL`, `DCL`, `TIMER`, `START`, `STATE`/`ENDSTATE`, `INPUT`, `OUTPUT`, `TASK`, `DECISION`/`ENDDECISION`, `NEXTSTATE`, `SET`/`RESET`, `STOP`, and `/* */` comments.
- **Static Verification & Linter (`lintSdl`, `SdlErrorCode`)**: Rules `SDL1001`–`SDL5006` covering syntax errors, duplicate declarations, undefined signals/timers/states, unreachable states, sink/deadlock states, unmatched `NEXTSTATE`, missing `START`, and disconnected channels/signalroutes.
- **Direct DAE Arena Lowering (`lowerSdlToDae`, `sdlToDae`)**: Lowers SDL-88 EFSM states, `DCL` variables, and `TIMER` countdown dynamics directly into `@modelscript/runtime`'s linear-memory `IDaeBuilder`.
- **Communicating EFSM Simulator & Reachability Analyzer (`simulateSdl`, `analyzeSdlReachability`)**: Discrete-event simulation with per-process FIFO input queues, channel/signalroute routing, timer `SET`/`RESET`/expiry scheduling, packet-loss injection for protocol testing, and CFG reachability/deadlock analysis.
- **Modelica State-Machine Projection (`sdlToModelica`)**: Projects SDL-88 systems and processes to Modelica 3.3+ synchronous state machines (`initialState`, `transition`, `activeState`).
- **Cleanroom ITU-T Z.100 Standard Library**: Zero-I/O library bundle (`@modelscript/sdl-std-lib`) covering ITU-T Z.100 predefined sorts (`Boolean`, `Integer`, `Real`, `Duration`, `Time`, `PId`, `Charstring`) and canonical telecom protocol blocks (Alternating-Bit Protocol, Watchdog Timer, Call Setup).
- **Unified Indexing & LSP (`sdlIndexing`, `validateSdl`, `getSdlDocumentSymbols`, `getSdlHover`, `getSdlCompletions`)**: Full IDE diagnostics, outline symbols, hover info, and completions.

# EDIF 2.0.0 (`.edf`)

**Package:** `@modelscript/edif` · **Maturity:** `Beta` · **Extensions:** `.edf`

**EDIF 2.0.0 (Electronic Design Interchange Format, EIA-548 / IEC 61690-1, 1983)** compiler, linter, hierarchical netlist flattener, DC/logic solver, DAE lowering engine, and LSP support for ModelScript.

## Maturity Tier

**Beta** (`modelscript.tier = "beta"`).

## Capabilities

- **Native WASM GLR Parser (`src/language.ts`, `dist/parser.wasm`)**: Declarative `@modelscript/dsl` grammar covering EDIF 2.0.0 S-expressions (`edif`, `edifVersion`, `edifLevel`, `keywordMap`, `status`, `external`, `library`, `technology`, `cell`, `cellType`, `view`, `viewType`, `interface`, `port`, `direction`, `contents`, `instance`, `viewRef`, `cellRef`, `libraryRef`, `net`, `joined`, `portRef`, `instanceRef`, `property`, `design`, `rename`).
- **Static Analysis & Lints (`src/errors.ts`, `src/lints/index.ts`)**: `EDIF1001`–`EDIF5006` diagnostics covering syntax errors, version validation, duplicate libraries/cells/instances/nets/ports, unresolved references, floating nets, shorted output drivers, missing top-level `design`, and circular hierarchy.
- **Hierarchical Netlist Flattener & DC/Logic Solver (`src/solver/`)**: Expands hierarchical EDIF netlists from the top-level `design`, solves resistive/passive DC circuits via Modified Nodal Analysis (MNA), and evaluates combinational/sequential digital logic (`AND2`, `OR2`, `NAND2`, `NOR2`, `INV`, `XOR2`, `DFF`).
- **Linear-Memory DAE Lowering (`src/dae/`)**: Lowers EDIF electrical netlists (KCL node equations, passive branch constitutive laws, and gate models) directly into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder`.
- **Polyglot Projections (`src/projections/`)**: Exports EDIF netlists to standard SPICE netlists (`edifToSpice`) and Modelica models (`edifToModelica`).
- **Cleanroom Standard Library (`@modelscript/edif-std-lib`)**: Zero-I/O bundle with AssemblyScript WASM runtime and parametric SVG block icons for 12 standard EDIF `GENERIC` cells (`RES`, `CAP`, `IND`, `GND`, `VCC`, `AND2`, `OR2`, `NAND2`, `NOR2`, `INV`, `XOR2`, `DFF`).
- **Workspace Indexing & LSP (`src/indexing.ts`, `src/lsp.ts`)**: Document symbols, hover cards, diagnostics, completions, and go-to-definition for `.edf`, `.edif`, and `.edn` files.

## Quick Start

```ts
import {
  parseEdif,
  lintEdif,
  flattenEdifNetlist,
  solveEdifDc,
  evaluateEdifLogic,
  edifToDae,
  edifToSpice,
  edifToModelica,
} from "@modelscript/edif";

const doc = parseEdif(edifSource);
const diagnostics = lintEdif(doc);
const flat = flattenEdifNetlist(doc);
const dc = solveEdifDc(flat);
const dae = edifToDae(doc);
const spice = edifToSpice(doc);
const modelica = edifToModelica(doc);
```

# GDSII (`.gds`)

**Package:** `@modelscript/gdsii` · **Maturity:** `Beta` · **Extensions:** `.gds`

ModelScript **Beta** language package for **GDSII** (Calma Graphic Design System II IC Layout Stream Format, 1978).

## Capabilities

- **WASM GLR Parser & GDT/ASCII Stream Parser**: Declarative `@modelscript/dsl` grammar (`gdsiiLanguage`) compiled to `dist/parser.wasm` plus structured GDT/ASCII parser supporting `HEADER`, `BGNLIB`, `LIBNAME`, `UNITS`, `BGNSTR`, `STRNAME`, `BOUNDARY`, `PATH`, `SREF`, `AREF`, `TEXT`, `LAYER`, `DATATYPE`, `WIDTH`, `XY`, `SNAME`, `STRANS`, `MAG`, `ANGLE`, `COLROW`, `ENDEL`, `ENDSTR`, `ENDLIB`.
- **Binary GDSII Stream Codec**: Full binary `.gds` / `.gds2` record encoder and decoder including IBM System/360 8-byte floating-point (`Real64`) conversion.
- **Lints & DRC Engine**: `GDS1001`–`GDS5006` diagnostics covering stream syntax, unclosed `BOUNDARY` polygons, unresolved `SREF`/`AREF` references, cyclic cell hierarchies, invalid layer/datatype bounds, zero-area degenerate polygons, and geometric DRC minimum-width and minimum-spacing checks.

- **Parasitic RC DAE Lowering**: Extracts interconnect sheet resistance, area/fringe capacitance, Elmore delay, and node ODEs directly into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder`.

- **Cleanroom CMOS Standard Library**: Built-in foundry layer-map presets (`NWELL`, `ACTIVE`, `POLY`, `CONTACT`, `METAL1`, `VIA1`, `METAL2`) and standard cells (`INV`, `NAND2`) with AssemblyScript WASM kernels.

# MELCOR (`.mel`)

**Package:** `@modelscript/melcor` · **Maturity:** `Beta` · **Extensions:** `.mel`

**MELCOR** (Sandia National Laboratories Nuclear Severe Accident Analysis Deck, 1982) language frontend, WebAssembly GLR parser, static linter, linear-memory DAE lowering, severe-accident thermal-hydraulic/core-heatup/oxidation solver, cleanroom standard library, and Modelica/RELAP5 projections for ModelScript.

## Maturity Tier

- **Tier:** `beta`
- **Category:** `language`
- **File Extensions:** `.mel`, `.melcor`, `.mci`, `.inp`

## Supported MELCOR Packages

- `MELGEN_INPUT` / `MELCOR_INPUT` / `END` deck wrappers and `TITLE`
- `EXEC_INPUT` — execution time bounds (`EXEC_TEND`, `EXEC_DTMAX`, `EXEC_DTMIN`, `EXEC_DT`)
- `CVH_INPUT` — control volume hydrodynamics (`CV_ID`, `CV_THR`, `CV_PAS`, `CV_TY`, `CV_VAT`)
- `FL_INPUT` — flow paths (`FL_ID`, `FL_FT`, `FL_GEO`, `FL_USL`)
- `HS_INPUT` — heat structures (`HS_ID`, `HS_GD`, `HS_LB`, `HS_RB`, `HS_TEMP`)
- `COR_INPUT` — core degradation, decay heat & Zircaloy-steam oxidation (`COR_RP`, `COR_ZDF`, `COR_PWR`, `COR_OX`)
- `RN1_INPUT` — radionuclide / fission product release & aerosol classes
- `CF_INPUT` — control functions (`CF_ID`, `CF_ARG`, `CF_SAI`)
- `TF_INPUT` — tabular functions (`TF_ID`, `TF_TAB`)
- `MP_INPUT` & `NCG_INPUT` — material properties and non-condensable gases

## Architecture

- **WASM GLR Parser (`src/language.ts`, `src/parser/`):** Declarative `@modelscript/dsl` grammar compiled to `dist/parser.wasm` + `src-gen/bindings.{js,d.ts}`.
- **Lints (`src/errors.ts`, `src/lints/`):** Pre-flight diagnostics `MEL1001`–`MEL5006` covering syntax, duplicate IDs, dangling CV references, non-positive geometry/thermodynamics, cyclic control functions, and missing execution time bounds.
- **DAE Lowering (`src/dae/`):** Direct linear-memory lowering of CVH mass/energy balances, FL momentum, HS thermal nodes, and COR decay-heat ODEs into `DAEBuilder`.
- **Transient Solver (`src/solver/`):** Coupled compressible blowdown, adiabatic/convective core decay-heat heatup, and Urbanic-Heidrick / Cathcart-Pawel parabolic Zircaloy-steam oxidation & $\text{H}_2$ generation kinetics.
- **Cleanroom Standard Library (`src/catalog/`, `assets/melcor-std-lib/`):** Schemas, SVG block icons, and AssemblyScript WASM runtime for MELCOR packages and PWR/BWR severe-accident materials (`UO2`, `Zircaloy-4`, `SS304`, `H2`, `N2`, `H2O`).
- **Projections (`src/projections/`):** Cross-language export to Modelica 3.x and US NRC RELAP5-3D card decks.
- **LSP & Indexing (`src/indexing.ts`, `src/lsp.ts`):** UnifiedWorkspace symbol indexing, diagnostics, document symbols, hover, and completions.

# SINDA / FLUINT (`.sin`)

**Package:** `@modelscript/sinda` · **Maturity:** `Beta` · **Extensions:** `.sin`

ModelScript **Beta** language support for **SINDA / SINDA-FLUINT** (NASA Systems Improved Numerical Differencing Analyzer — Lumped-Parameter Thermal Network Analyzer).

## Features

- **Native WASM GLR Parser (`sindaLanguage`)**: Declarative `@modelscript/dsl` grammar compiled to WebAssembly (`dist/parser.wasm`) supporting `HEADER OPTIONS DATA`, `HEADER NODE DATA`, `HEADER CONDUCTOR DATA`, `HEADER CONSTANTS DATA`, `HEADER ARRAY DATA`, `HEADER SOURCE DATA`, `HEADER EXECUTION`, `HEADER VARIABLES 1`, `HEADER VARIABLES 2`, `HEADER OUTPUT CALLS`, `END OF DATA`, and `C` / `$` comments.
- **Static Thermal Network Linter (`SIN1001`–`SIN5006`)**: Validates syntax, duplicate node/conductor IDs, undefined node references, self-loop conductors, negative capacitances/conductances, floating/disconnected thermal subnetworks without boundary nodes, invalid radiation temperatures ($\le 0\,\mathrm{K}$), and missing `END OF DATA`.
- **Linear-Memory DAE Lowering**: Directly lowers lumped-parameter thermal RC and Stefan-Boltzmann radiation networks ($\sigma G_{ij}(T_i^4 - T_j^4)$) into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder`.
- **Steady-State & Transient Thermal Solvers**:
  - `STDSTL`: Analytical-Jacobian Newton-Raphson steady-state solver for linear and nonlinear radiative thermal networks.
  - `CRANKN` / `FWDBCK`: Implicit Crank-Nicolson transient integrator with per-step Newton-Raphson for stiff and radiative networks.
  - `RK4`: 4th-order Runge-Kutta explicit transient integrator.
- **Modelica Projection**: Translates SINDA thermal networks to `Modelica.Thermal.HeatTransfer` (`HeatCapacitor`, `FixedTemperature`, `ThermalConductor`, `BodyRadiation`, `FixedHeatFlow`).
- **Cleanroom Standard Library (`@modelscript/sinda-std-lib`)**: Zero-I/O registered schemas, SVG icons, and AssemblyScript `runtime.wasm` for SINDA solver routines (`STDSTL`, `FWDBCK`, `CRANKN`, `SNFR`) and spacecraft thermal materials (`AL_6061`, `TI_6AL_4V`, `MLI`, `KAPTON`, `BLACK_ANODIZE`, `OSR`).
- **Unified Indexing & LSP**: Document symbols, diagnostics, hover documentation, and completions.

# USAF Digital DATCOM (`.dcm`)

**Package:** `@modelscript/datcom` · **Maturity:** `Beta` · **Extensions:** `.dcm`

USAF Stability and Control Digital DATCOM (1970s) language package for ModelScript (**Beta** tier).

## Capabilities

- **WASM GLR Parser (`src/language.ts`, `src/parser/`)**: Declarative `@modelscript/dsl` grammar and deck parser supporting Fortran NAMELIST blocks (`$FLTCON`, `$OPTINS`, `$SYNTHS`, `$BODY`, `$WGPLNF`, `$HTPLNF`, `$VTPLNF`, `$VFPLNF`, `$SYMFLP`, `$ASYFLP`, `$WGSCHR`, `$` terminators) and control cards (`CASEID`, `DIM FT/IN/M/CM`, `DERIV DEG/RAD`, `NACA-W/H/V-4/5/6-xxxx`, `DAMP`, `BUILD`, `PLOT`, `NEXT CASE`, `SAVE`).

- **Semi-Empirical Aerodynamic Solver (`src/solver/`)**: Helmbold/Polhamus finite-wing $C_{L_\alpha}$, Prandtl-Glauert compressibility scaling, induced and parasitic drag polar $C_D = C_{D_0} + C_L^2 / (\pi e AR)$, pitching moment $C_m$, longitudinal static margin, dynamic damping derivatives ($C_{m_q}, C_{l_p}, C_{n_r}$), and linearized longitudinal/lateral modal analysis.
- **DAE Lowering (`src/dae/`)**: Direct lowering of 6-DOF linearized longitudinal (`u, w, q, theta`) and lateral (`v, p, r, phi`) flight dynamics state-space equations to `@modelscript/runtime` `DAEBuilder`.
- **Projections (`src/projections/`)**: Export DATCOM cases and aerodynamic tables to JSBSim XML (`<fdm_config>`) and Modelica models.
- **Cleanroom Standard Library (`src/catalog/`, `assets/datcom-std-lib/`)**: NACA 4/5/6-digit airfoil catalog (`0012`, `2412`, `4412`, `23012`, `64A010`) and standard aircraft configuration templates (Cessna-172 class, Citation-class, Supersonic Delta) with AssemblyScript WASM runtime.
- **Indexing & LSP (`src/indexing.ts`, `src/lsp.ts`)**: Workspace indexing, diagnostics, document symbols, hover documentation, and completions.

# NASA CEA (`.cea`)

**Package:** `@modelscript/cea` · **Maturity:** `Beta` · **Extensions:** `.cea`

NASA **CEA** (_Chemical Equilibrium with Applications_, Gordon & McBride / NASA RP-1311) language frontend, WebAssembly GLR parser, Gibbs free-energy minimization solver, 1D isentropic rocket nozzle & CJ detonation analyzer, linear-memory DAE lowering, cleanroom NASA-7/NASA-9 standard library, and polyglot projections for ModelScript.

## Features

- **WASM GLR Parser (`@modelscript/dsl`)**: Declarative grammar for NASA CEA problem decks (`problem`, `reactants`, `only`, `omit`, `insert`, `output`, `end`, `#`/`!` comments).
- **Pre-flight Lints (`CEA1001`–`CEA5006`)**: Validates problem types, reactant species, positive pressure/temperature/expansion ratios, non-negative `o/f` and `phi`, fuel/oxidizer weight percentage totals, and `only`/`omit` conflicts.
- **Gibbs Equilibrium & Propulsion Solver**:
  - Newton-Raphson Lagrange-multiplier Gibbs free-energy minimization (`tp`, `hp`, `sp`, `uv`, `tv`, `sv`).
  - 1D isentropic rocket nozzle expansion (`equilibrium` & `frozen`) computing $T_c$, $\gamma$, $M_w$, $c^*$, $C_F$, $I_{sp,\text{vac}}$, and $I_{sp,\text{sl}}$.
  - Chapman-Jouguet (`deton`) detonation velocity and post-shock state solver.
- **Cleanroom Standard Library (`@modelscript/cea-std-lib`)**: 17 NASA-7/NASA-9 thermodynamic species (`H2`, `O2`, `H2O`, `OH`, `H`, `O`, `CH4`, `CO`, `CO2`, `N2`, `NO`, `RP-1`, `N2O4`, `MMH`, `UDMH`, `He`, `Ar`) with cleanroom SVG icons and AssemblyScript WASM thermodynamic evaluator.
- **Linear-Memory DAE Lowering**: Compiles equilibrium element balances, enthalpy/entropy constraints, and rocket nozzle equations directly into `DAEBuilder`.
- **Polyglot Projections**: Exports CEA decks and solutions to Cantera YAML, Modelica, and NASA ROCETS decks.
- **UnifiedWorkspace Indexing & LSP**: Document symbols, hover cards, completions, and diagnostics.

# GAMS (`.gms`)

**Package:** `@modelscript/gams` · **Maturity:** `Beta` · **Extensions:** `.gms`

General Algebraic Modeling System (**GAMS**, 1978–1987) language package for ModelScript (**Beta** tier).

## Features

- **Native WASM GLR Parser (`src/language.ts`) & Recursive-Descent Parser (`src/parser/`)**:
  - `Sets` / `Set` (including range expansion `i1*i5` and hyphenated labels) and `Alias`
  - `Parameters` / `Parameter`, `Scalars` / `Scalar`, and column-aligned 2D `Tables` / `Table`
  - `Variables` (`Free`, `Positive`, `Negative`, `Binary`, `Integer`) and `.lo` / `.up` / `.fx` / `.l` suffix assignments
  - `Equations` / `Equation` declarations and `..` definitions (`=e=`, `=l=`, `=g=`, `=n=`)
  - Indexed operators (`sum`, `prod`, `smin`, `smax`), ordered-set intrinsics (`ord`, `card`, `sameas`), and `$`-conditionals
  - `Model`, `Solve ... using lp|mip|nlp minimizing|maximizing ...`, `Display`
  - Column-1 `*` line comments, `$ontext`/`$offtext` block comments, and `$title` / `$eolcom` directives
- **Static Linter (`src/lints/`, `src/errors.ts`)**: `GAMS1001`–`GAMS5006` diagnostics for syntax errors, duplicate declarations, undefined sets/parameters/variables, domain index arity mismatches, undeclared equations in `Model`, missing objective variables, invalid solver types, and conflicting bounds.
- **Relational Set Instantiator & DAE Lowering (`src/dae/`)**: Evaluates sets, tables, computed assignments, and `$`-conditionals, and lowers flat LP/MILP/NLP problems directly into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder` linear-memory arena.
- **Built-in LP / MILP Solver (`src/solver/`)**: Two-Phase Simplex LP solver with Bland's anti-cycling rule + Branch-and-Bound MILP solver for binary/integer variables.
- **Cross-Language Projections (`src/projections/`)**: Export GAMS models to standard **MPS**, **AMPL** (`.mod` + `.dat`), and **Modelica** (`.mo`).
- **Cleanroom Standard Library (`@modelscript/gams-std-lib`)**: Zero-I/O registered schemas, SVG icons, and AssemblyScript `runtime.wasm` kernels for GAMS intrinsic operators (`sum`, `prod`, `smin`, `smax`, `ord`, `card`, `sameas`) and classic GAMSlib archetypes (`trnsport`, `diet`, `blend`).
- **UnifiedWorkspace Indexing & LSP (`src/indexing.ts`, `src/lsp.ts`)**: Diagnostics, document symbols, hover docs, completions, and go-to-definition.

## Usage

```ts
import { solveGams, lowerGamsToDae, lintGamsSource, gamsToMps } from "@modelscript/gams";

const source = `
Sets
  i canning plants / seattle, san-diego /
  j markets        / new-york, chicago, topeka / ;
Parameters
  a(i) capacity / seattle 350, san-diego 600 /
  b(j) demand   / new-york 325, chicago 300, topeka 275 / ;
Table d(i,j) distance in thousands of miles
              new-york  chicago  topeka
  seattle          2.5      1.7     1.8
  san-diego        2.5      1.8     1.4 ;
Scalar f freight / 90 / ;
Parameter c(i,j) ;
c(i,j) = f * d(i,j) / 1000 ;
Variables x(i,j), z ;
Positive Variable x ;
Equations cost, supply(i), demand(j) ;
cost..      z =e= sum((i,j), c(i,j)*x(i,j)) ;
supply(i).. sum(j, x(i,j)) =l= a(i) ;
demand(j).. sum(i, x(i,j)) =g= b(j) ;
Model transport / all / ;
Solve transport using lp minimizing z ;
`;

const result = solveGams(source);
console.log(result.status, result.objectiveValue); // "optimal", 153.675

const dae = lowerGamsToDae(source);
const mps = gamsToMps(source);
const diagnostics = lintGamsSource(source);
```

# IBM MPS (`.mps`)

**Package:** `@modelscript/mps` · **Maturity:** `Beta` · **Extensions:** `.mps`

IBM **MPS (Mathematical Programming System)** language package for ModelScript (**Beta** tier).

Supports classic 80-column fixed-format punch-card MPS (1960s–1970s IBM MPSX/370) and modern Free MPS for Linear Programming (LP), Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP), and Quadratic Programming (QP / MIQP).

## Features

- **Native WebAssembly GLR Parser** (`mpsLanguage` → `dist/parser.wasm` + `src-gen/bindings.js`) compiled via `@modelscript/dsl`.
- **Fixed & Free MPS Parser / Writer** (`parseMps`, `writeMps`):
  - `NAME`, `OBJSENSE` (`MIN`/`MAX`), `ROWS` (`N`, `L`, `G`, `E`), `COLUMNS` (including `'MARKER'` `'INTORG'`/`'INTEND'`), `RHS`, `RANGES`, `BOUNDS` (`LO`, `UP`, `FX`, `FR`, `MI`, `PL`, `BV`, `LI`, `UI`), `QUADOBJ`, `QMATRIX`, `ENDATA`, and `*` comments.
- **Static Analysis & Linter** (`lintMps`, `MPS1001`–`MPS5006`): structural card checks, duplicate rows, undefined row/column references, invalid bound/row types, contradictory bounds (`LO > UP`), unmatched integer markers, missing objective rows.
- **Direct Linear-Memory DAE Lowering** (`lowerMpsToDae`, `mpsToDae`) into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder`.
- **Presolver & Solvers** (`presolveMps`, `solveMpsLp`, `solveMpsMip`, `solveMps`):
  - Algebraic LP/MILP presolver (fixed variable substitution, empty row/column elimination, singleton row bound tightening).
  - Two-Phase Revised Simplex LP solver with LU partial-pivoting basis solves and Dantzig/Bland anti-cycling.
  - Branch-and-Bound MILP solver with best-bound node selection.
- **Polyglot Projections** (`mpsToCplexLp`, `mpsToModelica`, `mpsToAmpl`).
- **Workspace Indexing & LSP** (`mpsIndexing`, `validateMps`, `getMpsDocumentSymbols`, `getMpsHover`).

## Usage

```ts
import { lintMps, mpsToCplexLp, mpsToDae, parseMps, solveMps, writeMps } from "@modelscript/mps";

const mps = `
NAME          PRODMIX
OBJSENSE
  MAX
ROWS
 N  PROFIT
 L  LABOR
 L  MATERIAL
COLUMNS
    X1        PROFIT    40       LABOR     1
    X1        MATERIAL  2
    X2        PROFIT    30       LABOR     1
    X2        MATERIAL  1
RHS
    RHS1      LABOR     100      MATERIAL  140
ENDATA
`;

const model = parseMps(mps);
const diagnostics = lintMps(model);
const solution = solveMps(model); // optimal: X1=40, X2=60, objective=3400
const dae = mpsToDae(model);
const lpText = mpsToCplexLp(model);
const fixedMps = writeMps(model, { fixedFormat: true });
```

# CPLEX LP / LINDO (`.lp`)

**Package:** `@modelscript/cplex-lp` · **Maturity:** `Beta` · **Extensions:** `.lp`

CPLEX LP & LINDO algebraic optimization format language package for ModelScript (Beta tier).

## Overview

Supports the algebraic linear, mixed-integer, and quadratic programming formats originating with LINDO (1979) and standardized by CPLEX LP (`.lp`, `.ltx`, `.lindo`):

- **Objective sections**: `Minimize` / `Maximize` / `Minimum` / `Maximum` / `MIN` / `MAX` with optional objective name, linear terms, constant offset, and quadratic blocks `[ c1 x1^2 + c2 x1 * x2 ] / 2`.
- **Constraint sections**: `Subject To` / `Such That` / `ST` / `S.T.` with named or unnamed constraints using `<=`, `>=`, `=`, and LINDO `<`, `>` operators.
- **Bounds & variable domains**: `Bounds` (`lb <= x <= ub`, `x >= lb`, `x <= ub`, `x = val`, `x free`, `+/-inf`, `+/-infinity`), `Generals` / `General` / `Gen`, `Binaries` / `Binary` / `Bin`, `Semi-Continuous` / `Semis`, and `SOS` (`S1::`, `S2::`).
- **LINDO dialect directives**: `!` line comments (in addition to CPLEX `\` comments), `TITLE`, `FREE`, `SLB`, `SUB`, `GIN`, `INT`, and `END`.

## Architecture

- **WASM GLR Parser (`src/language.ts`, `src/parser/`)**: Declarative `@modelscript/dsl` grammar compiled to `dist/parser.wasm` + `src-gen/bindings.{js,d.ts}` alongside a structured LP/LINDO parser with full source location tracking.
- **Static Analysis (`src/errors.ts`, `src/lints/`)**: Diagnostic rules `LP1001`–`LP5006` covering syntax errors, missing objective, missing `End`, duplicate constraint names, contradictory variable bounds, binary+free conflicts, empty constraints, and invalid SOS weights.
- **DAE Lowering (`src/dae/`)**: Direct lowering of LP/MILP/QP decision variables, linear/quadratic objectives, and equality/slack-augmented constraints into `@modelscript/runtime` `DAEBuilder`.
- **Solver (`src/solver/`)**: Built-in two-phase simplex LP solver (with Bland's anti-cycling rule, variable shifting/splitting for arbitrary bounds and free variables) and branch-and-bound MILP solver for binary and general integer programs.
- **Projections (`src/projections/`)**: Lossless export to standard **MPS** (`cplexLpToMps`) and **Modelica** (`cplexLpToModelica`).
- **Indexing & LSP (`src/indexing.ts`, `src/lsp.ts`)**: `UnifiedWorkspace` symbol indexing, diagnostics, document symbols, and hover documentation.

## Usage

```ts
import {
  parseCplexLp,
  lintCplexLp,
  cplexLpToDae,
  solveCplexLp,
  cplexLpToMps,
  cplexLpToModelica,
} from "@modelscript/cplex-lp";

const source = `
\\ Classic production-mix LP
Maximize
  profit: 3 x1 + 5 x2
Subject To
  plant1: x1 <= 4
  plant2: 2 x2 <= 12
  plant3: 3 x1 + 2 x2 <= 18
End
`;

const model = parseCplexLp(source);
const diagnostics = lintCplexLp(model);
const solution = solveCplexLp(model);
const dae = cplexLpToDae(model);
const mps = cplexLpToMps(model);
const mo = cplexLpToModelica(model);
```

# IGES 5.3 (`.igs`)

**Package:** `@modelscript/iges` · **Maturity:** `Beta` · **Extensions:** `.igs`

**IGES 5.3 (Initial Graphics Exchange Specification, ANSI Y14.26M / USPRO 1980–1996)** language package for ModelScript (**Beta** tier).

## Capabilities

- **Native WebAssembly GLR Parser (`@modelscript/dsl`)**: Declarative IGES 80-column section grammar (`S` Start, `G` Global with Hollerith strings `nH...`, `D` Directory Entry 2-line records, `P` Parameter Data, `T` Terminate) compiled to `dist/parser.wasm`.
- **Full IGES 5.3 Fixed-Column Parser & Serializer**: Supports entity types `100` (Circular Arc), `102` (Composite Curve), `104` (Conic Arc), `106` (Copious Data), `108` (Plane), `110` (Line), `116` (Point), `120` (Surface of Revolution), `122` (Tabulated Cylinder), `124` (Transformation Matrix), `126` (Rational B-Spline Curve / NURBS), `128` (Rational B-Spline Surface), `142` (Curve on Parametric Surface), `144` (Trimmed Parametric Surface), and `186` (Manifold Solid B-Rep Object).
- **Lints & Diagnostics (`IGES1001`–`IGES5006`)**: Column-width validation, Hollerith string length checks, section completeness & Terminate count parity, DE pointer integrity, odd-line DE record checks, degenerate line/arc detection, NURBS knot monotonicity & weight checks, and unit flag validation.
- **CAD / NURBS / B-Rep Evaluator & Lowering**: Exact Cox-de Boor rational B-spline curve (`126`) and surface (`128`) evaluation, 3×4 transformation (`124`), bounding box and arc-length computation, and lowering to `@modelscript/cad` solids and assemblies.
- **Projections**: Export IGES models directly to **STEP AP214** (`ISO 10303-21`) and **SVG** technical projections (`xy`, `xz`, `yz`, `iso`).
- **Cleanroom Standard Library (`@modelscript/iges-std-lib`)**: Zero-I/O registered entity schemas (`100`–`186`), unit conversion presets, SVG block icons, and AssemblyScript WASM geometry kernel.
- **Workspace Indexing & LSP**: UnifiedWorkspace symbol indexing, validation diagnostics, document symbols, hover documentation, and completions.

## Quick Start

```ts
import { parseIges, lintIges, evaluateIgesDocument, lowerIgesToCad, igesToStep, igesToSvg } from "@modelscript/iges";

const doc = parseIges(igesText);
const diagnostics = lintIges(doc);
const evaluation = evaluateIgesDocument(doc);
const cad = lowerIgesToCad(doc);
const stepText = igesToStep(doc);
const svgText = igesToSvg(doc, { view: "xy" });
```

# AutoCAD DXF (`.dxf`)

**Package:** `@modelscript/dxf` · **Maturity:** `Beta` · **Extensions:** `.dxf`

**AutoCAD DXF (Drawing Exchange Format, 1982)** compiler, linter, CAD/geometry lowering engine, SVG/STEP projector, cleanroom standard library, and LSP integration for ModelScript (**Beta** tier).

## Capabilities

- **Native WASM GLR Parser (`@modelscript/dsl`)**: Formal grammar (`dxfLanguage`) for ASCII DXF group-code/value pairs covering `HEADER`, `TABLES` (`LAYER`), `BLOCKS` (`BLOCK`/`ENDBLK`), `ENTITIES`, `OBJECTS`, and `EOF`.
- **Full Entity Coverage**: `LINE`, `ARC`, `CIRCLE`, `LWPOLYLINE` (including bulge arcs), `POLYLINE`/`VERTEX`/`SEQEND`, `SPLINE`, `ELLIPSE`, `3DFACE`, `POINT`, `TEXT`/`MTEXT`, and hierarchical `INSERT` block references.
- **Static Linting (`DXF1001`–`DXF5006`)**: Validates syntax/group codes, unclosed `SECTION`/`BLOCK`/`POLYLINE`, missing `EOF`, undefined layers/blocks, cyclic `INSERT` chains, zero-radius `CIRCLE`/`ARC`, degenerate `LWPOLYLINE`/`3DFACE`/`ELLIPSE`, and invalid `$INSUNITS`.
- **CAD & Geometry Lowering**: Flattens hierarchical `INSERT` transforms (base point, scale, rotation, translation), computes analytical path lengths, exact bulge arc geometry, enclosed polygon areas, 3D bounding boxes, `3DFACE` triangle meshes, and `@modelscript/cad` extruded/polyhedral `Assembly` solids.
- **Projections**: Standalone SVG (`dxfToSvg`) with AutoCAD Color Index (ACI) styling and ISO 10303-21 STEP (`dxfToStep`) via `@modelscript/cad`.
- **Cleanroom Standard Library**: Entity schemas (`LINE`, `ARC`, `CIRCLE`, `LWPOLYLINE`, `SPLINE`, `ELLIPSE`, `3DFACE`, `INSERT`), ACI color/layer presets, SVG block icons, and AssemblyScript `runtime.wasm` geometry kernel.
- **UnifiedWorkspace Indexing & LSP**: Document symbols, hover cards, completions, and diagnostic ranges.

## Quick Usage

```ts
import { parseDxf, lintDxf, analyzeDxfGeometry, lowerDxfToCad, dxfToSvg, dxfToStep } from "@modelscript/dxf";

const doc = parseDxf(dxfSource);
const diagnostics = lintDxf(doc);
const metrics = analyzeDxfGeometry(doc);
const svg = dxfToSvg(doc);
const step = dxfToStep(doc, { extrusionHeight: 10 });
```

# G-code / RS-274 (`.gcode`)

**Package:** `@modelscript/gcode` · **Maturity:** `Beta` · **Extensions:** `.gcode`

RS-274 / ISO 6983 G-code CNC Numerical Control language package for ModelScript (**Beta** tier).

## Features

- **Native WASM GLR Parser (`@modelscript/dsl`)**: Full RS-274 / ISO 6983 grammar supporting `%` tape delimiters, `O` program numbers, `N` line numbers, modal G-codes (`G00`–`G95`), M-codes (`M00`–`M99`), axis/arc words (`X/Y/Z/A/B/C/I/J/K/R`), `F/S/T/P/Q/L`, `#` parameters & expressions, and `( ... )` / `;` comments.
- **Static Analysis & Linting (`GC1001`–`GC5006`)**: Detects syntax errors, cutting moves with zero/unset feedrate or stopped spindle, invalid arc center/radius geometry, rapid plunges below workplane `Z < 0`, conflicting modal G-codes in the same block, missing `M02`/`M30` program end, and undefined `M98` subprograms.
- **3D Toolpath Kinematics & CAD Swept Volume (`@modelscript/cad`)**: Modal CNC state machine supporting `G20`/`G21` unit scaling, `G90`/`G91` distance modes, `G17`/`G18`/`G19` planes, helical `G02`/`G03` arcs, `G81`–`G83` canned drilling cycles, `M98`/`M99` subprograms, exact path length & cycle time, and 3D CAD swept-volume solid generation.
- **DAE Lowering (`@modelscript/runtime`)**: Lowers spindle power, cutting torque, material removal rate (MRR), and cumulative energy/volume ODEs directly into `DAEBuilder`.
- **2D/CAD Projections**: Exports toolpaths to annotated SVG and AutoCAD-compatible ASCII DXF.
- **Cleanroom Standard Library (`@modelscript/gcode-std-lib`)**: ISO 6983 G/M-code and canned-cycle schemas plus standard endmill/drill cutting-speed presets with AssemblyScript WASM runtime.
- **UnifiedWorkspace Indexing & LSP**: Diagnostics, document symbols, hover documentation, and completions.

# APT (ISO 4342) (`.apt`)

**Package:** `@modelscript/apt` · **Maturity:** `Beta` · **Extensions:** `.apt`

ModelScript **Beta** language package for **APT** (_Automatically Programmed Tools_, MIT Servomechanisms Laboratory 1957–1960s / ISO 4342 CNC part programming language).

## Features

- **Native WASM GLR Parser (`@modelscript/dsl`)**: Declarative grammar for APT part programs (`.apt`, `.aptsource`, `.cls`) covering header directives (`PARTNO`, `MACHIN`, `UNITS`, `INTOL`, `OUTTOL`), machining setup (`CUTTER`, `SPINDL`, `FEDRAT`, `COOLNT`, `RAPID`), analytic geometry definitions (`POINT`, `LINE`, `CIRCLE`, `PLANE`, `PATERN`), continuous-path and point-to-point motion statements (`FROM`, `GOTO`, `GODLTA`, `GO`, `GOLFT`, `GORGT`, `GOFWD`, `GOBACK`, `GOUP`, `GODOWN` with `TO`/`ON`/`PAST`/`TANTO` modifiers), `FINI`, and `$$` comments.
- **CLDATA Analytic Geometry Solver & CAD Lowering**: Evaluates 2D/3D analytic geometry intersections (line-line, line-circle tangency/intersection, fillet circles) with exact cutter radius offset (`TO`/`ON`/`PAST`/`TANTO`), generating CLDATA toolpaths and `@modelscript/cad` swept CSG assemblies.
- **DAE Machining Physics Lowering**: Lowers cutting power, material removal rate (MRR), spindle torque, feed progress ODE, and cycle time into `@modelscript/runtime` `DAEBuilder`.
- **Projections**: Compiles CLDATA toolpaths to **RS-274 G-code** (`G00`/`G01`/`G02`/`G03`, `M03`/`M05`/`M08`/`M30`) and standalone **SVG** toolpath diagrams.
- **Static Analysis & Linting (`APT1001`–`APT5006`)**: Validates syntax, duplicate labels, undefined geometry references, cutter/feed/spindle bounds, motion ordering, geometric non-intersection, and program termination.
- **Cleanroom Standard Library (`@modelscript/apt-std-lib`)**: Zero-I/O bundle of APT geometric and motion schemas with cleanroom SVG icons and AssemblyScript WASM runtime.
- **Indexing & LSP**: UnifiedWorkspace indexing, diagnostics, document symbols, hover, and completions.

# LS-DYNA / DYNA3D (`.k`)

LS-DYNA / DYNA3D (`.k`, `.key`, `.dyn`) Explicit Dynamics Keyword Deck language package for ModelScript (**Beta** tier).

## Capabilities

- **Native WASM GLR Parser (`src/language.ts`)**: Declarative `@modelscript/dsl` grammar compiled to `dist/parser.wasm` + `src-gen/bindings.{js,d.ts}` covering `*KEYWORD`, `*TITLE`, `*NODE`, `*ELEMENT_SOLID`, `*ELEMENT_SHELL`, `*ELEMENT_BEAM`, `*PART`, `*SECTION_*`, `*MAT_*`, `*BOUNDARY_SPC_*`, `*INITIAL_VELOCITY`, `*LOAD_NODE_POINT`, `*DEFINE_CURVE`, `*SET_NODE_LIST`, `*CONTROL_TERMINATION`, `*CONTROL_TIMESTEP`, `*DATABASE_GLSTAT`, `*END`, and `$` comments.

# ANSYS APDL (`.apdl`)

**Package:** `@modelscript/apdl` · **Maturity:** `Beta` · **Extensions:** `.apdl`

ANSYS APDL (ANSYS Parametric Design Language, 1970) frontend, parametric macro expander, direct-stiffness finite element solver, DAE lowering, cleanroom standard library, and LSP services for ModelScript.

## Features

- **WASM GLR Parser (`@modelscript/dsl`)**: Declarative grammar for APDL processors (`/PREP7`, `/SOLU`, `/POST1`, `/TITLE`, `/UNITS`, `FINISH`), element/material/section/geometry/mesh/BC commands (`ET`, `MP`, `R`, `SECTYPE`, `SECDATA`, `K`, `L`, `A`, `V`, `N`, `E`, `TYPE`, `MAT`, `REAL`, `ESIZE`, `LMESH`, `D`, `F`, `SF`, `ANTYPE`, `SOLVE`), parametric macros (`*SET`, `*DIM`, `*DO`/`*ENDDO`, `*IF`/`*ELSE`/`*ENDIF`, `*GET`, `param = expr`), and `!` comments.

- **Parametric Macro Expander & Direct-Stiffness FEA Solver**: Evaluates `*SET`, `*DO` loops, `*IF` branches, expressions, and `K`/`L`/`ESIZE`/`LMESH` line meshing; solves 2D/3D Euler-Bernoulli beam (`BEAM188`) and truss (`LINK180`) static equilibrium ($K u = F$) and modal eigenvalue ($\det(K - \omega^2 M) = 0$) problems.
- **DAE Lowering & Projections**: Lowers structural equilibrium and dynamic equations into `@modelscript/runtime` `DAEBuilder`, and projects APDL models to NASTRAN `.bdf` and Modelica.
- **Cleanroom Standard Library**: AssemblyScript WASM runtime and SVG block catalog for `LINK180`, `BEAM188`, `PLANE182`, `SHELL181`, `SOLID185`, `MASS21`, and `COMBIN14`.
- **Workspace Indexing & LSP**: Document symbols, diagnostics, hover documentation, and completions for `.apdl`, `.mac`, `.ans`, and `.cdb` files.

# NASA PLOT3D (`.xyz`)

**Package:** `@modelscript/plot3d` · **Maturity:** `Beta` · **Extensions:** `.xyz`

NASA Ames **PLOT3D** Multi-Block Structured CFD Grid & Solution Format (1982) language package for ModelScript (**Beta** tier).

## Capabilities

- **DSL WASM GLR Parser (`src/language.ts`)**: Declarative `@modelscript/dsl` grammar compiled to `dist/parser.wasm` + `src-gen/bindings.{js,d.ts}` for ASCII formatted `.xyz`/`.g` grids, `.q` conservative solutions (`FSMACH`, `ALPHA`, `RE`, `TIME`, $\rho, \rho u, \rho v, \rho w, e$), `.f` function files, and `.nam` variable-name metadata.
- **ASCII & Fortran Unformatted Binary Codecs (`src/parser/`)**: Full read/write support for single-block and multi-block 2D/3D grids and solutions in ASCII formatted text and Fortran unformatted binary (32-bit record markers, little/big endian, float32/float64).
- **Lints & Diagnostics (`src/errors.ts`, `src/lints/`)**: `P3D1001`–`P3D5006` covering syntax/EOF, binary record markers, non-positive `NI`/`NJ`/`NK`, coordinate/field count mismatches, negative Jacobian / inverted hexahedral cell volumes, $\rho \le 0$, $p \le 0$, grid/solution block mismatches, and invalid `FSMACH`/`RE`/`ALPHA`.
- **CFD Field Diagnostics & Nozzle Verifier (`src/solver/`)**: Structured-grid hexahedral cell volume & metric Jacobian evaluator, conservative-to-primitive converter ($p, T, M, C_p, p_0, T_0, \Delta s$), surface mass-flux integration ($\iint \rho \vec{u}\cdot d\vec{A}$), and quasi-1D isentropic nozzle solver/verifier.
- **DAE Lowering & Polyglot Projections (`src/dae/`, `src/projections/`)**: Finite-volume Euler conservation equations lowered directly into `@modelscript/runtime` `DAEBuilder`, plus projections to VTK Legacy ASCII (`STRUCTURED_GRID`), OpenFOAM `blockMeshDict`, and Modelica.
- **Cleanroom Standard Library (`src/catalog/`, `assets/plot3d-std-lib/`)**: Zero-I/O standard library schemas (`Grid3D`, `SolutionQ`, `FunctionF`, `IsentropicNozzle`, `FlatPlateMesh`) with cleanroom SVG icons and AssemblyScript WASM runtime.
- **UnifiedWorkspace Indexing & LSP (`src/indexing.ts`, `src/lsp.ts`)**: Document symbols, diagnostics, hover cards, and completions.

---

## CLI & Toolchain Integration

```bash
# Validate and lint NASA PLOT3D models

# Run package test suite (8 suites, Beta maturity)
pnpm --filter @modelscript/plot3d test
```

# TRNSYS (`.dck`)

**Package:** `@modelscript/trnsys` · **Maturity:** `Beta` · **Extensions:** `.dck`

ModelScript **Beta**-tier language package for **TRNSYS** (Transient System Simulation Tool `.dck` Deck, 1975).

## Features

- **Native WASM GLR Parser (`src/language.ts`, `src/parser/`)**: Declarative `@modelscript/dsl` grammar compiled to `dist/parser.wasm` + `src-gen/bindings.{js,d.ts}` supporting TRNSYS `.dck` control cards (`VERSION`, `CONSTANTS`, `EQUATIONS`, `SIMULATION`, `TOLERANCES`, `LIMITS`, `DFQ`, `WIDTH`, `LIST`/`NOLIST`, `MAP`, `UNIT n TYPE m`, `PARAMETERS`, `INPUTS` with `unit,output` connections, `DERIVATIVES`, `ASSIGN`, `END`, and `*`/`!` comments).
- **Semantic Diagnostics (`src/errors.ts`, `src/lints/`)**: `TRN1001`–`TRN5006` covering syntax errors, duplicate `UNIT` numbers, undefined `UNIT` or out-of-range output references in `INPUTS`, `PARAMETERS`/`INPUTS` count mismatches, missing `SIMULATION`/`END` cards, invalid timesteps/time ranges, undefined variables in `EQUATIONS`, and algebraic loop detection.
- **Direct DAE Arena Lowering (`src/dae/`)**: Lowers solar collector (Hottel-Whillier-Bliss), stratified storage tank energy balance, controller/pump, forcing/weather, and building thermal zone ODEs directly into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder`.
- **Transient Solver (`src/solver/`)**: Successive-substitution transient solver for coupled TRNSYS unit networks (`Type 1`, `Type 2`, `Type 3`, `Type 4`, `Type 14`, `Type 15`, `Type 25`, `Type 56`).
- **Cleanroom Standard Library (`src/catalog/`, `assets/trnsys-std-lib/`)**: `modelscript.yaml` package with schemas, parametric SVG icons, and AssemblyScript `runtime.wasm` for classic TRNSYS Types.
- **Projections (`src/projections/`)**: Modelica and EnergyPlus IDF code generation from parsed TRNSYS decks.
- **Unified Indexing & LSP (`src/indexing.ts`, `src/lsp.ts`)**: Workspace symbol indexing, diagnostics, document symbols, hover, and completions.

---

# DOE-2 BDL (`.bdl`)

**Package:** `@modelscript/doe2` · **Maturity:** `Beta` · **Extensions:** `.bdl`

DOE-2.1E / DOE-2.2 Building Description Language (BDL — LBNL, 1979) compiler, thermal envelope DAE lowering, ASHRAE heat-balance load solver, cleanroom standard library, and polyglot projections for ModelScript.

## Capabilities

- **Native WASM GLR Parser (`src/language.ts`, `src/parser/`)**: Parses DOE-2.1E/2.2 BDL decks (`INPUT LOADS`/`SYSTEMS`/`PLANT`/`ECONOMICS`, `TITLE`, `RUN-PERIOD`, `BUILDING-LOCATION`, `MATERIAL`, `LAYERS`, `CONSTRUCTION`, `GLASS-TYPE`, `DAY-SCHEDULE`, `WEEK-SCHEDULE`, `SCHEDULE`, `SPACE`, `EXTERIOR-WALL`, `ROOF`, `UNDERGROUND-WALL`, `WINDOW`, `DOOR`, `ZONE`, `SYSTEM`, `PLANT-EQUIPMENT`, `COMPUTE`, `STOP`, `..` terminators, `$` comments).
- **Linter & Diagnostics (`src/errors.ts`, `src/lints/`)**: Validates syntax, missing `..` terminators, duplicate object names, undefined `LAYERS`/`MATERIAL`/`CONSTRUCTION`/`GLASS-TYPE`/`SPACE` references, non-positive physical properties, schedule bounds, and missing `STOP` (`DOE1001`–`DOE5006`).
- **Linear-Memory DAE Lowering (`src/dae/`)**: Lowers multi-layer wall U-values, 3R2C envelope thermal capacitance, infiltration, solar gains, internal loads, and zone HVAC control directly into `DAEBuilder` (`@modelscript/runtime`).
- **ASHRAE Heat-Balance Load & HVAC Solver (`src/solver/`)**: Computes composite wall R/U-values, steady-state heating/cooling loads ($Q = (UA + \dot{m}c_p)\Delta T$), and transient 24-hour zone temperature and HVAC energy responses.
- **Cleanroom Standard Library (`src/catalog/`, `assets/doe2-std-lib/`)**: ASHRAE/DOE-2 materials (`MAT-CONCRETE`, `MAT-INSUL-R19`, `MAT-GYPSUM`, `MAT-BRICK`), glazing (`GLZ-DOUBLE-LOWE`), and HVAC systems (`PSZ`, `VAVS`, `PIU`, `FC`, `PTAC`) compiled with AssemblyScript WASM runtime and SVG block icons.
- **Projections (`src/projections/`)**: Exports DOE-2 BDL models to EnergyPlus IDF and Modelica `Modelica.Thermal.HeatTransfer` networks.
- **Workspace Indexing & LSP (`src/indexing.ts`, `src/lsp.ts`)**: Diagnostics, document symbols, hover tooltips, and code actions.

# CHEMKIN (`.ck`)

**Package:** `@modelscript/chemkin` · **Maturity:** `Beta` · **Extensions:** `.ck`

ModelScript **Beta**-tier language package for **CHEMKIN** (Sandia National Laboratories Gas-Phase & Surface Chemical Kinetics Deck format, `.inp`, `.ck`, `.therm`).

## Capabilities

- **Native WebAssembly GLR Parser** (`src/language.ts`, `dist/parser.wasm`): Declarative `@modelscript/dsl` grammar supporting `ELEMENTS`/`ELEM`, `SPECIES`/`SPEC`, `THERMO` (NASA-7 14-coefficient 4-line records), `REACTIONS`/`REAC` (energy & quantity unit headers, `<=>`/`=`/`=>`, third-body `(+M)`/`+M`, `DUPLICATE`/`DUP`, `LOW`, `TROE`, `SRI`, `REV`, `PLOG`, enhanced efficiencies), `END`, and `!` comments.
- **Static Analysis & Linting** (`src/errors.ts`, `src/lints/`): `CK1001`–`CK5006` diagnostics for syntax errors, duplicate elements/species, undeclared species/elements, stoichiometric element balance violations, undeclared duplicate reactions, missing thermo records, invalid NASA-7 temperature ranges ($T_{\text{low}} < T_{\text{mid}} < T_{\text{high}}$), and negative Arrhenius pre-exponential factors.
- **Linear-Memory DAE Lowering** (`src/dae/`): Compiles Arrhenius, Lindemann, Troe, and reversible mass-action kinetics ($dY_k/dt = \dot{\omega}_k W_k / \rho$) and adiabatic energy balance directly into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder`.
- **0D Adiabatic Batch Reactor Solver** (`src/solver/`): Constant-volume (isochoric) and constant-pressure (isobaric) stiff Rosenbrock23 ODE integrator with NASA-7 thermodynamic evaluation and equilibrium reverse rate consistency ($K_c = k_f / k_r$).
- **Cleanroom Standard Library** (`src/catalog/`, `assets/chemkin-std-lib/`): Zero-I/O registered IUPAC element atomic weights and cleanroom H2/O2/CH4 NASA-7 thermodynamic database (`H2`, `O2`, `H2O`, `OH`, `H`, `O`, `HO2`, `H2O2`, `CH4`, `CO`, `CO2`, `N2`) with AssemblyScript WASM runtime.
- **Projections** (`src/projections/`): Lossless translation to **Cantera YAML** and **Modelica**.
- **Workspace Indexing & LSP** (`src/indexing.ts`, `src/lsp.ts`): Document symbols, hover cards with NASA-7 properties, completions, and real-time diagnostics.

## Scripts

```bash
npm run build       # Build stdlib WASM + GLR parser WASM + TypeScript
npm run typecheck   # Type-check with tsc --noEmit
npm run lint        # Run ESLint over src/ and tests/
npm test            # Run full unit & analytical/combustion benchmark suite
```

# MDL Molfile / SDF (`.mol`)

**Package:** `@modelscript/molfile` · **Maturity:** `Beta` · **Extensions:** `.mol`

MDL Molfile (V2000 / V3000) & Structure-Data File (SDF) Chemical Structure Format (1979–1980s) for ModelScript.

## Features

- **Native WASM GLR Parser (`@modelscript/dsl`)**: Formal DSL grammar for MDL V2000 header/counts/atom/bond/property blocks (`M  CHG`, `M  ISO`, `M  RAD`, `M  END`), V3000 extended CTAB (`M  V30 BEGIN CTAB`/`ATOM`/`BOND`/`END CTAB`), and multi-record SDF (`> <TAG>` data items and `$$$$` delimiters).
- **Chemical Structure Lints (`MOL1001`–`MOL5006`)**: Validates syntax, `M  END` termination, atom/bond counts line parity, out-of-range bond indices, self-loop & duplicate bonds, unknown elements, bond order/stereo flags, formal charges, and atomic valence bounds.
- **Molecular Graph, 3D Geometry & Force-Field Analyzer**: Computes Hill molecular formula, IUPAC molecular weight, exact monoisotopic mass, implicit hydrogens, SSSR ring perception, 3D bond lengths/angles/dihedrals, and UFF/harmonic bond-stretch force-field energy.
- **Linear-Memory DAE Lowering**: Compiles harmonic molecular mechanics bond-stretch equations directly into `@modelscript/runtime` `DAEBuilder`.
- **Cross-Language Projections**: Projects Molfile/SDF records to canonical SMILES and Protein Data Bank (PDB) formats.
- **Cleanroom Standard Library**: Zero-I/O AssemblyScript WASM runtime and periodic table / canonical molecule schemas (Water, Ethanol, Benzene, Aspirin, Caffeine).
- **Indexing & LSP**: Full workspace indexing, diagnostics, document symbols, hover tooltips, and completions.

# Gaussian Input (`.gjf`)

**Package:** `@modelscript/gaussian` · **Maturity:** `Beta` · **Extensions:** `.gjf`

ModelScript **Beta**-tier language package for **Gaussian Input** (`.gjf` / `.com`) and **Internal Z-Matrix** quantum chemistry specifications (1970–present).

## Capabilities

- **WASM GLR Parser (`@modelscript/dsl`) & Line-Offset Deck Parser**: Link0 directives (`%chk`, `%mem`, `%nprocshared`, `%nproc`, `%rwf`), Route sections (`#`, `#p`, `#n`, `#t`, `method/basis`, `opt`, `freq`, `sp`, `td`, `scrf`, `pop`, `scf`), Title sections, Charge & Spin Multiplicity, Cartesian & Internal Z-Matrix geometries (including dummy atoms `X`), `Variables:` / `Constants:` blocks, `--Link1--` multi-step jobs, and `!` comments.
- **Static Analysis & Linter (`GAU1001`–`GAU5006`)**: Syntax validation, missing route section, electron-count charge/spin multiplicity parity verification, element validation, Z-matrix reference ordering & collinearity checks, bond length/angle bounds, and `%mem`/`%nproc` validation.
- **NeRF Kinematics & Vibrational Solver**: Natural Extension Reference Frame (NeRF) Z-matrix → 3D Cartesian conversion, inverse Cartesian → Z-matrix conversion, center-of-mass & principal moments of inertia ($I_A, I_B, I_C$) / rotational constants, and harmonic vibrational normal-mode analysis.
- **Direct DAE Arena Lowering**: Lowers molecular mechanics and harmonic vibrational normal-mode ODEs directly into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `IDaeBuilder`.
- **Chemical Format Projections**: Exports parsed/solved geometries to MDL Molfile V2000 (`.mol`), XYZ (`.xyz`), and PDB (`.pdb`).
- **Cleanroom Standard Library (`@modelscript/gaussian-std-lib`)**: Zero-I/O schemas, SVG block icons, and AssemblyScript WASM runtime for quantum chemistry methods (`HF`, `MP2`, `CCSD(T)`, `B3LYP`, `PBE0`, `M06-2X`) and basis sets (`STO-3G`, `3-21G`, `6-31G(d)`, `6-311++G(d,p)`, `cc-pVDZ`, `cc-pVTZ`).
- **Unified Indexing & LSP**: Diagnostics, document symbols, hover documentation, and completions.

# IEEE CDF & BPA IPF (`.cdf`)

**Package:** `@modelscript/ieee-cdf` · **Maturity:** `Beta` · **Extensions:** `.cdf`

Native ModelScript **Beta** language package for **IEEE Common Data Format (1973)** and **BPA IPF (Interactive Power Flow, 1970s)** power-flow network decks.

## Capabilities

- **WASM GLR Parser (`@modelscript/dsl`)**: Declarative grammar in `src/language.ts` compiled to `dist/parser.wasm` plus fixed-column and free-format parsers for IEEE CDF (`BUS DATA FOLLOWS`, `BRANCH DATA FOLLOWS`, `LOSS ZONES FOLLOWS`, `INTERCHANGE DATA FOLLOWS`, `TIE LINES FOLLOWS`, `-999`/`-99`/`-9`, `END OF DATA`) and BPA IPF (`B `, `BE`, `BQ`, `BS`, `L `, `T `, `E `, `R `, `C `).
- **Lints & Diagnostics (`CDF1001`–`CDF5006`)**: Structural, topological, and electrical validation including missing title/MVA base, missing `END OF DATA`, duplicate bus numbers, undefined branch endpoints, self-loops, zero-impedance branches, missing/multiple slack buses, out-of-bounds voltages, inverted PV $Q$ limits, and disconnected islands.
- **AC Newton-Raphson Power-Flow Solver**: Complex $Y_{\text{bus}}$ admittance matrix builder (nominal-$\pi$ lines, off-nominal tap transformers, phase shifters, bus shunts) and polar Newton-Raphson solver with PV reactive power ($Q_{\min}/Q_{\max}$) limit enforcement.
- **Linear-Memory DAE Lowering**: Direct lowering of bus voltage magnitudes, angles, and AC power-flow mismatch equations ($P_i(V,\theta) = P_{g,i}-P_{l,i}$, $Q_i(V,\theta) = Q_{g,i}-Q_{l,i}$) into `@modelscript/runtime` `DAEBuilder`.
- **Polyglot Projections**: Lossless export to MATPOWER v2 (`.m`), PSS/E v33 (`.raw`), and Modelica (`.mo`).
- **Cleanroom Standard Library (`@modelscript/ieee-cdf-std-lib`)**: Parametric bus/branch archetypes, deterministic SVG block icons, AssemblyScript WASM runtime, and embedded cleanroom IEEE 5-bus, IEEE 14-bus, and BPA 3-bus reference networks.
- **Workspace Indexing & LSP**: Diagnostics, document symbols, hover documentation, and completion items.

## Commands

```bash
npm run typecheck
npm run lint
npm test
```

# USACE HEC-1 (`.hc1`)

**Package:** `@modelscript/hec1` · **Maturity:** `Beta` · **Extensions:** `.hc1`

USACE **HEC-1** (Flood Hydrograph Package, 1968) card-deck language implementation for ModelScript at **Beta** tier.

## Features

- **Native WASM GLR Parser (`hec1Language`)**: Declarative `@modelscript/dsl` grammar compiled to `dist/parser.wasm` supporting all standard 2-character HEC-1 card codes (`ID`, `IT`, `IN`, `IO`, `KK`, `KM`, `KO`, `BA`, `PB`, `PI`, `PC`, `LU`, `LS`, `LE`, `UC`, `UD`, `US`, `BF`, `RM`, `RS`, `RD`, `HC`, `ZW`, `ZZ`, and `*` comment cards).
- **Fixed- & Free-Format Card Deck Parser**: Parses classic 8-column Fortran fixed-field card decks as well as comma- and whitespace-delimited free-format HEC-1 decks.
- **Static Linting & Validation (`HEC11001`–`HEC15006`)**: Validates time-interval and end cards, duplicate station IDs, positive drainage area, SCS Curve Number bounds, Muskingum weighting and stability ($\Delta t / (2K) \ge X$), precipitation presence, and `HC` combine topology.
- **Hydrologic Runoff & Routing Solver**:
  - SCS Curve Number rainfall-excess ($Q = (P - I_a)^2 / (P - I_a + S)$) with impervious area handling.
  - SCS Dimensionless (`UD`), Clark (`UC`), and Snyder (`US`) unit hydrograph convolution with exact volume conservation.
  - Multi-subreach Muskingum channel routing (`RM`) with exact mass conservation ($\int Q_{\text{out}}\,dt = \int Q_{\text{in}}\,dt$).
- **Linear-Memory DAE Arena Lowering**: Lowers watershed linear-reservoir storage ODEs, Muskingum channel routing ODEs, and hydrograph combine balances directly into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder`.
- **Polyglot Projections**: Converts HEC-1 card decks into USACE HEC-HMS `.basin`/`.met` files and executable Modelica `.mo` models.
- **Cleanroom Standard Library (`@modelscript/hec1-std-lib`)**: TR-55 SCS Curve Number tables (Hydrologic Soil Groups A–D), Clark/Snyder/SCS UH archetypes, and Muskingum routing blocks with AssemblyScript WASM runtime and SVG block icons.
- **Workspace Indexing & LSP**: UnifiedWorkspace indexing, document symbols, diagnostics, hover docs, and card-code completions.

# USACE HEC-2 (`.hc2`)

**Package:** `@modelscript/hec2` · **Maturity:** `Beta` · **Extensions:** `.hc2`

US Army Corps of Engineers **HEC-2** (_Water Surface Profiles_, Hydrologic Engineering Center, 1960s–1970s) open-channel hydraulics card-deck language package for ModelScript (**Beta** tier).

## Capabilities

- **DSL & Native WASM GLR Parser (`src/language.ts`, `src/parser/`)**: Declarative `@modelscript/dsl` grammar compiled to `dist/parser.wasm` plus dual fixed-format (classic 8-column Fortran punch-card layout) and free-format (comma/whitespace-delimited) HEC-2 deck parser supporting `T1`–`T3`, `J1`–`J6`, `NC`, `NH`, `NV`, `QT`, `X1`–`X5`, `GR`, `SB`, `BT`, `CI`, `EJ`, `ER`, and `C ` comment cards.
- **Hydraulic Lints (`src/errors.ts`, `src/lints/`)**: Diagnostic rules `HEC21001`–`HEC25006` covering syntax errors, missing `J1`/`EJ`/`ER` cards, non-positive Manning's $n$, `GR`/`X1` `NUMST` point count mismatches, non-monotonic station coordinates, out-of-bounds bank stations `STCHL`/`STCHR`, negative reach lengths, and non-positive discharge.
- **1D Standard Step Solver (`src/solver/`)**: Subdivided Manning conveyance ($K = \frac{\phi}{n} A R^{2/3}$), velocity weighting $\alpha$, Froude number, critical depth $y_c$, normal depth $y_n$, and 1D Standard Step Energy Equation ($WSE_2 + \alpha_2 V_2^2/2g = WSE_1 + \alpha_1 V_1^2/2g + h_e$) gradually-varied flow profile solver for both US Customary ($\phi = 1.486$, $g = 32.174\text{ ft/s}^2$) and SI ($\phi = 1.0$, $g = 9.80665\text{ m/s}^2$) units.
- **DAE Arena Lowering (`src/dae/`)**: Direct lowering of steady 1D Saint-Venant energy and continuity equations into `@modelscript/runtime` `DAEBuilder` linear memory.
- **Projections (`src/projections/`)**: Export HEC-2 card decks to modern HEC-RAS `.g01`/`.f01` files and Modelica steady hydraulics models.
- **Cleanroom Standard Library (`src/catalog/`, `assets/hec2-std-lib/`)**: Chow (1959) / USACE Manning's $n$ roughness schemas and bridge/culvert contraction & expansion loss schemas with cleanroom SVG icons and AssemblyScript `runtime.wasm`.
- **Workspace Indexing & LSP (`src/indexing.ts`, `src/lsp.ts`)**: Document symbols, diagnostics, hover documentation, card-code completions, and `UnifiedWorkspace` integration.

# SEG-Y (`.sgy`)

**Package:** `@modelscript/segy` · **Maturity:** `Beta` · **Extensions:** `.sgy`

SEG-Y Rev 0 / Rev 1 (Society of Exploration Geophysicists Seismic Data Format, 1975 / 2002) compiler, binary/textual codec, seismic signal processing solver, DAE lowering engine, cleanroom standard library, and LSP services for ModelScript.

## Features

- **WASM GLR Textual Header Parser** (`src/language.ts`): Declarative `@modelscript/dsl` grammar for 40-card 80-byte SEG-Y textual reel headers (`C 1`–`C40`, `CLIENT`, `LINE`, `AREA`, `SAMPLE INTERVAL`, `TRACE LENGTH`, `FORMAT`, `REV`, `END TEXTUAL HEADER`).
- **Full Binary SEG-Y Rev 0 / Rev 1 Codec** (`src/parser/`):
  - Bidirectional ASCII ↔ EBCDIC (IBM CP037) textual reel header codec with automatic encoding detection.
  - 3200-byte textual reel header, 400-byte big-endian binary reel header, optional extended textual headers, and 240-byte trace headers.
  - Exact IBM System/360 32-bit hexadecimal float ↔ IEEE-754 float32 codec (`format=1`), plus `int32` (`2`), `int16` (`3`), IEEE `float32` (`5`), and `int8` (`8`).
- **Domain Linter** (`src/errors.ts`, `src/lints/`): Diagnostics `SEGY1001`–`SEGY5006` for stream/syntax errors, truncated headers, unsupported sample format codes, invalid measurement systems, non-positive sample intervals/counts, trace sample mismatches, duplicate/non-monotonic trace sequence numbers, and NaN/Inf amplitudes.
- **Seismic Signal Processing Solver** (`src/solver/`): Ricker/Ormsby/Klauder wavelet synthesis, Normal Moveout (NMO) traveltime & trace flattening, radix-2 Cooley-Tukey FFT amplitude/phase spectrum, zero-phase bandpass filtering, and RMS/AGC trace gain.
- **DAE Lowering** (`src/dae/`): Direct linear-memory lowering of 1D acoustic wave propagation and convolutional seismic reflection models into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder`.
- **Projections** (`src/projections/`): Export to CSV, human-readable ASCII trace dumps, and LAS 2.0 well-tie logs.
- **Cleanroom Standard Library** (`assets/segy-std-lib/`): SEG-Y Rev 0/Rev 1 header field schemas (`JobID`, `SampleIntervalUs`, `SampleFormatCode`, `Inline3D`, `Crossline3D`, `CDP`, `OffsetM`) and standard seismic wavelets (`Ricker`, `Ormsby`, `Klauder`) with AssemblyScript WASM runtime.
- **Unified Indexing & LSP** (`src/indexing.ts`, `src/lsp.ts`): Workspace symbol indexing, diagnostics, document symbols, hover, and completions.

# FITS 4.0 (`.fits`)

**Package:** `@modelscript/fits` · **Maturity:** `Beta` · **Extensions:** `.fits`

NASA/IAU **Flexible Image Transport System (FITS 4.0)** language package for ModelScript (**Beta** tier).

## Capabilities

- **WASM GLR Parser (`src/language.ts`)**: Declarative `@modelscript/dsl` grammar for 80-character FITS header keyword cards (`SIMPLE`, `BITPIX`, `NAXIS`, `NAXISn`, `EXTEND`, `XTENSION`, `PCOUNT`, `GCOUNT`, `BSCALE`, `BZERO`, `TFIELDS`, `TTYPE`, `TFORM`, `CRVAL`, `CRPIX`, `CDELT`, `CTYPE`, `CD1_1`–`CD2_2`, `HISTORY`, `COMMENT`, `END`).
- **2880-Byte Binary HDU Codec (`src/parser/binary-hdu.ts`)**: Full big-endian encode/decode for Primary HDUs, `IMAGE` extensions, `TABLE` (ASCII) extensions, and `BINTABLE` (binary) extensions across `BITPIX` $\in \{8, 16, 32, 64, -32, -64\}$ with `BSCALE`/`BZERO` physical value scaling.
- **Lints & Diagnostics (`src/errors.ts`, `src/lints/`)**: `FITS1001`–`FITS5006` covering card length, non-ASCII characters, missing `SIMPLE`/`END`, invalid `BITPIX`, `NAXIS` mismatch, 2880-byte alignment, `XTENSION` without `EXTEND = T`, duplicate mandatory keywords, and incomplete WCS definitions.
- **WCS Astrometry & Photometry (`src/solver/`)**: Calabretta & Greisen (2002) forward/inverse celestial spherical projections (`TAN` gnomonic, `SIN` orthographic, `ARC` zenithal equidistant), great-circle angular separation, sigma-clipped image statistics, circular aperture photometry, and Planck blackbody / magnitude calibration.
- **Linear Memory DAE Lowering (`src/dae/`)**: Photometric flux calibration and Beer-Lambert radiative transfer equations lowered directly to `DAEBuilder`.
- **Projections (`src/projections/`)**: Export to CSV, JSON metadata, CCSDS cross-link metadata, and SVG image/WCS reticle previews.
- **Cleanroom Standard Library (`src/catalog/`, `assets/fits-std-lib/`)**: FITS 4.0 mandatory and WCS keyword schemas with SVG icons and AssemblyScript WASM runtime kernel.
- **Workspace Indexing & LSP (`src/indexing.ts`, `src/lsp.ts`)**: Multi-file indexing, diagnostics, document symbols, hover documentation, and keyword completions.

# NetCDF Classic / CDL (`.cdl`)

**Package:** `@modelscript/netcdf` · **Maturity:** `Beta` · **Extensions:** `.cdl`

**Maturity:** Beta · **Extensions:** `.cdl`, `.nc`, `.cdf` · **Docs:** [modelscript.org/languages/netcdf](https://modelscript.org/languages/netcdf)

Native **Unidata NetCDF Classic v1/v2 (CDF1 / CDF2) & CDL (Common Data form Language, 1988)** multidimensional array dataset compiler, binary codec, CF-1.x validator, field statistics & bilinear interpolation engine, direct `DAEBuilder` lowering, and interactive React + SVG 2D heatmap/contour viewer panel for ModelScript.

---

## Core Capabilities

- **CDL ASCII & Binary NetCDF Classic v1/v2 Codec (`parseCdl`, `formatCdl`, `decodeNetcdfBinary`, `encodeNetcdfBinary`)**:
  - Full Common Data form Language (`.cdl`) parsing for `dimensions:`, `variables:`, `data:`, `UNLIMITED` record dimensions, all Classic types (`byte`, `char`, `short`, `int`, `long`, `float`, `double`), global & variable attributes, and `//` comments.
  - Native big-endian IEEE-754 binary encoding and decoding for NetCDF Classic v1 (`CDF\x01`, 32-bit offsets) and v2 (`CDF\x02`, 64-bit offsets), including fixed and interleaved record-variable slabs.
  - Native WebAssembly GLR parser (`dist/parser.wasm`) compiled from `@modelscript/dsl` combinators.
- **CF-1.x & Structural Linter (`lintNetcdf`, `NetcdfErrorCode`)**:
  - 18 domain diagnostics (`NC1001`–`NC5006`) covering syntax/magic errors, duplicate dimensions/variables/attributes, undefined dimensions, non-positive dimension sizes, `UNLIMITED` placement rules, data count vs. shape mismatches, missing CF-1.x `units`/`long_name` metadata, and NaN/Inf `_FillValue` mismatches.
- **Multidimensional Field Solver (`sliceVariable`, `computeFieldStats`, `computeFieldRmse`, `bilinearInterpolate2D`, `unpackVariableValues`)**:
  - Arbitrary-axis array slicing, min/max/mean/variance/std/RMS/RMSE statistics with fill-value masking, CF `scale_factor`/`add_offset` unpacking, and exact 2D rectilinear bilinear interpolation.
- **Direct Continuous DAE Arena Lowering (`lowerNetcdfToDae`, `netcdfToDae`)**:
  - Lowers multidimensional field variables and conservation/relaxation dynamics directly into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `IDaeBuilder` linear memory arena.
- **Polyglot Projections (`netcdfToCsv`, `netcdfToPlot3d`, `netcdfToModelica`)**:
  - Projects NetCDF datasets to tidy CSV tables, NASA PLOT3D grid/solution blocks, and Modelica 3.x models.
- **Cleanroom CF-1.x Standard Library (`@modelscript/netcdf-std-lib`)**:
  - Declarative cleanroom schemas, deterministic SVG block icons, and AssemblyScript WASM runtime kernels for CF-1.x standard variables (`temperature`, `pressure`, `u_wind`, `v_wind`, `salinity`, `elevation`) and NetCDF Classic data types.
- **Interactive Visualization (`renderNetcdfHeatmapSvg`, `NetcdfPanel`)**:
  - Pure SVG 2D heatmap & contour isoline slice visualizer with Viridis perceptual colormap and colorbar legend, integrated into an interactive React panel (`@modelscript/design-tokens/panel`) with variable selector, slice scrubber, dimensions/variables/attributes inspector, and lints tab.

---

# NASA CDF (`.skt`)

**Package:** `@modelscript/nasa-cdf` · **Maturity:** `Beta` · **Extensions:** `.skt`

**Maturity:** Beta · **Extensions:** `.skt`, `.cdf` · **Docs:** [modelscript.org/languages/nasa-cdf](https://modelscript.org/languages/nasa-cdf)

Native **NASA Common Data Format (CDF v2/v3 & Skeleton Table `.skt`, 1985)** space-physics telemetry parser, binary record codec, ISTP/SPDF metadata linter, `CDF_EPOCH`/`CDF_TIME_TT2000` time-conversion & vector-field solver, linear-memory `DAEBuilder` lowering, polyglot CSV/FITS/CCSDS projections, and interactive multi-channel SVG strip-chart React panel for ModelScript.

---

## Core Capabilities

- **WASM GLR Skeleton Table Grammar & Parser (`nasaCdfLanguage`, `parseCdfSkeleton`, `formatCdfSkeleton`)**: Native WebAssembly GLR parser (`dist/parser.wasm`) for NASA CDF Skeleton Tables (`.skt`) covering `#header`, `#GLOBALattributes`, `#VARIABLEattributes`, `#variables`/`#zVariables`, `#end`, `CDF_REAL4`/`CDF_REAL8`/`CDF_INT4`/`CDF_EPOCH`/`CDF_TIME_TT2000`, `ROW_MAJOR`/`COLUMN_MAJOR`, and `!` comments.
- **Binary CDF v2/v3 Record Codec (`encodeCdfBinary`, `decodeCdfBinary`)**: Encodes and decodes binary CDF streams with v3 (`0xCDF30001`) and v2 (`0xCDF26002`) magic headers, CDR, GDR, ADR, AgrEDR, zVDR, AzEDR, VXR, and VVR records in big-endian network byte order.
- **ISTP/SPDF Linter (`lintNasaCdf`, `NasaCdfErrorCode`)**: 19 domain diagnostics (`NCDF1001`–`NCDF5006`) checking syntax/magic errors, missing `#header`/`#end`, duplicate variables and attributes, invalid CDF data types, ISTP `DEPEND_0`/`UNITS`/`VALIDMIN`/`VALIDMAX` compliance, valid-bound range checks, and non-monotonic `EPOCH`/`TT2000` timestamps.
- **Space-Physics Time & Field Solver (`isoToCdfEpoch`, `cdfEpochToJ2000Seconds`, `cdfEpochToTt2000`, `computeMagneticFieldMagnitude`, `analyzeNasaCdfTelemetry`)**: High-precision `CDF_EPOCH` and `CDF_TIME_TT2000` conversions, per-channel telemetry statistics (min, max, mean, RMS, stdDev), magnetic field magnitude $|B| = \sqrt{B_x^2 + B_y^2 + B_z^2}$, plasma $\beta$, and Alfvén speed.
- **Direct Continuous DAE Arena Lowering (`lowerNasaCdfToDae`)**: Lowers magnetometer and plasma telemetry balance equations directly into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder` (`varCount === eqCount`).
- **Polyglot Projections (`nasaCdfToCsv`, `nasaCdfToFits`, `nasaCdfToCcsds`)**: Exports CDF telemetry to RFC-4180 CSV, FITS 4.0 80-character headers, and CCSDS KVN tracking metadata.
- **Interactive Strip-Chart Viewer & React Panel (`renderNasaCdfStripChartSvg`, `NasaCdfPanel`)**: Pure SVG multi-channel time-series strip-chart renderer integrated into a React `@modelscript/design-tokens/panel` inspector with channel filtering, variable statistics, attribute tables, and lint diagnostics.

---

---

## Diagnostic Codes (`NCDF1001`–`NCDF5006`)

| Code       | Rule                             | Severity  | Description                                                              |
| :--------- | :------------------------------- | :-------- | :----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `NCDF1001` | `syntax-error`                   | `error`   | Syntax error or malformed skeleton table statement                       |
| `NCDF1002` | `invalid-magic-number`           | `error`   | Invalid binary CDF magic header (expected v3 `0xCDF30001` or v2)         |
| `NCDF1003` | `corrupt-record-structure`       | `error`   | Corrupt binary CDF CDR/GDR/VDR/VXR/VVR record length or offset           |
| `NCDF2001` | `missing-header-section`         | `error`   | Skeleton table is missing the mandatory `#header` section                |
| `NCDF2002` | `missing-end-section`            | `error`   | Skeleton table is missing the mandatory `#end` terminator                |
| `NCDF2003` | `duplicate-variable`             | `error`   | Duplicate variable name declared in `#variables`                         |
| `NCDF2004` | `duplicate-attribute`            | `error`   | Duplicate global or variable attribute name                              |
| `NCDF3001` | `invalid-cdf-data-type`          | `error`   | Unrecognized or unsupported CDF data type                                |
| `NCDF3002` | `dimension-mismatch`             | `error`   | Variable `numDims` disagrees with `dimSizes` or `dimVariances`           |
| `NCDF4001` | `istp-missing-depend-0`          | `warning` | ISTP data variable is missing `DEPEND_0` referencing a time variable     |
| `NCDF4002` | `istp-missing-units`             | `warning` | ISTP data variable is missing `UNITS` attribute                          |
| `NCDF4003` | `istp-missing-valid-bounds`      | `warning` | ISTP data variable is missing `VALIDMIN` or `VALIDMAX`                   |
| `NCDF4004` | `istp-invalid-depend-0-target`   | `error`   | `DEPEND_0` references an undefined or non-time variable                  |
| `NCDF5001` | `invalid-valid-bounds`           | `error`   | `VALIDMIN` is strictly greater than `VALIDMAX`                           |
| `NCDF5002` | `value-out-of-valid-range`       | `warning` | Sample value falls outside `[VALIDMIN, VALIDMAX]`                        |
| `NCDF5003` | `non-monotonic-epoch`            | `error`   | `CDF_EPOCH` or `CDF_TIME_TT2000` timestamps are not strictly monotonic   |
| `NCDF5004` | `missing-istp-global-attributes` | `info`    | Missing recommended ISTP global attributes (`Project`, `Source_name`...) |
| `NCDF5005` | `fillval-mismatch`               | `warning` | `FILLVAL` lies inside `[VALIDMIN, VALIDMAX]`                             |
| `NCDF5006` | `empty-data-records`             | `info`    | Record-varying variable contains zero data records                       |

---

## Programmatic Usage

```typescript
import {
  analyzeNasaCdfTelemetry,
  decodeCdfBinary,
  encodeCdfBinary,
  lintNasaCdf,
  lowerNasaCdfToDae,
  nasaCdfToCsv,
  parseCdfSkeleton,
  renderNasaCdfStripChartSvg,
} from "@modelscript/nasa-cdf";

const doc = parseCdfSkeleton(sktSource);
const diagnostics = lintNasaCdf(doc);
const summary = analyzeNasaCdfTelemetry(doc);
const binary = encodeCdfBinary(doc);
const roundTripped = decodeCdfBinary(binary);
const dae = lowerNasaCdfToDae(doc);
const csv = nasaCdfToCsv(doc);
const svg = renderNasaCdfStripChartSvg(doc);
```

# WMO GRIB Ed. 1 (`.grb`)

**Package:** `@modelscript/grib` · **Maturity:** `Beta` · **Extensions:** `.grb`

**Maturity:** Beta · **Extensions:** `.grb`, `.grib`, `.grib1` · **Docs:** [modelscript.org/languages/grib](https://modelscript.org/languages/grib)

Native **WMO GRIB Edition 1 (FM 92-VIII Ext. GRIB, 1985)** Gridded Binary Meteorological Format package for ModelScript. Features a native WebAssembly GLR parser for textual GRIB1 descriptor dumps, a full binary GRIB Edition 1 stream encoder/decoder (Section 0 Indicator, Section 1 PDS, Section 2 Lat/Lon GDS, Section 3 BMS bitmap, Section 4 BDS with IBM System/360 32-bit floating-point reference value and arbitrary-width bit-packing, and Section 5 `7777` trailer), meteorological diagnostics (geostrophic wind, hypsometric barometric thickness, area-weighted global mean), direct `DAEBuilder` atmospheric primitive-equation lowering, NetCDF CDL & CSV projections, WMO Table 2/3 cleanroom standard library, LSP services, and an interactive React + SVG geographic heatmap/isobar/wind-barb viewer (`GribPanel`).

---

## Core Capabilities

- **WASM GLR Textual Parser & Binary GRIB1 Codec (`parseGribDescriptor`, `decodeGrib1Binary`, `encodeGrib1Binary`)**:
  - Parses textual GRIB1 descriptor dumps (`GRIB`, `IS`, `PDS`, `GDS`, `BMS`, `BDS`, `7777`) via a native WebAssembly GLR grammar (`dist/parser.wasm`) and structured AST parser.
  - Encodes and decodes WMO FM 92-VIII binary GRIB1 byte streams including IBM System/360 32-bit base-16 floating-point reference values $R$, sign-magnitude scale factors $E$ and $D$, MSB-first bit-packing/unpacking, and BMS missing-data bitmaps.
- **GRIB1 Packing & Atmospheric Physics Solver (`unpackGrib1Values`, `packGrib1Values`, `computeHypsometricThickness`, `computeGeostrophicWind`, `computeAreaWeightedGlobalMean`)**:
  - Exact WMO GRIB1 unpacking relation $Y = (R + X \cdot 2^E) \cdot 10^{-D}$.
  - Hypsometric thickness $\Delta Z = \frac{R_d \bar{T}_v}{g_0} \ln(p_1 / p_2)$ and barometric height relations.
  - Mid-latitude geostrophic wind $(u_g, v_g) = \left(-\frac{g_0}{f}\frac{\partial Z}{\partial y}, \frac{g_0}{f}\frac{\partial Z}{\partial x}\right)$ and cosine-latitude area-weighted global mean.
- **Direct Linear-Memory DAE Lowering (`lowerGribToDae`)**:
  - Lowers hydrostatic balance, geostrophic balance, inertial momentum equations, and GRIB1 physical value scaling directly into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder` (`varCount === eqCount`).
- **Domain Linter (`lintGribDocument`, `GribErrorCode`)**:
  - 16 diagnostic rules (`GRIB1001`–`GRIB5006`) validating magic headers, `7777` trailers, edition conformance, PDS date/time & WMO Table 2 parameter codes, GDS/BMS/BDS grid dimension parity, latitude/longitude bounds, and bit-width limits.
- **Projections & Interactive Geographic Visualization (`gribToNetCdfCdl`, `gribToCsv`, `renderGribMapSvg`, `GribPanel`)**:
  - Projects gridded fields to NetCDF CDL and flat lat/lon CSV.
  - Renders pure SVG geographic scalar heatmaps with marching-squares isobar contours and wind barbs/vectors, integrated into `GribPanel` via `@modelscript/design-tokens/panel`.

---

## Diagnostic Rules (`GRIB1001`–`GRIB5006`)

| Code       | Rule                         | Severity  | Description                                                                        |
| :--------- | :--------------------------- | :-------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `GRIB1001` | `invalid-magic`              | `error`   | Missing or invalid `GRIB` Indicator Section magic header or syntax error.          |
| `GRIB1002` | `missing-trailer`            | `error`   | Missing mandatory `7777` End Section trailer.                                      |
| `GRIB1003` | `unsupported-edition`        | `error`   | Unsupported GRIB edition number (only Edition 1 is supported).                     |
| `GRIB2001` | `invalid-pds-date`           | `error`   | Invalid PDS reference date/time field (month, day, hour, or minute out of range).  |
| `GRIB2002` | `invalid-parameter-code`     | `error`   | Parameter indicator outside valid WMO Table 2 range (`1..254`).                    |
| `GRIB2003` | `invalid-level-type`         | `warning` | Unrecognized WMO Table 3 level/layer type indicator.                               |
| `GRIB3001` | `gds-bds-dimension-mismatch` | `error`   | GDS grid dimensions (`ni * nj` or BMS active points) do not match BDS value count. |
| `GRIB3002` | `invalid-lat-lon-bounds`     | `error`   | Geographic latitude outside `[-90, 90]` or longitude outside `[-180, 360]`.        |
| `GRIB3003` | `bms-length-mismatch`        | `error`   | BMS bitmap length does not match GDS grid point count `ni * nj`.                   |
| `GRIB4001` | `invalid-bit-width`          | `error`   | BDS bit-width per value is negative or exceeds 32 bits.                            |
| `GRIB4002` | `invalid-scale-factor`       | `warning` | Extreme binary (`                                                                  | E   | > 64`) or decimal (` | D   | > 16`) scale factor. |
| `GRIB5001` | `missing-pds`                | `error`   | GRIB message is missing the mandatory Product Definition Section (PDS).            |
| `GRIB5002` | `missing-bds`                | `error`   | GRIB message is missing the mandatory Binary Data Section (BDS).                   |
| `GRIB5003` | `non-finite-data`            | `error`   | BDS data array contains non-finite (`NaN` or `Infinity`) values.                   |
| `GRIB5004` | `truncated-binary-message`   | `error`   | Binary GRIB1 message is truncated before its declared total length.                |
| `GRIB5005` | `invalid-grid-increment`     | `warning` | Non-positive grid increment (`di <= 0` or `dj <= 0`) on a regular lat/lon grid.    |
| `GRIB5006` | `physical-range-warning`     | `warning` | Unpacked values fall outside expected meteorological physical bounds.              |

# WMO BUFR (`.bufr`)

**Package:** `@modelscript/bufr` · **Maturity:** `Beta` · **Extensions:** `.bufr`

**Maturity:** Beta · **Extensions:** `.bufr`, `.bfr`, `.bufr.txt` · **Docs:** [modelscript.org/languages/bufr](https://modelscript.org/languages/bufr)

Native **WMO FM 94 BUFR (Binary Universal Form for the Representation of Meteorological Data, 1988)** parser, binary Edition 3/4 bit-stream codec, descriptor tree expander, atmospheric thermodynamic & ISA hypsometric QA solver, linear-memory `DAEBuilder` lowering, meteorological linter (`BUFR1001`–`BUFR5006`), CSV/EPW projections, and interactive SVG/React upper-air sounding & WMO station-plot viewer for ModelScript.

---

## Core Capabilities

- **WASM GLR Parser & Textual BUFR Grammar (`bufrLanguage`, `parseBufrText`)**: Parses structured BUFR messages (`BUFR`, `SECTION 0..5`, `TABLE_B`, `TABLE_D`, `F-X-Y` descriptors such as `0-01-001`, `1-02-003`, `2-01-130`, `3-01-001`, `3-09-052`, `SUBSET`, `7777`, `#` comments).
- **WMO BUFR Edition 3 & 4 Binary Bit-Stream Codec (`encodeBufrBinary`, `decodeBufrBinary`, `BitWriter`, `BitReader`)**: Bit-accurate packing and unpacking of Sections 0, 1, 3, 4, and 5 (`BUFR`..`7777`) with Table B `scale`, `referenceValue`, `bitWidth`, CCITT IA5 strings, missing-value all-1s encoding, delayed replication (`1-XX-000` + `0-31-001`/`0-31-002`), and Table C operators (`2-01-YYY`, `2-02-YYY`).
- **Descriptor Tree Expander & Meteorological QA Solver (`expandBufrDescriptors`, `solveBufrMeteorology`)**: Expands Table D sequences (including radiosonde `3-09-052` and SYNOP `3-07-080`), evaluates Magnus-Tetens saturation vapor pressure, dewpoint, and relative humidity, and verifies International Standard Atmosphere (ISA) pressure-altitude and hypsometric thickness.
- **Direct Continuous DAE Arena Lowering (`lowerBufrToDae`, `bufrToDae`)**: Lowers ideal gas density, potential temperature $\theta = T (P_0 / P)^\kappa$, hydrostatic balance $dP/dt = -\rho g_0 w_{\text{ascent}}$, and wind $(u, v)$ components directly into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `IDaeBuilder`.
- **Meteorological & Structural Linter (`lintBufr`, `BufrErrorCode`)**: 14 diagnostics (`BUFR1001`–`BUFR5006`) covering magic header, missing `7777` sentinel, invalid `F/X/Y` bounds, unknown Table B/D descriptors, subset count mismatches, delayed replication errors, and physical meteorological range violations.
- **Projections (`bufrToCsv`, `bufrToEpw`)**: Exports decoded station summaries or sounding profiles to RFC-4180 CSV and EnergyPlus EPW weather snippets.
- **Interactive Sounding & Station Viewer (`renderBufrSoundingSvg`, `BufrPanel`)**: Pure SVG log-P vertical temperature/dewpoint profile with wind barbs and WMO station-plot model, embedded in a React panel built with `@modelscript/design-tokens/panel`.

---
