# USGS DEM (`.dem`)

**Package:** `@modelscript/usgs-dem` · **Maturity:** `Beta` · **Extensions:** `.dem`

**Maturity:** Beta · **Extensions:** `.dem`, `.usgs-dem` · **Docs:** [modelscript.org/languages/usgs-dem](https://modelscript.org/languages/usgs-dem)

Native **USGS Digital Elevation Model (DEM)** ASCII Terrain Format (1970s–1980s, USGS Data Users Guide 5) parser, WASM GLR grammar, geomorphometric solver, `@modelscript/cad` solid terrain lowerer, Manning kinematic-wave overland runoff DAE lowerer, and interactive React + SVG elevation map viewer for ModelScript.

---

## Core Capabilities

- **WASM GLR Grammar & Dual-Format Parser (`usgsDemLanguage`, `parseUsgsDem`, `serializeUsgsDem`)**: Parses both 1024-byte fixed-column USGS DEM tape records (with Fortran `D` exponents) and free-format `TYPE_A` / `TYPE_B` / `TYPE_C` ASCII decks.
- **Semantic & Structural Linter (`lintUsgsDem`, `UsgsDemErrorCode`)**: Validates `DEM1001`–`DEM5006` (syntax errors, ground reference system codes, planimetric/elevation units, positive `dx/dy/dz` resolution, missing or mismatched Type B profiles, elevation bounds, UTM zone, and Type C RMSE).
- **CAD Terrain Mesh & Solid Lowering (`buildTerrainMesh`, `lowerUsgsDemToCadSolid`)**: Triangulates regular DEM grids into surface meshes with exact surface area, planar area, and prism volume above datum, and lowers to watertight `@modelscript/cad` `PolyhedronSolid`.
- **Topographic & Geomorphometric Solver (`interpolateElevation`, `computeHornSlopeAspect`, `computeTerrainGridMetrics`, `computeD8Flow`, `computeHypsometricIntegral`, `extractElevationProfile`)**:
  - Bilinear elevation interpolation
  - Horn (1981) 3×3 finite-difference slope & compass aspect gradients
  - D8 steepest-descent flow direction & topological flow accumulation
  - Strahler hypsometric integral & cross-section transect extraction
- **DAE Lowering (`lowerUsgsDemToDae`, `usgsDemToDae`)**: Lowers watershed overland runoff Manning kinematic-wave continuity and discharge equations directly into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder`.
- **Polyglot Projections (`usgsDemToStl`, `usgsDemToObj`, `usgsDemToHec1`)**: Exports watertight ASCII STL, Wavefront OBJ, and USACE HEC-1 subbasin summary decks.
- **Cleanroom Standard Library (`@modelscript/usgs-dem-std-lib`)**: Zero-I/O datum/projection schemas (UTM NAD27/NAD83, Geographic arc-seconds, State Plane, Albers), canonical synthetic terrain benchmarks (`generateGaussianHillDem`, `generateInclinedPlaneDem`, `generateVValleyDem`), and AssemblyScript WASM runtime.
- **Interactive Visualization (`renderUsgsDemMapSvg`, `UsgsDemPanel`)**: Pure SVG hypsometric-tint elevation map with marching-squares contour lines, interactive N–S cross-section profile, and React panel built on `@modelscript/design-tokens/panel`.

# NCSA HDF4 (`.hdf`)

**Package:** `@modelscript/hdf4` · **Maturity:** `Beta` · **Extensions:** `.hdf`

**Maturity:** Beta · **Extensions:** `.hdf`, `.h4`, `.hdf4`, `.eos` · **Docs:** [modelscript.org/languages/hdf4](https://modelscript.org/languages/hdf4)

Native **NCSA HDF4 (Hierarchical Data Format v4, 1987)** scientific data container, DDL schema language, binary DDH/DD codec, NASA EOS-HDF swath/grid standard library, and interactive SVG/React visualization package for ModelScript. Features full big-endian HDF4 binary encoding/decoding (4-byte magic `0x0e031301`, DDH/DD tag-ref-offset-length descriptor blocks, `DFTAG_NDG`/`DFTAG_SD`/`DFTAG_VG`/`DFTAG_VH`/`DFTAG_VS`), WASM GLR parser for HDF4 DDL/SDS textual schemas, Vgroup hierarchy traversal, N-D SDS slicing & statistics, direct linear-memory `DAEBuilder` lowering, 17 domain lint rules (`HDF1001`–`HDF5006`), NetCDF CDL & CSV projections, and an interactive React + SVG viewer/editor panel (`Hdf4Panel`).

---

## Core Capabilities

- **WASM GLR Parser & Dual Textual/Binary Codec (`parseHdf4Ddl`, `encodeHdf4Binary`, `decodeHdf4Binary`)**:
  - Textual HDF4 DDL grammar (`HDF4`, `SDS`, `VGROUP`, `VDATA`, `RASTER8`, `PALETTE`, `DIM`, `ATTR`, `DATA`, `MEMBER`, `END`, `#` comments) compiled to native `dist/parser.wasm`.
  - Binary NCSA HDF4 stream encoder/decoder supporting magic `0x0e031301`, chained DDH/DD blocks, and standard tags (`DFTAG_NDG`, `DFTAG_SDD`, `DFTAG_SD`, `DFTAG_NT`, `DFTAG_VG`, `DFTAG_VH`, `DFTAG_VS`, `DFTAG_ID8`, `DFTAG_RI8`, `DFTAG_IP8`).
- **Solver & Scientific Array Analytics (`traverseVgroupHierarchy`, `sliceSds`, `computeSdsStatistics`, `analyzeHdf4Document`)**:
  - Cycle-safe Vgroup hierarchy traversal, N-dimensional SDS hyperslab slicing, and exact min/max/mean/variance/std/RMSE statistics.
- **Direct Continuous DAE Arena Lowering (`hdf4ToDae`, `lowerHdf4ToDae`)**:
  - Lowers scientific dataset statistics and conservation/balance equations directly into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder`.
- **Domain Linter (`lintHdf4`, `Hdf4ErrorCode`)**:
  - 17 diagnostics (`HDF1001`–`HDF5006`) covering syntax/magic validation, duplicate tag/ref or SDS names, undefined Vgroup members, cyclic Vgroup hierarchies, SDS data count mismatches, invalid `DFNT_*` type codes, and non-positive dimension sizes.
- **Projections (`hdf4ToNetcdfCdl`, `hdf4ToCsv`)**:
  - Projects HDF4 hierarchies and SDS datasets to NetCDF CDL and RFC-4180 CSV.
- **Cleanroom Standard Library (`@modelscript/hdf4-std-lib`)**:
  - Core HDF4 object tag schemas (`SDS`, `Vgroup`, `Vdata`, `Raster8`, `Palette`, `NDG`) and NASA EOS-HDF swath/grid archetypes (`EOS_SWATH`, `EOS_GRID`, `EOS_POINT`, `MODIS_L1B`, `AIRS_L2`, `LANDSAT_TM`) with deterministic SVG block icons and AssemblyScript WASM runtime.
- **Interactive SVG Diagram & React Panel (`renderHdf4DiagramSvg`, `Hdf4Panel`)**:
  - Pure SVG Vgroup/SDS hierarchy diagram + 2D SDS dataset heatmap with color bar, wrapped in an interactive React panel built on `@modelscript/design-tokens/panel`.

# ARINC 429 (`.a429`)

**Package:** `@modelscript/arinc429` · **Maturity:** `Beta` · **Extensions:** `.a429`

**Maturity:** Beta · **Extensions:** `.a429`, `.arinc429`, `.429` · **Docs:** [modelscript.org/languages/arinc429](https://modelscript.org/languages/arinc429)

Native **ARINC 429 (Mark 33 Digital Information Transfer System, 1977)** commercial avionics data bus schema, 32-bit binary word codec, flight-state kinematic DAE lowering, and Primary Flight Display (PFD) visualization package for ModelScript.

---

## Core Capabilities

- **WASM GLR Parser (`arinc429Language`)**: Declarative `@modelscript/dsl` grammar compiled to WebAssembly (`dist/parser.wasm`) for ARINC 429 bus schema and trace files (`BUS`, `RATE HIGH|LOW`, `LABEL` octal `001`–`377`, `SDI`, `ENCODING BNR|BCD|DISCRETE`, `RANGE`, `RESOLUTION`, `UNITS`, `FRAME`/`WORD` hex 32-bit words, `#` comments).
- **Exact 32-Bit ARINC 429 Word Codec (`encodeArinc429Word`, `decodeArinc429Word`)**:
  - **Bits 1–8**: 8-bit bit-reversed octal label (`001`–`377`)
  - **Bits 9–10**: 2-bit Source/Destination Identifier (`SDI`, `0..3`)
  - **Bits 11–29**: 19-bit two's-complement `BNR`, 5-digit `BCD` (3+4+4+4+4 bits), or `DISCRETE` payload
  - **Bits 30–31**: 2-bit Sign/Status Matrix (`SSM`)
  - **Bit 32**: Odd parity bit across all 32 bits
- **Avionics Bus Linter (`lintArinc429`, `Arinc429ErrorCode`)**: Diagnostics `A4291001`–`A4295006` verifying syntax, odd parity, octal label bounds, BCD nibble validity, SSM Failure Warning (`00`) / No Computed Data (`01`), duplicate label definitions, and bus bandwidth utilization against 12.5 kbps (LOW) or 100 kbps (HIGH) including the 4-bit inter-word gap (36 bit-times/word).
- **Flight-State Decoding & Bus Utilization Solver (`decodeFlightState`, `analyzeBusUtilization`)**: Decodes standard Air Data Computer (`203`, `205`, `206`, `211`), Inertial Reference System (`310`, `311`, `314`, `324`, `325`), and Radio Altimeter (`164`) telemetry and computes bus throughput and timing margins.
- **Direct Linear-Memory DAE Lowering (`arinc429ToDae`, `lowerArinc429ToDae`)**: Lowers 3D flight-state kinematic equations directly into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder`.
- **Telemetry Projections (`arinc429ToCsv`, `arinc429ToJsbsimTelemetry`)**: Exports decoded traces to CSV and JSBSim telemetry property format.
- **Interactive SVG & React Panel (`renderArinc429Svg`, `renderArinc429WordSvg`, `renderArinc429PfdSvg`, `Arinc429Panel`)**: Pure SVG 32-bit bit-field inspector and Primary Flight Display (artificial horizon, airspeed tape, altitude tape, heading strip) integrated with `@modelscript/design-tokens/panel`.

---

## 32-Bit ARINC 429 Word Bit Layout

| Bit(s) (1-indexed) | Width | Field  | Description                                                      |
| :----------------- | :---- | :----- | :--------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `32`               | 1     | `P`    | Odd parity bit (total 1-bits across all 32 bits must be odd)     |
| `31..30`           | 2     | `SSM`  | Sign/Status Matrix (`00` FW, `01` NCD, `10` FT, `11` Normal BNR) |
| `29..11`           | 19    | `DATA` | 19-bit two's-complement BNR, 5-digit BCD, or Discrete bitmask    |
| `10..9`            | 2     | `SDI`  | Source/Destination Identifier (`00`, `01`, `10`, `11`)           |
| `8..1`             | 8     | `LBL`  | Bit-reversed octal label (`001`–`377`, transmitted MSB-first)    |

---

## Diagnostic Codes (`A4291001`–`A4295006`)

| Code       | Rule                     | Severity  | Description                                                    |
| :--------- | :----------------------- | :-------- | :------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `A4291001` | `syntax-error`           | `error`   | Syntax error in ARINC 429 bus schema or trace file.            |
| `A4292001` | `invalid-octal-label`    | `error`   | Label is not a valid 3-digit octal identifier in `001`–`377`.  |
| `A4292002` | `duplicate-label`        | `error`   | Duplicate label/SDI definition on the same bus.                |
| `A4293001` | `parity-error`           | `error`   | 32-bit ARINC 429 word violates odd-parity check (bit 32).      |
| `A4293002` | `invalid-bcd-nibble`     | `error`   | BCD data field contains a nibble greater than 9 (`0xA`–`0xF`). |
| `A4294001` | `ssm-failure-warning`    | `warning` | SSM indicates Failure Warning (`00` BNR / `11` DISCRETE).      |
| `A4294002` | `ssm-no-computed-data`   | `warning` | SSM indicates No Computed Data (`01`).                         |
| `A4295001` | `bus-bandwidth-exceeded` | `error`   | Scheduled bus bandwidth exceeds 100% of bus capacity.          |
| `A4295002` | `bus-bandwidth-high`     | `warning` | Scheduled bus bandwidth exceeds 80% engineering safety margin. |
| `A4295003` | `unknown-word-label`     | `warning` | Trace word references a label not declared in the bus schema.  |
| `A4295004` | `range-exceeded`         | `warning` | Decoded value exceeds declared label engineering range.        |
| `A4295005` | `invalid-sdi`            | `error`   | SDI value is outside the valid 2-bit range (`0`–`3`).          |
| `A4295006` | `missing-bus-rate`       | `warning` | Bus rate not specified; defaulting to `LOW` (12.5 kbps).       |

---

## Programmatic Usage

```typescript
import {
  parseArinc429,
  encodeArinc429Word,
  decodeArinc429Word,
  lintArinc429,
  decodeFlightState,
  analyzeBusUtilization,
  arinc429ToDae,
  renderArinc429Svg,
} from "@modelscript/arinc429";

const doc = parseArinc429(`
BUS ADC_BUS_1
RATE HIGH
LABEL 203 ALTITUDE ENCODING BNR SDI 0 RANGE 131072 RESOLUTION 0.5 UNITS ft RATE 20
FRAME 0.000 WORD 0xE0C350C1
`);

const diagnostics = lintArinc429(doc);
const flight = decodeFlightState(doc);
const utilization = analyzeBusUtilization(doc);
const dae = arinc429ToDae(doc);
const svg = renderArinc429Svg(doc);
```

# NMEA 0183 (`.nmea`)

**Package:** `@modelscript/nmea0183` · **Maturity:** `Beta` · **Extensions:** `.nmea`

**Maturity:** Beta · **Extensions:** `.nmea`, `.nme`, `.gps`, `.log` · **Docs:** [modelscript.org/languages/nmea0183](https://modelscript.org/languages/nmea0183)

Native **NMEA 0183 (National Marine Electronics Association 0183, 1983)** ASCII marine navigation & GNSS telemetry parser, WGS-84 geodesic solver, continuous DAE trajectory kinematics lowering, telemetry linter, polyglot projections (CSV, GPX 1.1, OpenDRIVE), and interactive 2D GPS ground-track + polar satellite skyplot viewer for ModelScript.

---

## Core Capabilities

- **WASM GLR Parser & Typed Telemetry Decoder (`nmea0183Language`, `parseNmea0183`)**: Parses standard `$` and `!` NMEA 0183 sentences with 2-character talker IDs (`GP`, `GN`, `GL`, `GA`, `HC`, `SD`, `II`, `AI`, `GB`, `BD`, `HE`, `WI`) and 3-character formatters (`GGA`, `RMC`, `GSA`, `GSV`, `VTG`, `HDG`, `DBT`, `MWV`), comma-separated fields, and `*XX` hex XOR checksums.
- **WGS-84 Geodesy & Track Kinematics Solver (`vincentyInverse`, `haversineDistance`, `geodeticToEcef`, `ecefToGeodetic`, `geodeticToEnu`, `solveNmeaTrack`)**: Exact iterative Vincenty inverse geodesic distance and azimuth on the WGS-84 reference ellipsoid ($a = 6378137\text{ m}$, $f = 1/298.257223563$), Haversine spherical distance, ECEF $(X, Y, Z)$ round-trip transformations, local East-North-Up (ENU) coordinates, and multi-epoch speed/course kinematics.
- **Direct Continuous DAE Arena Lowering (`lowerNmea0183ToDae`, `nmea0183ToDae`)**: Lowers 2D/3D vehicle trajectory kinematics ($\dot{p}_e = v_e$, $\dot{p}_n = v_n$, $\dot{p}_u = v_u$, $\dot{s} = v$, $\dot{v}_e = a_e$, $\dot{v}_n = a_n$, $\dot{v}_u = a_u$) directly into `@modelscript/runtime`'s linear-memory `IDaeBuilder`.
- **Telemetry Integrity Linter (`lintNmea0183`, `Nmea0183ErrorCode`)**: 14 domain diagnostics (`NMEA1001`–`NMEA5006`) checking syntax, XOR `*XX` checksum parity, 82-character sentence length limits, `ddmm.mmmm` coordinate range, void/invalid GPS fix status, high HDOP (`> 5.0`), non-monotonic UTC timestamps, unknown talkers/formatters, satellite geometry, and unrealistic speeds.
- **Cleanroom Standard Library (`@modelscript/nmea0183-std-lib`)**: Zero-I/O standard library bundle with parametric SVG block icons, schema metadata, and AssemblyScript WASM runtime for `GGA`, `RMC`, `GSA`, `GSV`, `VTG`, `HDG`, `DBT`, and `MWV`.
- **Polyglot Projections (`nmea0183ToCsv`, `nmea0183ToGpx`, `nmea0183ToOpenDrive`)**: Projects decoded GNSS tracks to RFC 4180 CSV, GPX 1.1 XML, and ASAM OpenDRIVE `.xodr` road trajectory geometry.
- **Interactive SVG Visualization & React Panel (`renderNmea0183Svg`, `Nmea0183Panel`)**: Pure SVG 2D GPS ground-track map + polar satellite skyplot (from `GSV` azimuth/elevation/SNR) embedded in a full React panel using `@modelscript/design-tokens/panel`.

| `NMEA5005` | `invalid-satellite-geometry` | Warning  | Satellite azimuth/elevation out of physical bounds               |
| `NMEA5006` | `unrealistic-speed`          | Warning  | Speed over ground exceeds plausible marine/surface threshold     |

# RINEX v2 (`.obs`)

**Package:** `@modelscript/rinex` · **Maturity:** `Beta` · **Extensions:** `.obs`

**Maturity:** Beta · **Extensions:** `.obs`, `.nav`, `.rnx`, `.24o`, `.24n`, `.25o`, `.25n`, `.o`, `.n` · **Docs:** [modelscript.org/languages/rinex](https://modelscript.org/languages/rinex)

Native **RINEX v2 (Receiver Independent Exchange Format, Gurtner et al. 1989)** GNSS/GPS observation (`OBS`) and navigation (`NAV`) compiler, ICD-GPS-200 broadcast Keplerian orbit propagator, Gauss-Newton weighted least-squares 3D receiver position & DOP solver, direct linear-memory `DAEBuilder` lowering, domain linter (`RNX1001`–`RNX5006`), polyglot projections (NMEA 0183, CCSDS OEM, CSV), and interactive SVG polar skyplot & residual viewer for ModelScript.

---

## Core Capabilities

- **WASM GLR Grammar & Fixed-Column RINEX v2 Parser (`rinexLanguage`, `parseRinex`, `parseRinexObs`, `parseRinexNav`)**:
  - Formal `@modelscript/dsl` grammar compiled to native WebAssembly (`dist/parser.wasm`)
  - Full 60-character data + 20-character label header parsing (`RINEX VERSION / TYPE`, `PGM / RUN BY / DATE`, `MARKER NAME`, `APPROX POSITION XYZ`, `ANTENNA: DELTA H/E/N`, `# / TYPES OF OBSERV`, `TIME OF FIRST OBS`, `ION ALPHA`, `ION BETA`, `END OF HEADER`)
  - Multi-epoch observation blocks (handling continuation lines, LLI, signal strength indicators) and 8-line GPS broadcast Keplerian ephemeris records (including Fortran `D` exponents)
- **ICD-GPS-200 Orbit Propagator & Gauss-Newton 3D Fix Solver (`computeSatelliteEcef`, `solveReceiverPosition`, `solveRinexEpoch`)**:
  - Broadcast Keplerian ephemeris propagation to WGS-84 ECEF $(X_s, Y_s, Z_s)$ with harmonic perturbations ($C_{uc}, C_{us}, C_{rc}, C_{rs}, C_{ic}, C_{is}$) and relativistic clock correction $\Delta t_r = F_{\text{rel}} e \sqrt{A} \sin E_k$
  - Weighted least-squares Gauss-Newton 3D fix $(X, Y, Z, c\delta t)$ from $\ge 4$ pseudoranges with Sagnac Earth-rotation compensation, WGS-84 geodetic conversion, and GDOP/PDOP/HDOP/VDOP/TDOP computation
- **Direct Continuous DAE Arena Lowering (`rinexToDae`, `lowerRinexToDae`)**:
  - Lowers nonlinear pseudorange observation equations $\sqrt{(X_{s,i} - x)^2 + (Y_{s,i} - y)^2 + (Z_{s,i} - z)^2} + c\delta t = P_i + c\Delta t_{sv,i}$ directly into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder`
- **GNSS Domain Linter (`lintRinex`, `RinexErrorCode`)**:
  - Diagnostics `RNX1001`–`RNX5006` validating syntax, required headers, RINEX version, satellite geometry ($< 4$ satellites), PRN validity, monotonic epochs, pseudorange bounds ($15{,}000\text{–}35{,}000\,\text{km}$), and orbital eccentricity ($e \ge 1$)
- **Polyglot Projections (`rinexToNmea`, `rinexToCcsdsOem`, `rinexToCsv`)**:
  - Exports fixes and orbits to NMEA 0183 (`$GPGGA`/`$GPGSA`), CCSDS Orbit Ephemeris Message (`CCSDS_OEM_VERS = 2.0`), and tabular CSV
- **Interactive SVG Polar Skyplot & React Panel (`renderRinexSkyplotSvg`, `RinexPanel`)**:
  - Renders a pure SVG polar GNSS constellation skyplot (elevation rings, azimuth compass, PRN markers) paired with a pseudorange residual bar chart inside `@modelscript/design-tokens/panel`

---

# IRIG 106 / TMATS (`.tmats`)

**Package:** `@modelscript/irig106` · **Maturity:** `Beta` · **Extensions:** `.tmats`

**Maturity:** Beta · **Extensions:** `.tmats`, `.tmt`, `.tma` · **Docs:** [modelscript.org/languages/irig106](https://modelscript.org/languages/irig106)

Native **IRIG 106 Chapter 9 TMATS (Telemetry Attributes Transfer Standard)** compiler, PCM major/minor frame commutator solver, polynomial engineering-unit calibration engine, DAE lowering pipeline, CCSDS XTCE / CSV projections, and interactive React + SVG commutator viewer/editor for ModelScript.

---

## Core Capabilities

- **WASM GLR Parser & TMATS Parser (`irig106Language`, `parseIrig106`, `serializeIrig106`)**: Parses IRIG 106 Chapter 9 `CODE:VALUE;` attributes across all core groups (`G\` General, `T-x\` Transmission, `M-x\` Multiplex/Modulation, `P-x\` PCM Format, `D-x\` PCM Measurement Description, `C-x\` Data Conversion, `COMMENT`).
- **PCM Frame Commutator Solver (`buildCommutatorGrid`, `evaluatePolynomialCalibration`, `evaluateConversion`, `decodeBinaryWord`)**:
  - Exact minor/major frame bit-rate, frame-rate, and word-rate computation
  - Supercommutated (`WP`, `WI`) and subcommutated (`FP`, `FI`) 2D major/minor frame slot grid scheduling
  - Per-parameter sample rate ($f_s$) and Nyquist bandwidth ($f_s / 2$) calculation
  - Horner-form polynomial engineering-unit calibration $y = \sum_{k=0}^{n} c_k x^k$, pair-set interpolation (`PRS`), and derived equations (`DER`).
- **Direct Continuous DAE Arena Lowering (`lowerIrig106ToDae`, `irig106ToDae`)**: Lowers PCM frame timing parameters, per-channel calibration equations, and Nyquist bandwidth relations directly into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder` linear memory arena.
- **TMATS Linter (`lintIrig106`, `Irig106ErrorCode`)**: Comprehensive diagnostics (`IRIG1001`–`IRIG5006`) covering missing `;` terminators, duplicate attribute codes, out-of-bounds word positions, overlapping PCM word/bit allocations, undefined `C-x` conversion references, bit-rate / minor-frame-rate mismatches, missing sync patterns (`MF4`), and invalid word lengths (`F1`).
- **Cleanroom Standard Library (`@modelscript/irig106-std-lib`)**: Declarative schemas for TMATS groups (`G`, `T`, `M`, `P`, `D`, `C`) and IRIG-106 standard optimal frame sync patterns (16-bit `EB90`, 24-bit `FAF320`, 32-bit `FE6B2840`) with an AssemblyScript WASM runtime.
- **Projections (`irig106ToXtce`, `irig106ToCsv`)**: Exports TMATS telemetry definitions to CCSDS 660.1-G-1 XTCE XML and tabular CSV commutator schedules.
- **Interactive Visualization & LSP (`renderIrig106CommutatorSvg`, `Irig106Panel`, `validateIrig106`, `getIrig106DocumentSymbols`, `getIrig106Hover`, `getIrig106Completions`)**: Pure SVG PCM major/minor frame commutator visualizer and React panel built on `@modelscript/design-tokens/panel`.

## Lint Rules (`IRIG1001`–`IRIG5006`)

| Code       | Rule                              | Severity  | Description                                                                                             |
| :--------- | :-------------------------------- | :-------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `IRIG1001` | `syntax-error`                    | `error`   | Syntax error or missing `;` terminator on a TMATS attribute line.                                       |
| `IRIG2001` | `duplicate-attribute-code`        | `error`   | Duplicate TMATS attribute code declared multiple times in the file.                                     |
| `IRIG3001` | `word-position-out-of-bounds`     | `error`   | PCM measurement word position (`WP`) is outside minor frame bounds `[1, MF1]`.                          |
| `IRIG3002` | `overlapping-pcm-allocation`      | `error`   | Two PCM measurements overlap in the same minor frame, word position, and bit range.                     |
| `IRIG4001` | `undefined-conversion-ref`        | `error`   | `D-x` measurement references an undefined `C-x` data conversion (`DCN`).                                |
| `IRIG5001` | `bit-rate-frame-mismatch`         | `error`   | PCM bit rate (`D1`), minor frame bits (`MF2`), or word budget (`MF1 * F1 + syncBits`) are inconsistent. |
| `IRIG5002` | `missing-sync-pattern`            | `error`   | PCM format group is missing minor frame synchronization pattern (`P-x\MF4`).                            |
| `IRIG5003` | `invalid-word-length`             | `error`   | PCM common word length (`P-x\F1`) is outside the valid IRIG 106 range (`4`–`64` bits).                  |
| `IRIG5004` | `invalid-frame-position`          | `error`   | Measurement subcommutation frame position (`FP`) exceeds major frame depth (`MF\N`).                    |
| `IRIG5005` | `missing-polynomial-coefficients` | `warning` | `C-x` conversion of type `COE` has no polynomial coefficients (`CO-n`) defined.                         |
| `IRIG5006` | `sync-pattern-length-mismatch`    | `warning` | Sync pattern bit length does not match standard IRIG-106 widths or minor frame sync bit budget.         |

---

## Programmatic Usage

```typescript
import {
  parseIrig106,
  lintIrig106,
  buildCommutatorGrid,
  evaluatePolynomialCalibration,
  irig106ToDae,
  irig106ToXtce,
  renderIrig106CommutatorSvg,
} from "@modelscript/irig106";

const tmats = `
G\\PN:FLIGHT_TEST_01;
P-1\\DLN:PCM_LINK_1;
P-1\\D1:128000;
P-1\\F1:16;
P-1\\MF\\N:4;
P-1\\MF1:6;
P-1\\MF2:128;
P-1\\MF4:FE6B2840;
D-1\\DLN:PCM_LINK_1;
D-1\\MN-1-1:PITCH_RATE;
D-1\\WP-1-1:1;
D-1\\WI-1-1:2;
C-1\\DCN:PITCH_RATE;
C-1\\MN3:DEG/S;
C-1\\DCT:COE;
C-1\\CO-0:-100.0;
C-1\\CO-1:0.0030517578125;
`;

const model = parseIrig106(tmats);
const diagnostics = lintIrig106(model);
const grid = buildCommutatorGrid(model);
const dae = irig106ToDae(model);
const xtceXml = irig106ToXtce(model);
const svg = renderIrig106CommutatorSvg(model);
```

# ENDF-6 (`.endf`)

**Package:** `@modelscript/endf6` · **Maturity:** `Beta` · **Extensions:** `.endf`

**Maturity:** Beta · **Extensions:** `.endf`, `.endf6`, `.enf`, `.pendf`, `.gendf`, `.tape` · **Docs:** [modelscript.org/languages/endf6](https://modelscript.org/languages/endf6)

Native **ENDF-6 (Evaluated Nuclear Data File Format, BNL/NNDC 1968–1980s+)** evaluated nuclear cross-section tape parser, resonance evaluator, multigroup collapse solver, linear-memory `DAEBuilder` lowering, and interactive log-log cross-section viewer/editor for ModelScript.

---

## Core Capabilities

- **WASM GLR Grammar & 80-Column ENDF-6 Card Parser (`endf6Language`, `parseEndf6Tape`, `parseEndfFloat`)**:
  - Exact 11-character Fortran exponent-omitted floating-point parsing (e.g., ` 9.223500+4`, `-1.234567-5`, ` 2.530000-2`) and canonical formatting.
  - Full `HEAD`, `CONT`, `TAB1`, and `LIST` record decoding with `MAT` (cols 67–70), `MF` (cols 71–72), `MT` (cols 73–75), and `NS` (cols 76–80) sequence identifiers.
  - Structured decoding for `MF=1` (`MT=451` descriptive data & directory), `MF=2` (`MT=151` single-level Breit-Wigner resonance parameters), `MF=3` (pointwise cross-sections `MT=1, 2, 18, 102`), `MF=8` (`MT=457` radioactive decay data), and `SEND`/`FEND`/`MEND`/`TEND` tape terminators.
- **Nuclear Data Validation & Linting (`lintEndf6Tape`, `Endf6ErrorCode`)**:
  - 18 domain diagnostics (`ENDF1001`–`ENDF5006`) covering card formatting, missing `SEND`/`FEND`/`MEND`/`TEND` terminators, invalid `MAT`/`MF`/`MT` codes, non-monotonic energy grids, negative cross-sections $\sigma(E) < 0$, invalid interpolation schemes (`INT` $\notin \{1..5\}$), `MT=1` total vs. partial cross-section sum consistency, and invalid `ZA` or `AWR <= 0`.
- **Cross-Section Interpolation, Resonance & Multigroup Solver (`evaluateTab1`, `evaluateSlbwRange`, `collapseMultigroup`)**:
  - Exact ENDF-6 `INT=1..5` interpolation (histogram, lin-lin, lin-log, log-lin, log-log).
  - Single-Level Breit-Wigner (SLBW) s-wave resonance cross-section evaluator (elastic, capture, fission, total) with exact $1/v$ thermal tail and resonance peak behavior.
  - Flux-weighted multigroup cross-section collapse over Maxwellian thermal + $1/E$ epithermal neutron spectra.
- **Direct Continuous DAE Arena Lowering (`lowerEndf6ToDae`)**:
  - Lowers collapsed multigroup neutron balance ODEs, reaction-rate equations (`R_total`, `R_capture`, `R_fission`), and `MF=8` radioactive decay ODEs directly into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder`.
- **Polyglot Projections & Interactive Log-Log Viewer (`endf6ToMcnpMaterial`, `endf6ToScaleComposition`, `endf6ToCsv`, `renderEndf6CrossSectionSvg`, `Endf6Panel`)**:
  - Projects ENDF-6 nuclides to MCNP material cards, SCALE standard compositions, and CSV tables.
  - Pure SVG log-log $\sigma(E)$ vs. $E$ cross-section plotter and interactive React panel (`Endf6Panel`).

---

## Package Structure

| Path                    | Description                                                                                           |
| :---------------------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `src/index.ts`          | Public package exports                                                                                |
| `src/language.ts`       | `endf6Language` WASM GLR grammar and UI panel registration                                            |
| `src/types.ts`          | Core TypeScript interfaces (`Endf6Tape`, `Endf6Material`, `Endf6Tab1Record`, etc.)                    |
| `src/parser/`           | 11-char ENDF float parser/formatter and 80-column `HEAD`/`CONT`/`TAB1`/`LIST` tape parser             |
| `src/errors.ts`         | `Endf6ErrorCode` (`ENDF1001`–`ENDF5006`) diagnostic catalog                                           |
| `src/lints/index.ts`    | ENDF-6 structural, monotonicity, positivity, and consistency linter                                   |
| `src/solver/`           | `INT=1..5` interpolation, SLBW resonance evaluator, and multigroup collapse                           |
| `src/dae/`              | Direct `DAEBuilder` lowering for multigroup neutron balance & reaction rates                          |
| `src/projections/`      | MCNP material card, SCALE composition, and CSV projections                                            |
| `src/catalog/`          | Cleanroom ENDF-6 `MF`/`MT` schemas and reference nuclides (`H-1`, `B-10`, `U-235`, `U-238`, `Pu-239`) |
| `src/diagram/`          | Pure SVG log-log neutron cross-section plotter (`renderEndf6CrossSectionSvg`)                         |
| `src/ui/Endf6Panel.tsx` | Interactive React cross-section viewer/editor panel                                                   |
| `src/indexing.ts`       | UnifiedWorkspace symbol indexing                                                                      |
| `src/lsp.ts`            | LSP diagnostics, document symbols, hover, and completions                                             |

# JCAMP-DX (`.jdx`)

**Package:** `@modelscript/jcamp-dx` · **Maturity:** `Beta` · **Extensions:** `.jdx`

**Maturity:** Beta · **Extensions:** `.jdx`, `.dx`, `.jcamp` · **Docs:** [modelscript.org/languages/jcamp-dx](https://modelscript.org/languages/jcamp-dx)

Native **JCAMP-DX (Joint Committee on Atomic and Molecular Physical Data — Data Exchange, IUPAC 1988)** analytical spectroscopy language package (`.jdx`, `.dx`, `.jcamp`) for ModelScript. Features a WebAssembly GLR parser, full ASDF/DIFDUP compression codec (AFFN, PAC, SQZ, DIF, DUP, and DIFDUP checkpoint verification), Beer-Lambert & Savitzky-Golay spectroscopy solver, direct linear-memory `DAEBuilder` lowering of Lorentzian/Gaussian absorption line shapes, domain diagnostics (`JDX1001`–`JDX5006`), cleanroom IUPAC spectroscopy standard library, pure SVG spectrum renderer, and an interactive React viewer/editor panel.

---

## Core Capabilities

- **WASM GLR Parser & ASDF/DIFDUP Codec (`parseJcampDx`, `decodeXyData`, `encodeAsdf`)**: Parses JCAMP-DX 4.24/5.01/6.00 Labeled Data Records (`##TITLE=`, `##JCAMP-DX=`, `##DATA TYPE=`, `##XYDATA=(X++(Y..Y))`, `##PEAK TABLE=(XY..XY)`, `##END=`, `$$` comments) and decodes/encodes AFFN, PAC, SQZ (`@A-Ia-i`), DIF (`%J-Rj-r`), DUP (`S-Zs`), and DIFDUP with strict checkpoint verification.
- **Spectroscopy Solver (`transmittanceToAbsorbance`, `absorbanceToTransmittance`, `findSpectralPeaks`, `integrateBand`, `savitzkyGolaySmooth`)**: Beer-Lambert $A = -\log_{10} T$ conversion, topographic-prominence peak detection, trapezoidal band integration, and Savitzky-Golay polynomial smoothing.
- **Direct DAE Arena Lowering (`lowerJcampDxToDae`, `jcampDxToDae`)**: Lowers Beer-Lambert transmittance/absorbance and Lorentzian/Gaussian absorption line-shape models directly into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `IDaeBuilder`.
- **Spectroscopy Linter (`lintJcampDx`, `JcampDxErrorCode`)**: Validates mandatory LDRs, `##NPOINTS` parity, DIFDUP checkpoint continuity, positive scaling factors, X-range bounds, and physical transmittance limits (`JDX1001`–`JDX5006`).
- **Interactive SVG & React Panel (`renderJcampDxSpectrumSvg`, `JcampDxPanel`)**: Renders wavenumber/ppm-reversed IR & NMR plots, stick-plot mass spectra, peak callouts, and live Absorbance/Transmittance toggling.

---

## Package Structure

| Path                                  | Description                                                                       |
| :------------------------------------ | :-------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |

| `src/language.ts`                     | `jcampDxLanguage` DSL grammar, file extensions, and UI panel registration         |
| `src/types.ts`                        | Core TypeScript interfaces (`JcampDocument`, `JcampBlock`, `JcampLdr`)            |
| `src/errors.ts`                       | `JcampDxErrorCode` diagnostic definitions (`JDX1001`–`JDX5006`)                   |
| `src/parser/asdf.ts`                  | ASDF encoder/decoder (AFFN, PAC, SQZ, DIF, DUP, DIFDUP + checkpoint verification) |
| `src/parser/jcamp-parser.ts`          | JCAMP-DX LDR & compound block parser (`parseJcampDx`, `serializeJcampDx`)         |
| `src/lints/index.ts`                  | `lintJcampDx` domain diagnostic validator                                         |
| `src/solver/spectroscopy.ts`          | Beer-Lambert, peak finder, trapezoidal integration, Savitzky-Golay smoothing      |
| `src/dae/lowering.ts`                 | Direct `IDaeBuilder` lowering of Beer-Lambert & Lorentzian/Gaussian line shapes   |
| `src/projections/index.ts`            | CSV and JSON spectrum projections                                                 |
| `src/catalog/jcamp-dx-std-schemas.ts` | Cleanroom IUPAC spectroscopy types & IR functional-group absorption bands         |
| `src/diagram/spectrum-svg.ts`         | Pure SVG IR/NMR/MS/UV-Vis/Raman spectrum renderer                                 |
| `src/ui/JcampDxPanel.tsx`             | Interactive React spectrum viewer & metadata/peak/lint inspector                  |

# IUCr Crystallographic CIF (`.mcif`)

**Package:** `@modelscript/iucr-cif` · **Maturity:** `Beta` · **Extensions:** `.mcif`

**Maturity:** Beta · **Extensions:** `.cif`, `.mcif`, `.star` · **Docs:** [modelscript.org/languages/iucr-cif](https://modelscript.org/languages/iucr-cif)

Native **IUCr Crystallographic Information File (CIF / STAR 1.1)** crystal-structure modeling, crystallography solver, powder X-ray diffraction (XRD) simulator, and interactive 3D-projected lattice viewer package for ModelScript. Supports full STAR/CIF 1.1 syntax (`data_`, `loop_`, `_tag value`, single/double-quoted strings, `;...;` multiline semicolon blocks, `?`/`.` missing/inapplicable tokens, standard uncertainties such as `5.4310(2)`, and `#` comments), triclinic-to-cubic metric tensor geometry, Wyckoff symmetry expansion, Cu-$K\alpha$ Bragg powder XRD simulation, direct linear-memory `DAEBuilder` lowering, PDB/XYZ/MDL Molfile projections, 14 crystallographic lint rules (`ICIF1001`–`ICIF5006`), and a React + SVG crystal lattice & powder XRD viewer panel.

---

## Core Capabilities

- **WASM GLR & STAR/CIF 1.1 Parser (`parseIucrCif`, `extractCrystalStructure`, `iucrCifLanguage`)**: Parses multi-block CIF/STAR 1.1 files with standard uncertainties, semicolon-delimited text blocks, loops, and both CIF 1.0 and CIF 2.0 symmetry/cell aliases.
- **Crystallography & Powder XRD Solver (`computeMetricTensor`, `expandSymmetrySites`, `findPeriodicBonds`, `computeTheoreticalDensity`, `simulatePowderXrd`, `solveCrystalStructure`)**:
  - Triclinic-to-cubic metric tensor $G$, unit-cell volume $V = \sqrt{\det G}$, reciprocal metric tensor $G^* = G^{-1}$, and fractional $\leftrightarrow$ Cartesian orthogonalization.
  - Affine `_symmetry_equiv_pos_as_xyz` Wyckoff expansion with periodic modulo-1 deduplication and minimum-image nearest-neighbor bond detection.
  - Cu-$K\alpha$ ($\lambda = 1.5406\,\text{\AA}$) powder XRD $d_{hkl}$, $2\theta$, Cromer-Mann atomic scattering factor $f_j(s)$, complex structure factor $|F_{hkl}|^2$, Lorentz-polarization correction, and broadened diffraction profile.
- **Direct Continuous DAE Arena Lowering (`cifToDae`, `lowerCifToDae`)**: Lowers unit-cell metric tensor components, unit-cell volume ($V^2 = \det G$), density, and Bragg diffraction equations ($2 d_{hkl} \sin\theta = \lambda$) directly into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder`.
- **Crystallographic Linter (`lintIucrCif`, `IucrCifErrorCode`)**: 14 domain diagnostics (`ICIF1001`–`ICIF5006`) checking STAR syntax, duplicate `data_` blocks/tags, `loop_` column divisibility, non-positive cell lengths, invalid cell angles, degenerate metric tensors, missing fractional coordinates, invalid occupancies, and overlapping symmetry-expanded atoms ($< 0.5\,\text{\AA}$).
- **Polyglot Projections (`cifToPdb`, `cifToXyz`, `cifToMolfile`)**: Projects crystal structures to RCSB PDB (`CRYST1` + `ATOM` + `CONECT`), Cartesian XYZ, and MDL Molfile V2000.
- **Interactive SVG Visualization & React Panel (`renderIucrCifSvg`, `IucrCifPanel`)**: Pure SVG isometric 3D-projected unit-cell lattice (atoms, bonds, unit-cell wireframe) + simulated Cu-$K\alpha$ powder XRD pattern, integrated into a React `@modelscript/design-tokens/panel` viewer.
- **Cleanroom Standard Library (`@modelscript/iucr-cif-std-lib`)**: Core CIF dictionary categories (`_cell`, `_symmetry`, `_atom_site`, `_diffrn`) and canonical crystal templates (Silicon $Fd\bar{3}m$, NaCl $Fm\bar{3}m$, $\alpha$-Quartz $P3_121$, FCC Copper $Fm\bar{3}m$) with AssemblyScript WASM runtime.

---

## Package Structure

| Path                                    | Description                                                                                |
| :-------------------------------------- | :----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `src/index.ts`                          | Public package exports                                                                     |
| `src/language.ts`                       | `iucrCifLanguage` WASM GLR grammar and UI panel registration (`.cif`, `.mcif`, `.star`)    |
| `src/types.ts`                          | STAR/CIF AST and crystallographic domain types                                             |
| `src/errors.ts`                         | `IucrCifErrorCode` (`ICIF1001`–`ICIF5006`) diagnostic definitions                          |
| `src/parser/cif-parser.ts`              | STAR/CIF 1.1 lexer, parser, standard-uncertainty parser, and structure extractor           |
| `src/lints/index.ts`                    | `lintIucrCif` syntactic, structural, metric, and steric-overlap validator                  |
| `src/solver/crystallography.ts`         | Metric tensor, orthogonalization, Wyckoff expansion, periodic bonds, and density           |
| `src/solver/xrd.ts`                     | Cu-$K\alpha$ Bragg powder XRD structure-factor and profile simulator                       |
| `src/dae/lowering.ts`                   | `lowerCifToDae` and `cifToDae` direct `DAEBuilder` lowering                                |
| `src/projections/`                      | `cifToPdb`, `cifToXyz`, and `cifToMolfile` structural projections                          |
| `src/catalog/iucr-cif-std-schemas.ts`   | Cleanroom CIF dictionary & canonical crystal schemas + SVG icons                           |
| `assets/iucr-cif-std-lib/src/models.ts` | AssemblyScript WASM crystallography & Bragg diffraction runtime                            |
| `src/diagram/crystal-svg.ts`            | `renderIucrCifSvg` 3D-projected crystal lattice & powder XRD SVG renderer                  |
| `src/ui/IucrCifPanel.tsx`               | Interactive React crystal lattice & powder XRD viewer/editor panel                         |
| `src/indexing.ts`                       | `iucrCifIndexing` UnifiedWorkspace indexer                                                 |
| `src/lsp.ts`                            | `validateIucrCif`, `getIucrCifDocumentSymbols`, `getIucrCifHover`, `getIucrCifCompletions` |

# 3D Systems STL (`.stl`)

**Package:** `@modelscript/stl` · **Maturity:** `Beta` · **Extensions:** `.stl`

**Maturity:** Beta · **Extensions:** `.stl` · **Docs:** [modelscript.org/languages/stl](https://modelscript.org/languages/stl)

Native **3D Systems STL (Stereolithography ASCII & Binary Mesh Format, 1987)** compiler, manifold analyzer, mass-property solver, CAD/DAE lowering engine, polyglot projector, and interactive 3D orthographic/isometric SVG mesh viewer for ModelScript.

---

## Core Capabilities

- **WASM GLR ASCII Parser & Binary STL Codec (`parseStl`, `parseAsciiStl`, `parseBinaryStl`, `encodeBinaryStl`, `formatAsciiStl`)**:
  - Formal `@modelscript/dsl` grammar (`stlLanguage`) compiled to `dist/parser.wasm` + `src-gen/bindings.{js,d.ts}`.
  - Full ASCII STL (`solid` / `facet normal` / `outer loop` / `vertex` / `endloop` / `endfacet` / `endsolid`) and IEEE-754 little-endian Binary STL (80-byte header + `uint32` facet count + 50-byte facet records) support.
- **Manifold & Geometry Diagnostics (`lintStl`, `StlErrorCode`)**:
  - Comprehensive diagnostics (`STL1001`–`STL5006`) detecting syntax/truncation errors, mismatched `solid`/`endsolid` names, NaN/Inf coordinates, degenerate zero-area triangles, right-hand-rule normal inversions, non-manifold edges (>2 incident faces), open boundary edges (non-watertight shells), and negative signed volume.
- **Exact Mass-Property & Topology Solver (`computeStlMassProperties`, `analyzeStlTopology`)**:
  - Exact signed tetrahedral volume $V = \frac{1}{6}\sum v_0 \cdot (v_1 \times v_2)$, surface area, volume-weighted centroid, exact 3×3 inertia tensor (origin and centroidal frames), bounding box, Euler characteristic $\chi = V - E + F$, and watertightness verification.
- **CAD Solid & DAE Rigid-Body Lowering (`stlToCadSolid`, `stlToDae`, `lowerStlToDae`)**:
  - Lowers welded triangle meshes into `@modelscript/cad` `PolyhedronSolid` nodes and lowers 6-DOF rigid-body mass/inertia dynamics directly into `@modelscript/runtime` `DAEBuilder`.
- **Polyglot Projections & Interactive 3D Viewer (`stlToObj`, `stlToStep`, `renderStlMeshSvg`, `StlPanel`)**:
  - Projects STL meshes to Wavefront OBJ, ISO 10303-21 STEP, and painter's-algorithm Lambertian-shaded isometric/orthographic SVG (`iso`, `xy`, `xz`, `yz`, wireframe toggle), paired with an interactive React `StlPanel`.
- **Cleanroom Standard Library (`@modelscript/stl-std-lib`)**:
  - Analytical watertight STL primitives (Unit Cube, Unit Tetrahedron, Regular Octahedron, Cylinder, Icosphere) with AssemblyScript `runtime.wasm` mass-property kernels and SVG block icons.

---

## Package Structure

| `src/errors.ts`                  | `StlErrorCode` (`STL1001`–`STL5006`) diagnostic catalog                          |
| `src/parser/index.ts`            | Unified ASCII & Binary STL parser and encoder                                    |
| `src/lints/index.ts`             | Manifold, watertightness, normal-consistency, and geometry linter                |
| `src/solver/index.ts`            | Exact tetrahedral volume, area, centroid, 3×3 inertia tensor, and Euler topology |
| `src/cad/index.ts`               | `@modelscript/cad` `PolyhedronSolid` lowering                                    |
| `src/dae/index.ts`               | Rigid-body mass/inertia lowering to `@modelscript/runtime` `DAEBuilder`          |
| `src/projections/index.ts`       | Projections to Wavefront OBJ, ISO 10303-21 STEP, and SVG                         |

# Wavefront OBJ / MTL (`.obj`)

**Package:** `@modelscript/obj` · **Maturity:** `Beta` · **Extensions:** `.obj`

**Maturity:** Beta · **Extensions:** `.obj`, `.mtl` · **Docs:** [modelscript.org/languages/obj](https://modelscript.org/languages/obj)

Native **Wavefront OBJ & MTL** (1980s Wavefront Technologies Advanced Visualizer 3D geometry & material library format) compiler, mesh analyzer, CAD/DAE lowering engine, polyglot exporter, and interactive SVG 3D viewer for ModelScript.

---

## Core Capabilities

- **WASM GLR Grammar & Full Wavefront OBJ/MTL Parsers (`objLanguage`, `parseObj`, `parseMtl`, `parseObjWithMtl`)**:
  - Ingests vertices (`v`), texture coordinates (`vt`), vertex normals (`vn`), parameter-space vertices (`vp`), polygonal faces (`f` with `v`, `v/vt`, `v//vn`, `v/vt/vn`, supporting both 1-based positive and relative negative indices), polylines (`l`), point clouds (`p`), objects (`o`), groups (`g`), smoothing groups (`s`), material libraries (`mtllib`), and material bindings (`usemtl`).
  - Parses companion Wavefront MTL libraries (`newmtl`, `Ka`, `Kd`, `Ks`, `Ke`, `Ns`, `d`, `Tr`, `Ni`, `illum`, texture maps).
- **Mesh Topology & Geometry Solver (`triangulateObjMesh`, `computeSmoothVertexNormals`, `computeBoundingBox`, `computeMeshMetrics`)**:
  - Fan triangulation of arbitrary $n$-gons into indexed triangles.
  - Area-weighted smooth vertex normal calculation, axis-aligned bounding box, exact surface area $A$, signed volume $V$, centroid, rigid-body inertia tensor, watertightness check, and Euler characteristic $\chi = V - E + F$.
- **CAD & Linear-Memory DAE Lowering (`lowerObjToCad`, `lowerObjToDae`, `objToDae`)**:
  - Lowers OBJ meshes directly into `@modelscript/cad` `PolyhedronSolid` and `Assembly` structures with MTL diffuse color metadata.
  - Lowers rigid-body mass, centroid, diagonal inertia tensor, and 6-DOF translational/rotational dynamics directly into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder`.
- **Polyglot Projections (`objToAsciiStl`, `objToBinaryStl`, `objToStep`, `objToUsd`)**:
  - Exports meshes to ASCII STL, IEEE 754 Binary STL, ISO 10303-21 STEP, and OpenUSD `.usda`.
- **Domain Linter (`lintObj`, `lintMtl`, `ObjErrorCode`)**:
  - 10 diagnostic rules (`OBJ1001`–`OBJ5006`) detecting syntax errors, 0-based index misuse, out-of-range vertex/texcoord/normal references, faces with $<3$ vertices, degenerate zero-area faces, undefined material bindings, out-of-range MTL color components, and non-manifold edges.
- **Cleanroom Standard Library (`@modelscript/obj-std-lib`)**:
  - Built-in Wavefront OBJ geometric primitives and engineering MTL materials (`Aluminum`, `Steel`, `Copper`, `Glass`, `MatteWhite`) backed by an AssemblyScript WASM geometry/shading kernel.
- **Interactive 3D SVG Viewer & React Panel (`renderObjMeshSvg`, `ObjPanel`)**:
  - Pure SVG isometric/orthographic shaded 3D mesh renderer with painter's algorithm depth sorting, Lambertian/Blinn-Phong MTL shading, wireframe overlay, and material swatch legend.

---

## Lint Rules

| Code    | Rule                          | Severity | Description                                                       |
| :------ | :---------------------------- | :------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| OBJ1001 | `syntax-error`                | error    | Malformed Wavefront OBJ or MTL directive                          |
| OBJ2001 | `zero-index`                  | error    | Zero index used in face/line/point (Wavefront OBJ is 1-based)     |
| OBJ2002 | `vertex-index-out-of-range`   | error    | Vertex index `v` in `f` references a non-existent vertex          |
| OBJ2003 | `texcoord-index-out-of-range` | error    | Texture coordinate index `vt` in `f` references a non-existent UV |
| OBJ2004 | `normal-index-out-of-range`   | error    | Vertex normal index `vn` in `f` references a non-existent normal  |
| OBJ3001 | `face-too-few-vertices`       | error    | Face directive `f` has fewer than 3 vertices                      |
| OBJ3002 | `degenerate-face`             | warning  | Degenerate face with zero surface area                            |
| OBJ4001 | `undefined-material`          | warning  | `usemtl` references a material not defined in the provided MTL    |
| OBJ4002 | `mtl-color-out-of-range`      | warning  | MTL color component (`Ka`, `Kd`, `Ks`, `Ke`) outside `[0, 1]`     |
| OBJ5006 | `non-manifold-edge`           | warning  | Edge shared by more than 2 faces (non-manifold mesh topology)     |

# Intel HEX (`.hex`)

**Package:** `@modelscript/ihex` · **Maturity:** `Beta` · **Extensions:** `.hex`

**Maturity:** Beta · **Extensions:** `.hex`, `.ihx`, `.ihex`, `.h86`, `.mcs` · **Docs:** [modelscript.org/languages/ihex](https://modelscript.org/languages/ihex)

Native **Intel HEX (I8HEX / I16HEX / I32HEX)** microcontroller & EPROM firmware memory image format (1973) package for ModelScript. Features a WebAssembly GLR parser, full I8HEX/I16HEX/I32HEX codec (`parseIhex`, `encodeIhex`), 32-bit linear/segmented memory segment coalescing, flat ROM binary generation (`0xFF` erase fill), IEEE 802.3 CRC-32 & Fletcher-16 integrity verification, 17 domain lint rules (`IHEX1001`–`IHEX5006`), direct linear-memory `DAEBuilder` lowering, projections to Motorola S-Record / Verilog `$readmemh` / C byte arrays, pure SVG memory-map diagrams, and an interactive React `IhexPanel` viewer.

---

## Core Capabilities

- **WASM GLR Parser & Intel HEX Codec (`parseIhex`, `encodeIhex`, `computeIhexChecksum`)**:
  - Supports all six standard Intel HEX record types (`00` Data, `01` EOF, `02` Extended Segment Address, `03` Start Segment Address, `04` Extended Linear Address, `05` Start Linear Address)
  - Full I8HEX (16-bit), I16HEX (20-bit segmented), and I32HEX (32-bit linear) decoding and encoding
  - Exact 2's-complement checksum computation and verification on every record.
- **Memory-Map & Integrity Solver (`coalesceIhexMemoryMap`, `toBinaryRomImage`, `computeCrc32`, `computeFletcher16`, `solveIhexImage`)**:
  - Coalesces contiguous 32-bit memory regions into sorted segments with gap and overlap accounting
  - Generates contiguous flat ROM binary images with configurable erased-flash fill byte (`0xFF`)
  - Computes IEEE 802.3 CRC-32 and Fletcher-16 checksums per segment and across the full image, plus flash utilization statistics.
- **Direct Linear-Memory DAE Arena Lowering (`ihexToDae`, `lowerIhexToDae`)**:
  - Lowers ROM memory-footprint, segment address span, gap balance, flash utilization, and checksum verification equations directly into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `IDaeBuilder`.
- **Firmware Integrity Linter (`lintIhex`, `IhexErrorCode`)**:
  - 17 diagnostics (`IHEX1001`–`IHEX5006`) detecting missing `:` start codes, malformed hex, truncated records, 2's-complement checksum mismatches, byte-count mismatches, unsupported record types, invalid control payload lengths, missing/duplicate/trailing EOF records, overlapping addresses, large uninitialized gaps, and unaligned entry points.
- **Polyglot Projections (`ihexToSrec`, `ihexToVerilogMem`, `ihexToCArray`)**:
  - Projects Intel HEX images to Motorola S-Record (`S0`/`S1`/`S2`/`S3`/`S7`/`S8`/`S9`), Verilog `$readmemh` `.mem`, and C `const uint8_t` arrays.
- **Memory-Map SVG & Interactive React Panel (`renderIhexMemoryMapSvg`, `IhexPanel`)**:
  - Generates vector SVG memory-map segment layout bars and address-range diagrams
  - Interactive React panel with Memory Map SVG, Hex/ASCII Dump table, Segments summary, and Lints tabs.

---

| `src/errors.ts`                     | `IhexErrorCode` diagnostic definitions (`IHEX1001`–`IHEX5006`)            |
| `src/parser/index.ts`               | `parseIhex`, `encodeIhex`, `computeIhexChecksum`                          |
| `src/lints/index.ts`                | `lintIhex` firmware image integrity linter                                |
| `src/solver/index.ts`               | Memory coalescer, ROM image generator, IEEE CRC-32, Fletcher-16           |
| `src/dae/index.ts`                  | `ihexToDae` and `lowerIhexToDae` linear-memory DAE lowering               |
| `src/projections/index.ts`          | `ihexToSrec`, `ihexToVerilogMem`, `ihexToCArray`                          |
| `src/diagram/index.ts`              | `renderIhexMemoryMapSvg` pure SVG memory-map diagram renderer             |
| `src/ui/IhexPanel.tsx`              | Interactive React Memory Map, Hex/ASCII Dump, Segments, and Lints panel   |
| `src/catalog/ihex-std-schemas.ts`   | Cleanroom schemas for Intel HEX record types (`00`–`05`) & MCU layouts    |
| `assets/ihex-std-lib/src/models.ts` | AssemblyScript WASM cleanroom stdlib runtime                              |
| `src/indexing.ts`                   | UnifiedWorkspace indexer for Intel HEX files                              |
| `src/lsp.ts`                        | LSP validation, document symbols, hover, and completions                  |

## Lint Rules

| Code       | Rule                      | Severity | Description                                                |
| :--------- | :------------------------ | :------- | :--------------------------------------------------------- |
| `IHEX1001` | `missing-start-code`      | error    | Record line does not begin with `':'` start code           |
| `IHEX1002` | `invalid-hex-syntax`      | error    | Non-hexadecimal characters or odd hex digit count          |
| `IHEX1003` | `truncated-record`        | error    | Record shorter than minimum 11-character frame             |
| `IHEX2001` | `checksum-mismatch`       | error    | 2's-complement checksum byte does not match computed value |
| `IHEX2002` | `byte-count-mismatch`     | error    | Byte count `LL` does not match payload byte length         |
| `IHEX3001` | `unsupported-record-type` | error    | Record type outside standard range `00`–`05`               |
| `IHEX3002` | `invalid-payload-length`  | error    | Control record (`01`–`05`) has wrong payload byte count    |
| `IHEX3003` | `nonzero-control-address` | warning  | Control record (`01`–`05`) has non-zero address field      |
| `IHEX4001` | `missing-eof-record`      | error    | Image is missing terminating `01` End-Of-File record       |
| `IHEX4002` | `records-after-eof`       | warning  | Records appear after `01` End-Of-File record               |
| `IHEX4003` | `duplicate-eof-record`    | warning  | Multiple `01` End-Of-File records found                    |
| `IHEX5001` | `overlapping-address`     | error    | Overlapping address bytes written by multiple data records |
| `IHEX5002` | `large-uninitialized-gap` | warning  | Large uninitialized memory gap between segments            |
| `IHEX5003` | `empty-image`             | warning  | Image contains no `00` Data records                        |
| `IHEX5004` | `address-wraparound`      | warning  | Data record crosses 16-bit `0xFFFF` address boundary       |
| `IHEX5005` | `mixed-addressing-modes`  | warning  | Image mixes I16HEX (`02`/`03`) and I32HEX (`04`/`05`)      |
| `IHEX5006` | `unaligned-entry-point`   | info     | Start address does not point inside any defined segment    |

# Motorola S-Record (`.srec`)

**Package:** `@modelscript/srec` · **Maturity:** `Beta` · **Extensions:** `.srec`

**Maturity:** Beta · **Extensions:** `.srec`, `.s19`, `.s28`, `.s37`, `.mot`, `.sre`, `.sx` · **Docs:** [modelscript.org/languages/srec](https://modelscript.org/languages/srec)

Native **Motorola S-Record (SREC)** firmware memory image format parser, encoder, verifier, DAE footprint lowerer, and interactive memory-map/hex viewer (`.srec`, `.s19`, `.s28`, `.s37`, `.mot`) for ModelScript. Supports all standard Motorola S-Record types (`S0` header, `S1`/`S2`/`S3` 16/24/32-bit data, `S5`/`S6` 16/24-bit record counts, `S7`/`S8`/`S9` 32/24/16-bit start address termination), 1's-complement checksum validation, contiguous memory-region coalescing, IEEE 802.3 CRC-32 verification, direct linear-memory `DAEBuilder` lowering, polyglot projections (Intel HEX, Verilog `$readmemh`, C `uint8_t[]`), and an interactive React + SVG memory-region & hex dump viewer (`SrecPanel`).

---

## Core Capabilities

- **WASM GLR Parser & SREC Codec (`srecLanguage`, `parseSrec`, `encodeSrec`)**: Declarative `@modelscript/dsl` grammar compiled to WebAssembly GLR (`dist/parser.wasm`) plus lossless round-trip parser and encoder for 16-bit (`S1`/`S9`), 24-bit (`S2`/`S8`), and 32-bit (`S3`/`S7`) Motorola S-Record images.
- **Firmware Integrity Linter (`lintSrec`, `SrecErrorCode`)**: Validates `SREC1001`–`SREC5006` rules including syntax errors, 1's-complement checksums, byte count consistency, reserved `S4` rejection, `S5`/`S6` data record count verification, missing termination records, address-width mismatches between data and terminator records, overlapping address bytes, and missing `S0` header warnings.
- **Memory-Region Solver & Binary Image Builder (`solveSrecMemory`, `coalesceMemoryRegions`, `buildBinaryImage`, `computeCrc32`)**: Coalesces scattered records into sorted contiguous memory segments, builds flat binary images with configurable fill bytes, computes IEEE 802.3 CRC-32 checksums, and validates entry-point addresses.
- **Direct Linear-Memory DAE Lowering (`srecToDae`, `lowerSrecToDae`)**: Lowers firmware footprint, address span, utilization, record count, and per-region layout equations directly into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `IDaeBuilder`.
- **Polyglot Projections (`srecToIntelHex`, `srecToVerilogReadmemh`, `srecToCArray`)**: Converts Motorola S-Record images into Intel HEX (with Extended Linear Address `04` records), Verilog `$readmemh` memory initialization files, and C `const uint8_t[]` header/source arrays.
- **Cleanroom Stdlib (`@modelscript/srec-std-lib`)**: Declarative schemas and AssemblyScript WASM runtime for `S0`–`S9` record types and classic Motorola 6800, 68000, ColdFire, and PowerPC memory map presets.
- **Interactive SVG Memory Map & React Panel (`renderSrecMemoryMapSvg`, `SrecPanel`)**: Pure SVG memory-region layout bar with entry-point indicator and a 4-tab React panel (Memory Map SVG, Hex/ASCII Dump, Records, and Lints).

---

# JEDEC JESD3 (`.jed`)

**Package:** `@modelscript/jedec` · **Maturity:** `Beta` · **Extensions:** `.jed`

**Maturity:** Beta · **Extensions:** `.jed`, `.jedec`, `.pld` · **Docs:** [modelscript.org/languages/jedec](https://modelscript.org/languages/jedec)

Native **JEDEC Standard 3 (JESD3)** Programmable Logic Device (PLD) fuse-map and test-vector compiler, PAL/GAL sum-of-products Boolean extractor, logic simulator, HDL projector, and interactive fuse-matrix visualizer for ModelScript. Supports classic 1980s bipolar and electrically erasable PLDs (`PAL16L8`, `PAL16R8`, `GAL16V8`, `GAL22V10`), exact 16-bit JESD3 fuse (`C`) and ETX transmission checksum verification, direct linear-memory `DAEBuilder` lowering, synthesizable Verilog-2001 / VHDL-93 projections, and a React + SVG PAL/GAL fuse-matrix panel (`JedecPanel`).

---

## Core Capabilities

- **WASM GLR & JESD3 Fuse-Map Parser (`jedecLanguage`, `parseJedec`, `serializeJedec`, `computeJedecFuseChecksum`)**: Parses JESD3 fields (`QP`, `QF`, `QV`, `F`, `L`, `G`, `N`, `C`, `V`, `X`), `*` delimiters, and optional STX (`0x02`) / ETX (`0x03`) + 4-hex transmission checksum framing.
- **PAL/GAL Boolean Extractor & Test-Vector Simulator (`extractJedecEquations`, `simulateJedecVectors`, `computeFuseUtilization`)**: Reconstructs sum-of-products (SOP) Boolean equations from the PAL16L8 / GAL16V8 AND-OR fuse array and evaluates JESD3 `V` test vectors (`0`, `1`, `C`, `H`, `L`, `X`, `Z`, `N`) against extracted outputs.
- **Direct Boolean DAE Arena Lowering (`lowerJedecToDae`)**: Lowers PLD input pins, product terms, and Boolean output equations directly into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `IDaeBuilder` linear memory representation.
- **Synthesizable HDL Projections (`jedecToVerilog`, `jedecToVhdl`)**: Projects extracted fuse-map Boolean logic to synthesizable Verilog-2001 modules and VHDL-93 entity/architecture pairs.
- **JESD3 Diagnostic Linter (`lintJedec`, `JedecErrorCode`)**: Comprehensive validation (`JED1001`–`JED5006`) covering missing `*` delimiters, mandatory `QF` fuse count, 16-bit `C` fuse checksum mismatch, 16-bit ETX transmission checksum mismatch, out-of-bounds `L` fuse addresses, invalid `F` default states, `V` vector length vs `QP` pin count mismatches, vector counts exceeding `QV`, and overlapping fuse writes.
- **Interactive Fuse-Matrix Viewer (`renderJedecFuseMatrixSvg`, `JedecPanel`)**: Renders intact (`0`) vs blown (`1`) fuse cells across product terms and input columns in pure SVG, integrated into an interactive React panel with Fuse Matrix, Boolean Equations, Test Vectors, and Lints tabs.

---

| Path                    | Description                                                                                    |
| :---------------------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `src/index.ts`          | Public package exports                                                                         |
| `src/language.ts`       | `jedecLanguage` WASM GLR grammar, file extensions (`.jed`, `.jedec`), and UI panel metadata    |
| `src/types.ts`          | Core JESD3 document, fuse-map, test-vector, device-profile, and solver interfaces              |
| `src/errors.ts`         | `JedecErrorCode` (`JED1001`–`JED5006`) diagnostic definitions                                  |
| `src/parser/`           | `parseJedec`, `serializeJedec`, `computeJedecFuseChecksum`, `computeJedecTransmissionChecksum` |

| `src/solver/`           | PAL/GAL device profiles, SOP Boolean extractor, and JESD3 `V` test-vector simulator            |
| `src/dae/`              | `lowerJedecToDae` direct Boolean DAE arena lowering                                            |
| `src/projections/`      | `jedecToVerilog` and `jedecToVhdl` synthesizable HDL projections                               |
| `src/diagram/`          | `renderJedecFuseMatrixSvg` pure SVG fuse-matrix grid renderer                                  |
| `src/ui/JedecPanel.tsx` | Interactive React panel using `@modelscript/design-tokens/panel`                               |

# ASN.1 (X.208 / X.680) (`.asn1`)

**Package:** `@modelscript/asn1` · **Maturity:** `Beta` · **Extensions:** `.asn1`

**Maturity:** Beta · **Extensions:** `.asn`, `.asn1`, `.mib` · **Docs:** [modelscript.org/languages/asn1](https://modelscript.org/languages/asn1)

Native **ASN.1 (ISO/ITU-T X.208 / X.680 Abstract Syntax Notation One + X.690 BER/DER TLV Codec, 1984)** compiler, binary wire codec, schema analyzer, and interactive visualizer for ModelScript. Features a native WebAssembly GLR parser (`parser.wasm`), canonical BER/DER Tag-Length-Value binary encoder & decoder (including base-128 VLQ `OBJECT IDENTIFIER`, minimal two's-complement `INTEGER`, definite short/long length, and lexicographic `SET` sorting), 17 schema & wire diagnostics (`ASN11001`–`ASN15006`), wire-size byte bounds & DAE bandwidth lowering, projections to ITU-T Z.100 SDL-88 `NEWTYPE`, C99 structs, and JSON Schema, plus an interactive React + SVG Type Graph & BER/DER TLV Inspector panel.

---

## Core Capabilities

- **WASM GLR Grammar & Recursive-Descent Parser (`asn1Language`, `parseAsn1`)**: Parses ASN.1 modules (`DEFINITIONS`, `AUTOMATIC`/`EXPLICIT`/`IMPLICIT TAGS`, `BEGIN`/`END`, `IMPORTS`/`EXPORTS`, `::=`, `SEQUENCE`, `SEQUENCE OF`, `SET`, `SET OF`, `CHOICE`, `ENUMERATED`, `INTEGER`, `BOOLEAN`, `REAL`, `NULL`, `OCTET STRING`, `BIT STRING`, `OBJECT IDENTIFIER`, `UTF8String`/`IA5String`/`PrintableString`, context/application/private tags `[n]`, `OPTIONAL`, `DEFAULT`, `SIZE`, range `(a..b)`, `--` comments).
- **Canonical X.690 BER/DER TLV Codec (`encodeDer`, `decodeBer`, `encodeOidContent`, `decodeOidContent`, `encodeDerIntegerContent`, `encodeLength`)**: Exact byte-level X.690 DER encoder and permissive BER decoder with canonicality verification.
- **Schema & Wire Linter (`lintAsn1`, `Asn1ErrorCode`)**: 17 diagnostic rules (`ASN11001`–`ASN15006`) covering syntax errors, duplicate types/fields/enums, undefined type references, cyclic non-optional dependencies, duplicate context tags in `CHOICE`/`SET`, ambiguous consecutive untagged `OPTIONAL` fields, invalid `SIZE`/range constraints, non-canonical DER lengths/booleans/integers, and invalid OID root arcs.
- **Type Dependency Graph, Wire-Size Bounds & DAE Lowering (`buildAsn1TypeGraph`, `computeWireSizeBounds`, `verifyDerRoundTrip`, `lowerAsn1ToDae`, `asn1ToDae`)**: Computes min/max BER/DER wire byte bounds and TLV overhead per type and lowers bandwidth & traffic accumulation equations directly into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder`.
- **Polyglot Projections (`asn1ToSdl`, `asn1ToC`, `asn1ToJsonSchema`)**: Projects ASN.1 modules to ITU-T Z.100 SDL-88 `NEWTYPE`, C99 `typedef struct`/`enum`/`union` headers, and JSON Schema Draft 2020-12.
- **Cleanroom Standard Library (`@modelscript/asn1-std-lib`)**: X.680 universal tags (`0x01` BOOLEAN through `0x31` SET) and classic 1980s protocol schemas (SNMPv1 PDU, X.509 `AlgorithmIdentifier` & `Validity`, IEC 61850 GOOSE PDU) with SVG icons and AssemblyScript WASM runtime.
- **Interactive Visualization & LSP (`renderAsn1DiagramSvg`, `renderBerTlvSvg`, `Asn1Panel`, `validateAsn1`, `getAsn1DocumentSymbols`, `getAsn1Hover`, `getAsn1Completions`)**: Pure SVG schema type-dependency graph, color-coded BER/DER TLV byte-layout breakdown, and React panel for VS Code / Ansatz.

---

## Semantic & Wire Lint Rules (`ASN11001`–`ASN15006`)

| Code       | Rule                        | Severity  | Description                                                                    |
| :--------- | :-------------------------- | :-------- | :----------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `ASN11001` | `syntax-error`              | `error`   | Syntax error in ASN.1 module.                                                  |
| `ASN11002` | `unterminated-module`       | `error`   | Missing `BEGIN` or `END` delimiter in ASN.1 module.                            |
| `ASN12001` | `duplicate-type-definition` | `error`   | Duplicate type assignment in module scope.                                     |
| `ASN12002` | `duplicate-field-name`      | `error`   | Duplicate field name in `SEQUENCE`/`SET`/`CHOICE`.                             |
| `ASN12003` | `duplicate-enum-value`      | `error`   | Duplicate `ENUMERATED` or named-number name/integer value.                     |
| `ASN12004` | `undefined-type-reference`  | `error`   | Reference to an undefined ASN.1 type.                                          |
| `ASN13001` | `cyclic-type-dependency`    | `error`   | Cyclic non-optional type dependency causing infinite wire size.                |
| `ASN13002` | `duplicate-context-tag`     | `error`   | Duplicate tag `[n]` in `CHOICE`/`SET`/`SEQUENCE` causing decoding ambiguity.   |
| `ASN13003` | `ambiguous-optional-fields` | `warning` | Consecutive untagged `OPTIONAL` fields with identical outer tag.               |
| `ASN14001` | `invalid-size-constraint`   | `error`   | Invalid `SIZE` constraint (`min > max` or negative bound).                     |
| `ASN14002` | `invalid-integer-range`     | `error`   | Invalid integer range (`min > max`).                                           |
| `ASN15001` | `non-canonical-der-length`  | `error`   | Non-canonical DER length (indefinite `0x80` or non-minimal long form).         |
| `ASN15002` | `non-canonical-der-boolean` | `error`   | Non-canonical DER `BOOLEAN` byte (must be `0x00` or `0xFF`).                   |
| `ASN15003` | `non-canonical-der-integer` | `error`   | Non-canonical DER `INTEGER` (redundant leading sign octet).                    |
| `ASN15004` | `invalid-oid-arcs`          | `error`   | Invalid `OBJECT IDENTIFIER` root arcs (`arc0 > 2` or `arc0 < 2 && arc1 > 39`). |
| `ASN15005` | `truncated-tlv`             | `error`   | Truncated BER/DER TLV payload exceeding available buffer.                      |
| `ASN15006` | `trailing-tlv-bytes`        | `warning` | Trailing unparsed bytes after top-level BER/DER TLV.                           |

---

## Programmatic Usage

```typescript
import {
  parseAsn1,
  encodeDer,
  decodeBer,
  bytesToHex,
  lintAsn1,
  computeWireSizeBounds,
  asn1ToDae,
  asn1ToSdl,
  asn1ToC,
  asn1ToJsonSchema,
  renderAsn1DiagramSvg,
} from "@modelscript/asn1";

const der = encodeDer({
  kind: "sequence",
  items: [{ kind: "oid", value: "1.2.840.113549.1.1.1" }, { kind: "null" }],
});
console.log(bytesToHex(der)); // 30 0D 06 09 2A 86 48 86 F7 0D 01 01 01 05 00
```

# Aerospace & Aviation

**Tagline:** Flight dynamics, propulsion & mission telemetry
**Summary:** Connect SysML v2 architectures and ReqIF requirements to JSBSim flight models, NASA ROCETS propulsion decks, Modelica subsystems, and CCSDS telemetry, then simulate, formally verify, and export SSP / FMU packages without leaving one toolchain.
**Headline:** From requirements to flight dynamics in a single, verifiable thread

**Target Languages:** `jsbsim`, `rocets`, `ccsds`, `easy5`, `modelica`, `ssp`, `sysml2`, `reqif`, `oscal`, `step`, `qif`, `cfd`, `fea`, `fortran`
**Supported Standards:** SysML v2 / KerML, ReqIF, NIST OSCAL 1.1, CCSDS OEM / OPM / XTCE, STEP AP242, ISO 23952 QIF 3.0, SSP 1.0 (FMI 2.0 / 3.0), DO-178C MC/DC & Formal Proof

### Industry Challenges & Solutions
- **Requirements drift from analysis:** Requirements live in one tool, physics in another. Traceability is rebuilt by hand before every review.
- **Legacy Fortran & decks:** Decades of validated propulsion and flight code are locked in card decks and Fortran routines nobody wants to touch.
- **Certification evidence is manual:** Verification artifacts are assembled from screenshots and spreadsheets instead of generated from the models.

### Key Capabilities
- **6-DOF flight dynamics:** Parse JSBSim aircraft definitions and lower them to DAEs for simulation and linearization.
- **Propulsion transients:** Ingest ROCETS engine decks and turbomachinery maps, with a bridge for embedded Fortran user routines.
- **Mission telemetry:** Read CCSDS orbit and XTCE telemetry definitions and align them with simulated trajectories.
- **Formal verification:** Check SysML v2 constraints, k-induction safety proofs, and MC/DC test vectors across airframe and controls.

### End-to-End Workflow
1. **Capture:** SysML v2 architecture + ReqIF requirements
2. **Model:** JSBSim airframe, ROCETS engine, Modelica subsystems
3. **Simulate:** Stiff DAE solvers, SSP co-sim & Monte Carlo
4. **Verify:** MC/DC, barrier proofs & SARIF evidence

### Representative CLI Workflow
```bash
msx rocets simulate engine.roc
msx render SpacecraftPower spacecraft.sysml --view IBD -o ibd.svg
msx verify BrakingController brake.mo --format sarif
```

# Automotive & Mobility

**Tagline:** AUTOSAR, powertrain & autonomous-driving scenarios
**Summary:** Bring AUTOSAR architectures, Simulink controllers, GT-SUITE powertrains, ReqIF safety specs, and ASAM OpenDRIVE / OpenSCENARIO scenarios into one workspace, then co-simulate, verify ISO 26262 parity, and export FMUs.
**Headline:** Software-defined vehicles need a software-defined toolchain

**Target Languages:** `autosar`, `simulink`, `gtsuite`, `opendrive`, `openscenario`, `gtfs`, `reqif`, `adams`, `simpack`, `qif`, `oscal`, `ssp`, `modelica`, `c`
**Supported Standards:** AUTOSAR Classic & Adaptive, ASAM OpenDRIVE, ASAM OpenSCENARIO, GTFS Transit Feeds, FMI 2.0 / 3.0, SSP 1.0, ISO 26262 (via ReqIF & B2B / MC/DC)

### Industry Challenges & Solutions
- **Toolchain sprawl:** Architecture, controls, plant, and scenario tools each speak their own format, so integrating them takes weeks.
- **Scenario coverage:** Proving AV safety means running thousands of scenarios, not a handful of hand-picked test drives.
- **Vendor lock-in:** Per-seat licenses limit who can run models, so CI and supplier collaboration suffer.

### Key Capabilities
- **AUTOSAR RTE simulation:** Inspect and lint ARXML, project it to SysML v2, and simulate runnable scheduling.
- **Simulink → Modelica:** Parse .slx / .mdl block diagrams and translate them to equation-based Modelica with Back-to-Back parity checks.
- **Scenario safety:** Orchestrate OpenSCENARIO runs on OpenDRIVE roads with time-to-collision and RSS margin checks.
- **Co-simulation:** Package FMUs with SSP and orchestrate multi-rate co-simulation.

### End-to-End Workflow
1. **Architect:** AUTOSAR ARXML & ReqIF → SysML v2
2. **Integrate:** Simulink controllers + GT-SUITE plant
3. **Scenario:** OpenDRIVE roads, OpenSCENARIO maneuvers
4. **Deliver:** FMI 3.0 FMUs & SSP 1.0 packages

### Representative CLI Workflow
```bash
msx autosar lint BrakeController.arxml

msx fmu DC_Motor motor.mo --fmi-version 3 --type cs
```

# Power Systems & Grid

**Tagline:** EMT, power flow & grid-code compliance
**Summary:** Run PSCAD/EMTDC electromagnetic transients, Siemens PSS/E, DIgSILENT PowerFactory, and GE PSLF transmission studies alongside OpenDSS distribution, IEC 61850 substations, OCPP EV charging, and OpenADR demand response — with IEEE 2800, NERC PRC-029, and ENTSO-E RfG verification built in.
**Headline:** Grid-code compliance, from PSCAD to IEEE 2800 in one pipeline

**Target Languages:** `pscad`, `psse`, `powerfactory`, `pslf`, `cgmes`, `matpower`, `opendss`, `atp`, `comtrade`, `scl`, `dnp3`, `oneliner`, `sel`, `ocpp`, `openadr`, `ampl`, `oscal`, `modelica`, `c`, `fortran`, `csv`
**Supported Standards:** IEEE 2800-2022 & NERC PRC-029-1, ENTSO-E RfG & IEEE 1547-2018, DIgSILENT PowerFactory (.dz / .pfd / .dsl), GE PSLF (.epc / .dyd) & PSS/E RAW v30–35, IEC 61970-600 CGMES & IEC 61850 SCL (GOOSE / SV), IEEE 1815 (DNP3) & C37.111 COMTRADE, OCPP 1.6J / 2.0.1 & OpenADR 2.0b, NIST OSCAL 1.1 (NERC CIP) & CIGRE B4.82 / TB 881

### Key Capabilities

- **Power flow & DER hosting:** PSS/E, PowerFactory, CGMES, and PSLF transmission cases plus OpenDSS unbalanced distribution and hosting capacity.
- **COMTRADE waveforms:** Read and write IEEE C37.111 transient recordings and validate IEC 61850 GOOSE / SEL protection coordination.

3. **Record:** COMTRADE waveforms
4. **Comply:** IEEE 2800 / NERC PRC-029 / ENTSO-E RfG report

### Representative CLI Workflow
```bash
msx pscad verify-ieee2800 SolarPlant_250MW.pscx --tstop 3.0 --step 20us -o report.json

```

# Chemical & Process

**Tagline:** Flowsheets, kinetics, geochemistry & molecular graphs
**Summary:** Parse Aspen Plus flowsheets, gPROMS dynamic PDEs, AMPL algebraic optimization models, Cantera reaction mechanisms, PHREEQC aqueous geochemistry, and SMILES/SDF molecular graphs, and couple them with equation-based control and pipeline networks.
**Headline:** Open, scriptable chemical & process simulation

**Target Languages:** `aspen`, `gproms`, `ampl`, `cantera`, `phreeqc`, `smiles`, `olga`, `lps`, `plcopen`, `modelica`, `csv`
**Supported Standards:** Aspen Plus / HYSYS (.bkp / .inp), gPROMS PML (Method of Lines), AMPL (.mod / .nl / .mps), Cantera YAML & NASA-7 Thermo, USGS PHREEQC Geochemistry, SMILES / MDL Molfile & Joback-Reid, IEC 61131-3 & FMI 2.0 / 3.0

### Industry Challenges & Solutions
- **Steady-state only:** Flowsheets are rarely carried into dynamic and control studies.
- **Closed formats:** Process models are hard to review, diff, and automate.
- **Disconnected scales:** Molecular properties, reaction kinetics, and plant controls live in separate tools.

### Key Capabilities
- **Flowsheets & PDEs:** Read Aspen flowsheets and discretize gPROMS distributed domains via Method of Lines.
- **Kinetics & thermochemistry:** Evaluate Cantera Arrhenius/Troe mechanisms and NASA-7 polynomials.
- **Molecular & aqueous properties:** Estimate Joback critical properties from SMILES and PHREEQC mineral saturation.
- **Optimization:** Direct-collocation optimal control, AMPL NLP solving, and parameter estimation.

### End-to-End Workflow
1. **Molecules:** SMILES, Cantera & PHREEQC
2. **Flowsheet:** Aspen & gPROMS PDEs
3. **Control:** Modelica & PLC co-sim
4. **Optimize:** AMPL & collocation solver

### Representative CLI Workflow
```bash
msx lint ./plant --format json
msx optimize Reactor reactor.mo
msx simulate Reactor reactor.mo --stop-time 3600
```

# Life Sciences, Healthcare & Medical

**Tagline:** Systems biology, pharmacometrics, radiotherapy & surgical CAS
**Summary:** Unify systems & synthetic biology (SBML, Antimony, BioNetGen, SBOL3, SED-ML, NMTRAN, MLXTRAN, PDB, GenBank) with clinical physiology, neurobiology, biomechanics, radiation oncology, and computer-assisted surgery (CellML, NMODL, OpenSim, FEBio, DICOM-RT, TOPAS, NIfTI/NRRD, 3MF Medical, OpenIGTLink).
**Headline:** From molecular pathways to radiotherapy and surgical navigation

**Target Languages:** `sbml`, `antimony`, `bngl`, `sbol`, `sedml`, `nmtran`, `mlxtran`, `pdb`, `genbank`, `cellml`, `nmodl`, `opensim`, `febio`, `dicom-rt`, `topas`, `nifti`, `three-mf`, `igtl`, `modelica`, `owl2`, `csv`
**Supported Standards:** SBML L2/L3 & SED-ML, SBOL3 & GenBank, NONMEM NMTRAN & Monolix MLXTRAN, CellML 2.0 & NEURON NMODL, DICOM-RT (RTPLAN / RTSTRUCT / RTDOSE) & TOPAS, NIfTI-1/2 & NRRD, ISO/ASTM 52915 3MF Medical, OpenIGTLink & PLUS, FDA 21 CFR 820.30 / Part 11 DHF & IEC 62304

### Industry Challenges & Solutions
- **Reproducibility gaps:** Published biological and clinical models are hard to re-run and verify across scales.
- **Fragmented clinical geometry:** Medical imaging, radiotherapy plans, surgical guides, and tracker calibration live in disconnected silos.
- **Regulatory traceability:** Assembling FDA 21 CFR 820.30 / Part 11 / IEC 62304 Design History Files by hand is slow and error-prone.

### Key Capabilities
- **Systems & synthetic biology:** Simulate SBML, Antimony, BioNetGen, SBOL3 genetic circuits, and NONMEM PK/PD dosing protocols.
- **Physiome & biomechanics:** Solve CellML cardiac electrophysiology, OpenSim musculoskeletal dynamics, and FEBio hyperelastic tissues.
- **Radiotherapy & proton therapy:** Evaluate DICOM-RT DVH metrics, BED/EQD2 biological doses, and TOPAS Bortfeld Bragg peaks.
- **Image-guided surgery:** Extract NIfTI/NRRD iso-surfaces, verify 3MF surgical guides, and compute OpenIGTLink Fitzpatrick TRE.

### End-to-End Workflow
1. **Pathways:** SBML, Antimony, SBOL3 & NMTRAN
2. **Biomechanics:** CellML, OpenSim & FEBio
3. **Oncology & CAS:** DICOM-RT, TOPAS, NIfTI, 3MF & IGTL
4. **Certify:** FDA / ISO Design History File

### Representative CLI Workflow
```bash
msx dicom-rt dosimetry ProstateVMAT.rtplan
msx topas bragg-peak ProtonNozzle.topas
msx three-mf topology MandibleOsteotomyGuide.3mf
msx igtl calibrate LaparoscopicTracker.plus.xml
```

# Linter Rules Reference

ModelScript ships **2392 diagnostic rules** across **149 languages**. This page is generated from each language's rule catalog (for example `languages/modelica/src/errors.ts`), so codes, severities and message templates match what the tools report. Text in `<angle brackets>` is filled in from your model.

## Running the linters

Diagnostics appear as you type in VS Code and Studio through the language server. From the command line:

```bash
# Languages handled by the unified linter (detected by file extension)
msx lint ./models
msx lint ./models --format json --strict

# Domain formats with their own command
msx spice lint SensorFrontEnd.net
```

The **CLI** column below shows which command reports each language's rules.
